# nbo-png-infraestructure-flux

Código fuente de producción y configuraciones. Captura local: 28/10/2026.

Incluye 0 archivos Java y 5516 archivos de configuración, recursos y compilación/despliegue.

Cada sección identifica la ruta original y contiene el archivo completo, salvo valores de credenciales ocultados. Los Java conservan sus implementaciones, imports, anotaciones y comentarios. Se excluyen src/test, resultados de compilación, binarios y herramientas/perfiles de pruebas de rendimiento.

Infraestructura: incluye bases, devops-base, env, flux-system, overlays, scripts y utils. Los entornos QA/testing se conservan porque son configuraciones de despliegue. La carpeta raíz poc y la documentación quedan fuera.

Valores de credenciales ocultados en configuraciones: 155. Referencias a variables de entorno conservadas.

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: adm-garantias-back-app
  namespace: nubo-back
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: adm-garantias-back
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: adm-garantias-back
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: adm-garantias-back-app-container
          image: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/adm-garantias-back:0.11.1
          imagePullPolicy: Always
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "200m"
              memory: "256Mi"

              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
```

## bases/apps/authentication-front/config-authentication.yml

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: config-authentication
  namespace: nubo-front
data:
  default.conf: |
    server {
        listen       5003;
        listen  [::]:5003;
        server_name  localhost;

        #access_log  /var/log/nginx/host.access.log  main;

        location / {
            
            if ($request_method = 'OPTIONS') {
                 add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' '*';
                 add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods' 'GET, POST, OPTIONS, DELETE, PUT, PATCH';
                 add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers' 'Authorization, Content-Type';
                 add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Credentials' 'true';
                  return 204;
            }
            add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' '*';
            add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods' 'GET, POST, OPTIONS, DELETE, PUT, PATCH';
            add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers' 'Authorization, Content-Type';
            add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Credentials' 'true';

            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            index  index.html index.htm;
        }
        
        location /assets/ {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            types {
                application/javascript js;
                text/css css;
                image/svg+xml svg;
                application/json json;
            }
            add_header Cache-Control "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate";
        }

        error_page  404              /404.html;

        # redirect server error pages to the static page /50x.html
        #
        error_page   500 502 503 504  /50x.html;
        location = /50x.html {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
        }

        # proxy the PHP scripts to Apache listening on 127.0.0.1:80
        #
        #location ~ \.php$ {
        #    proxy_pass   http://127.0.0.1;
        #}

        # pass the PHP scripts to FastCGI server listening on 127.0.0.1:9000
        #
        #location ~ \.php$ {
        #    root           html;
        #    fastcgi_pass   127.0.0.1:9000;
        #    fastcgi_index  index.php;
        #    fastcgi_param  SCRIPT_FILENAME  /scripts$fastcgi_script_name;
        #    include        fastcgi_params;
        #}

        # deny access to .htaccess files, if Apache's document root
        # concurs with nginx's one
        #
        #location ~ /\.ht {
        #    deny  all;
        #}
    }
```

## bases/apps/authentication-front/deploy-react-app.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: authentication-front-app
  namespace: nubo-front
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: authentication-front-app
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: authentication-front-app
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: authentication-front-app-container
          image: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/authentication-front:1.110.0
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "100m" # New 20250621
              memory: "64Mi"
            limits: # New 20250621
              cpu: "500m" # New 20250621
              memory: "128Mi"
          env:
            - name: VITE_REMOTE_UTILITIES
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: config-auth-env-variable
                  key: VITE_REMOTE_UTILITIES
            - name: VITE_REMOTE_PARENT

                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: config-auth-env-variable
                  key: VITE_REMOTE_PARENT
            - name: VITE_DECRYPTION_KEY
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:

                  key: VITE_DECRYPTION_KEY

                  key: VITE_REMOTE_BG_IMAGE_DEV
            - name: VITE_KC_BASE_URL
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: config-auth-env-variable
                  key: VITE_KC_BASE_URL
            - name: VITE_KC_REALM
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:

                  key: VITE_KC_REALM
            - name: VITE_KC_CLIENT_ID
              valueFrom:

              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: config-auth-env-variable
                  key: VITE_DOMAIN_EMAIL_NUAM
          ports:

          volumeMounts:

              mountPath: /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf

            #   mountPath: /etc/ssl/certs/apisix.crt

          # command:

          #     # Crear el archivo ca-certificates.crt si no existe
          #     touch /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && \
          #     # Copiar el contenido existente de ca-certificates.crt a un archivo temporal
          #     cp /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt /tmp/ca-certificates.crt.bak && \
          #     # Añadir el contenido de apisix.crt al archivo temporal
          #     cat /etc/ssl/certs/apisix.crt >> /tmp/ca-certificates.crt.bak && \
          #     # Copiar el archivo temporal de vuelta a ca-certificates.crt
          #     cp /tmp/ca-certificates.crt.bak /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && \
          #     # Iniciar la aplicación principal
          #     exec nginx -g 'daemon off;'
      volumes:

          configMap:
            name: config-authentication
      # - name: apisix-cert-volume
```

## bases/apps/cronjob-automatico-manual/cronjob-nubo-update-diario.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: nubo-update-preclosure-1155
  namespace: postgresql-nubo
spec:
  schedule: "0 23 * * *"
  timeZone: America/Lima
  concurrencyPolicy: Forbid
  startingDeadlineSeconds: 600
  suspend: false
  successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 1
  failedJobsHistoryLimit: 3
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      activeDeadlineSeconds: 300
      backoffLimit: 2
      ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 86400 # borra Job + Pod 24h después de terminar
      template:
        spec:
          restartPolicy: Never
          automountServiceAccountToken: false
          terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30
          imagePullSecrets:
            - name: harbor-credentials-postgresql-nubo
          securityContext:
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 70 # usuario postgres en la imagen alpine
            runAsGroup: 70
            seccompProfile:
              type: RuntimeDefault
          containers:
            - name: postgres-update
              image: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/postgres-alpine/postgres:13-alpine
              imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
              securityContext:
                allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
                capabilities:
                  drop: ["ALL"]
              command: ["/bin/sh", "-c"]
              args:
                - |
                  set -eu
                  echo "=== Iniciando update TEMP_PRUEBA4: $(date) ==="

                  psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --single-transaction <<'EOF'
                  SET lock_timeout = '10s';
                  SET statement_timeout = '120s';
                  UPDATE "NUANBODB"."PRE_CLOSURE_COUNTRY"
                  SET "STATUS_ID" = 1155
                  WHERE "STATUS_ID" IS DISTINCT FROM 1155;
                  EOF

                  echo "=== Job finalizado OK: $(date) ==="
              env:
                - name: PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT
                  value: "10"
                - name: PGHOST
                  valueFrom:
                    {
                      secretKeyRef: "[REDACTED]"
                    }
                - name: PGPORT
                  valueFrom:
                    {
                      secretKeyRef: "[REDACTED]"
                    }
                - name: PGDATABASE
                  valueFrom:
                    {
                      secretKeyRef:
                        { name: postgres-credentials, key: PGDATABASE },
                    }
                - name: PGUSER
                  valueFrom:
                    {
                      secretKeyRef: "[REDACTED]"
                    }
                - name: PGPASSWORD
                  valueFrom:
                    {
                      secretKeyRef:
                        { name: postgres-credentials, key: PGPASSWORD },
                    }
              resources:
                requests:
                  cpu: 50m
                  memory: 64Mi
                limits:
                  cpu: 100m
                  memory: 128Mi

```

## bases/apps/cronjob-automatico-manual/cronJob-paquetes.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: automatic-packaging-cronjob
  namespace: nubo-back

spec:
  # Kubernetes interpreta el horario en UTC.
  # Con TZ=UTC+5, el script calcula la hora de Peru/Colombia (UTC-5).
  schedule: "*/10 13-20 * * 1-5"

  # Se declara explícitamente para que Flux mantenga activo el CronJob.
  suspend: false

  concurrencyPolicy: Forbid
  startingDeadlineSeconds: 300

  successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 3
  failedJobsHistoryLimit: 3

  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      backoffLimit: 0

      # curl puede esperar hasta 240 segundos.
      # El Job debe permitir un tiempo mayor.
      activeDeadlineSeconds: 300

      # Los Jobs terminados se conservan aproximadamente 5 minutos.
      ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 300

      template:
        spec:
          restartPolicy: Never

          containers:
            - name: automatic-packaging-cronjob
              image: curlimages/curl:latest

              env:
                - name: TZ
                  value: "UTC+5"

              command:
                - /bin/sh
                - -c
                - |
                  NOW=$(date +%H:%M)

                  case "${NOW}" in
                    "08:30")
                      CUT="SAME_DAY_CUT_1"
                      SDS="true"
                      ;;
                    "10:00")
                      CUT="FUTURE_DAY_CUT_1"
                      SDS="false"
                      ;;
                    "10:30")
                      CUT="SAME_DAY_CUT_2"
                      SDS="true"
                      ;;
                    "11:20")
                      CUT="SAME_DAY_CUT_3"
                      SDS="true"
                      ;;
                    "12:00")
                      CUT="FUTURE_DAY_CUT_2"
                      SDS="false"
                      ;;
                    "15:00")
                      CUT="FUTURE_DAY_CUT_3"
                      SDS="false"
                      ;;
                    *)
                      echo "No hay corte programado para las ${NOW}; se omite la ejecución."
                      exit 0
                      ;;
                  esac

                  EXEC_DATE=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)
                  CLIENT_DT=$(date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)

                  echo "Ejecutando corte:"
                  echo "horaLocal=${NOW}"
                  echo "executionDate=${EXEC_DATE}"
                  echo "cutType=${CUT}"
                  echo "sameDaySettlement=${SDS}"

                  curl -i \
                    --fail-with-body \
                    --connect-timeout 10 \
                    --max-time 240 \
                    -X POST "http://operaciones-empaquetamiento-automatico-back-service.nubo-back.svc.cluster.local/operations-custody-automatic-packages-api/v1/automatic-custodian-packages/run" \
                    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
                    -H "client_ip: 127.0.0.1" \
                    -H "client_user: automatic-packaging-cronjob" \
                    -H "client_datetime: ${CLIENT_DT}" \
                    -d "{\"executionDate\":\"${EXEC_DATE}\",\"cutType\":\"${CUT}\",\"sameDaySettlement\":${SDS}}"
```

## bases/apps/cronjob-automatico-manual/cronJob-pending-operations-mail.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: pending-operations-mail-cronjob
  namespace: nubo-back
spec:
  # Una corrida diaria, lunes a viernes, a las 4:30pm hora Bogotá — NUBFAC-62.
  # Hora PLACEHOLDER a confirmar con negocio (la HU solo da "7:00pm" como ejemplo del horario
  # de cumplimiento/asignación, no de cuándo debe salir el aviso).
  schedule: "30 16 * * 1-5"
  timeZone: "America/Bogota"

  suspend: false
  concurrencyPolicy: Forbid
  startingDeadlineSeconds: 300

  successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 3
  failedJobsHistoryLimit: 3

  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      backoffLimit: 0
      activeDeadlineSeconds: 120
      ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 300

      template:
        spec:
          restartPolicy: Never

          containers:
            - name: pending-operations-mail-cronjob
              image: curlimages/curl:latest

              command:
                - /bin/sh
                - -c
                - |
                  CLIENT_DT=$(date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)

                  for CUT_TYPE in PENDING_SETTLEMENT_CUT PENDING_ASSIGNMENT_CUT; do
                    echo "Ejecutando corte de operaciones pendientes RF: cutType=${CUT_TYPE}"
                    curl -i \
                      --fail-with-body \
                      --connect-timeout 10 \
                      --max-time 90 \
                      -X POST "http://operaciones-rf-cmd-back-service.nubo-back.svc.cluster.local/operations-rf-cmd-api/v1/pending-operations-mail/run?cutType=${CUT_TYPE}" \
                      -H "client_ip: 127.0.0.1" \
                      -H "client_user: pending-operations-mail-cronjob" \
                      -H "client_datetime: ${CLIENT_DT}" \
                      -H "client_backend: true"
                  done

          imagePullSecrets:
            - name: harbor-credentials-nubo-back

```

```yaml
  name: dashboard-metrics-query-back-app
  namespace: nubo-back
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: dashboard-metrics-query-back
  template:

      labels:
        app: dashboard-metrics-query-back
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        fsGroup: 10001
        automountServiceAccountToken: false
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: dashboard-metrics-query-back-app-container
          image: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/dashboard-metrics-query-back:1.0.0
          imagePullPolicy: Always
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 10001
            seccompProfile:
              type: RuntimeDefault
            #readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          resources:

              cpu: "200m"

              memory: "512Mi"
          env:

                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret
                  key: DB_PASSWORD
            - name: DB_URL
              valueFrom:

              valueFrom:

                  name: nubo-back-secret
                  key: DB_HIKARI_MAXIMUM_POOL_SIZE
            - name: DB_HIKARI_MINIMUM_IDLE
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret
                  key: DB_HIKARI_MINIMUM_IDLE
            - name: DB_HIKARI_IDLE_TIMEOUT
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret
                  key: DB_HIKARI_IDLE_TIMEOUT
            - name: DB_HIKARI_VALIDATION_TIMEOUT
```

## bases/apps/ebs-attach-poc/io2-multiattach.yaml

```yaml
# Prueba 2c: EBS io2 Multi-Attach real. Solo io1/io2 lo soportan, solo dentro de UNA AZ,
# solo en modo bloque (volumeMode: Block) y sin filesystem compartido: la coordinacion de
# escrituras es responsabilidad de la aplicacion.
# Esperado: io2-app-1a e io2-infra-1a Running en nodos distintos de us-east-1a, con el mismo
# disco adjunto; io2-app-1b Pending (Multi-Attach no cruza AZ).
# Costo: 4 GiB io2 + 100 IOPS mientras exista (centavos por hora). Retirar al terminar.
apiVersion: storage.k8s.io/v1
kind: StorageClass
metadata:
  name: poc-io2-multiattach
provisioner: ebs.csi.aws.com
reclaimPolicy: Delete
volumeBindingMode: WaitForFirstConsumer
allowVolumeExpansion: false
parameters:
  type: io2
  iops: "100"
  encrypted: "true"
allowedTopologies:
  - matchLabelExpressions:
      - key: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
        values:
          - us-east-1a
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: ebs-io2-multiattach
  namespace: poc-sqlite-multizone
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteMany
  volumeMode: Block
  storageClassName: poc-io2-multiattach
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 4Gi
---
# Nodo aplicacion de us-east-1a: escritor.
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: io2-app-1a
  namespace: poc-sqlite-multizone
spec:
  replicas: 1
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: io2-app-1a
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: io2-app-1a
        prueba: io2-multiattach
    spec:
      nodeSelector:
        workload: aplicacion
        topology.kubernetes.io/zone: us-east-1a
      tolerations:
        - key: workload
          operator: Equal
          value: aplicacion
          effect: NoSchedule
      securityContext:
        # El dispositivo de bloque crudo pertenece a root:disk; se usa root sin capabilities.
        runAsUser: 0
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: tools
          image: python:3.13-alpine
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          command: ["python", "-c", "import time; time.sleep(10**9)"]
          env:
            - name: POD_NAME
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: metadata.name
            - name: NODE_NAME
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: spec.nodeName
            - name: DEVICE
              value: /dev/shared-io2
            - name: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE
              value: "1"
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 10m
              memory: 16Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 64Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          volumeMounts:
            - name: tools
              mountPath: /tools
              readOnly: true
          volumeDevices:
            - name: shared
              devicePath: /dev/shared-io2
      volumes:
        - name: tools
          configMap:
            name: ebs-attach-tools
        - name: shared
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: ebs-io2-multiattach
---
# Nodo infra de us-east-1a (sin taint): segundo nodo de la misma AZ. Pod temporal de la prueba.
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: io2-infra-1a
  namespace: poc-sqlite-multizone
spec:
  replicas: 1
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: io2-infra-1a
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: io2-infra-1a
        prueba: io2-multiattach
    spec:
      nodeSelector:
        workload: infra

      containers:

              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: spec.nodeName
            - name: DEVICE
              value: /dev/shared-io2
            - name: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE
              value: "1"
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 10m
              memory: 16Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 64Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false

            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          volumeMounts:
            - name: tools

# Nodo aplicacion de us-east-1b: debe quedar Pending (Multi-Attach no cruza AZ).
```

```yaml
# Prueba 2a (NEGATIVA): 3 replicas obligadas a 3 AZ compartiendo un EBS gp3 RWO.
# Esperado: 1 pod Running en la AZ del volumen y 2 Pending por conflicto de zona.
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: ebs-shared-3az
  namespace: poc-sqlite-multizone
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  storageClassName: ebs-sc-gp3
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: ebs-shared-3az
  namespace: poc-sqlite-multizone
spec:
  replicas: 3
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ebs-shared-3az
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ebs-shared-3az
    spec:
      nodeSelector:
        workload: aplicacion
      tolerations:
        - key: workload
          operator: Equal
          value: aplicacion
          effect: NoSchedule
      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:
          requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
            - labelSelector:
                matchLabels:
                  app: ebs-shared-3az
              topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: tools
          image: python:3.13-alpine
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          command: ["python", "-c", "import time; time.sleep(10**9)"]
          env:
            - name: POD_NAME
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: metadata.name
            - name: NODE_NAME
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: spec.nodeName
            - name: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE
              value: "1"
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 10m
              memory: 16Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 64Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          volumeMounts:
            - name: tools
              mountPath: /tools
              readOnly: true
            - name: data
              mountPath: /data
      volumes:
        - name: tools
          configMap:
            name: ebs-attach-tools
        - name: data
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: ebs-shared-3az

```

## bases/apps/ebs-attach-poc/shared-samenode.yaml

```yaml
# Prueba 2b: 3 replicas SIN restriccion de zona compartiendo un EBS gp3 RWO.
# RWO significa "un nodo", no "un pod": el scheduler coloca las 3 en el nodo donde esta
# adjunto el volumen. Esperado: 3 Running en el MISMO nodo. No es Multi-Attach ni alta disponibilidad.
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: ebs-shared-samenode
  namespace: poc-sqlite-multizone
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  storageClassName: ebs-sc-gp3
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: ebs-shared-samenode
  namespace: poc-sqlite-multizone
spec:
  replicas: 3
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ebs-shared-samenode
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ebs-shared-samenode
    spec:
      nodeSelector:
        workload: aplicacion
      tolerations:
        - key: workload
          operator: Equal
          value: aplicacion
          effect: NoSchedule
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
        # Con SELinux cada pod recibe categorias MCS propias y el volumen queda etiquetado para
        # el ultimo pod que lo monta. Un nivel fijo e igual para las 3 replicas les permite
        # compartir el mismo volumen. En nodos sin SELinux se ignora.
        seLinuxOptions:
          level: "s0:c500,c501"
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      initContainers:
        # La raiz del volumen nace root:root sin escritura para el usuario 1000. Se ajusta una
        # sola vez (idempotente: las otras replicas lo encuentran listo); solo capability CHOWN.
        - name: volume-permissions
          image: python:3.13-alpine
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          command: ["sh", "-c", "if [ \"$(stat -c %u /data)\" != 1000 ]; then chmod 0775 /data && chown 1000:1000 /data; fi; ls -land /data; cat /proc/self/attr/current 2>/dev/null; echo"]
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 10m
              memory: 16Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 64Mi
          securityContext:
            runAsNonRoot: false
            runAsUser: 0
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
              add: ["CHOWN"]
          volumeMounts:
            - name: data
              mountPath: /data
      containers:
        - name: tools
          image: python:3.13-alpine
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          command: ["python", "-c", "import time; time.sleep(10**9)"]
          env:
            - name: POD_NAME
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: metadata.name
            - name: NODE_NAME
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: spec.nodeName
            - name: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE
              value: "1"
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 10m
              memory: 16Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 64Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          volumeMounts:
            - name: tools
              mountPath: /tools
              readOnly: true
            - name: data
              mountPath: /data
      volumes:
        - name: tools
          configMap:
            name: ebs-attach-tools
        - name: data
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: ebs-shared-samenode

```

## bases/apps/ebs-attach-poc/tools-configmap.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: ebs-attach-tools
  namespace: poc-sqlite-multizone
data:
  # Archivos sobre un filesystem montado (pruebas 2a y 2b).
  files.py: |
    import hashlib
    import os
    import sys

    DATA = os.environ.get("DATA_DIR", "/data")
    WHO = f"pod={os.environ.get('POD_NAME')} node={os.environ.get('NODE_NAME')}"

    cmd = sys.argv[1]
    if cmd == "write":
        name, content = sys.argv[2], " ".join(sys.argv[3:])
        path = os.path.join(DATA, name)
        with open(path, "w") as f:
            f.write(content)
            f.flush()
            os.fsync(f.fileno())
        print(f"WRITE {name} sha256={hashlib.sha256(content.encode()).hexdigest()} {WHO}")
    elif cmd == "read":
        path = os.path.join(DATA, sys.argv[2])
        if not os.path.exists(path):
            print(f"READ {sys.argv[2]} NO_EXISTE {WHO}")
            sys.exit(0)
        content = open(path).read()
        print(f"READ {sys.argv[2]} sha256={hashlib.sha256(content.encode()).hexdigest()} contenido='{content}' {WHO}")
    elif cmd == "list":
        print(f"LIST {sorted(os.listdir(DATA))} {WHO}")
  # Bloque crudo con O_DIRECT, sin cache del kernel (prueba 2c, io2 Multi-Attach).
  block.py: |
    import mmap
    import os
    import sys

    DEVICE = os.environ.get("DEVICE", "/dev/shared-io2")
    BLOCK = 4096
    WHO = f"pod={os.environ.get('POD_NAME')} node={os.environ.get('NODE_NAME')}"

    buf = mmap.mmap(-1, BLOCK)
    if sys.argv[1] == "write":
        msg = " ".join(sys.argv[2:]).encode()[:BLOCK]
        buf.write(msg)
        fd = os.open(DEVICE, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_DIRECT | os.O_SYNC)
        os.pwritev(fd, [buf], 0)
        os.close(fd)
        print(f"WRITE offset=0 bytes={len(msg)} {WHO}")
    elif sys.argv[1] == "read":
        fd = os.open(DEVICE, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECT)
        os.preadv(fd, [buf], 0)
        os.close(fd)
        print(f"READ offset=0 contenido='{bytes(buf).rstrip(bytes(1)).decode(errors='replace')}' {WHO}")

```

```yaml
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
```
```yaml
          volumeMounts:
            - name: kafka-certificates
              mountPath: /app/certificates
      volumes:
        - name: kafka-certificates
          configMap:
            name: kafka-certificates
      imagePullSecrets:
        - name: harbor-credentials-nubo-back-integracion
---
```

## bases/apps/garantias-front/config-garantias.yml

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: config-garantias
  namespace: nubo-front
data:
  default.conf: |
    server {
        listen       5007;
        listen  [::]:5007;
        server_name  localhost;

        #access_log  /var/log/nginx/host.access.log  main;

        location / {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            index  index.html index.htm;
        }
        
        location /assets/ {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            types {
                application/javascript js;
                text/css css;
            }
            add_header Cache-Control "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate";
        }
        
        error_page  404              /404.html;

        # redirect server error pages to the static page /50x.html
        #
        error_page   500 502 503 504  /50x.html;
        location = /50x.html {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
        }

        # proxy the PHP scripts to Apache listening on 127.0.0.1:80
        #
        #location ~ \.php$ {
        #    proxy_pass   http://127.0.0.1;
        #}

        # pass the PHP scripts to FastCGI server listening on 127.0.0.1:9000
        #
        #location ~ \.php$ {
        #    root           html;
        #    fastcgi_pass   127.0.0.1:9000;
        #    fastcgi_index  index.php;
        #    fastcgi_param  SCRIPT_FILENAME  /scripts$fastcgi_script_name;
        #    include        fastcgi_params;
        #}

        # deny access to .htaccess files, if Apache's document root
        # concurs with nginx's one
        #
        #location ~ /\.ht {
        #    deny  all;
        #}
    }
```

## bases/apps/garantias-front/deploy-react-app.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: garantias-front-app
  namespace: nubo-front
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: garantias-front-app
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: garantias-front-app
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: garantias-front-app-container
          image: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/garantias-front:0.54.0
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "200m" # New 20250621
              memory: "256Mi"
            limits: # New 20250621
              cpu: "500m" # New 20250621
              memory: "512Mi"
          env:
            - name: VITE_REMOTE_PARENT
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: config-garantias-env-variable
                  key: VITE_REMOTE_PARENT
            - name: VITE_REMOTE_UTILITIES
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: config-garantias-env-variable
                  key: VITE_REMOTE_UTILITIES
            - name: VITE_DEV_USER_MANAGEMENT
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: config-garantias-env-variable
                  key: VITE_DEV_USER_MANAGEMENT
            - name: VITE_OPERATIONS_URL
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: config-garantias-env-variable
                  key: VITE_OPERATIONS_URL
            - name: VITE_MASTER_URL
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: config-garantias-env-variable
                  key: VITE_MASTER_URL
            - name: VITE_GUARANTEES_SOCKETS_URL
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: config-garantias-env-variable
                  key: VITE_GUARANTEES_SOCKETS_URL
            - name: VITE_WEBSOCKET_NOTIFICATIONS
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: config-garantias-env-variable
                  key: VITE_WEBSOCKET_NOTIFICATIONS
          ports:
            - containerPort: 5007
          volumeMounts:
            - name: config-volume
              mountPath: /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
              subPath: default.conf
          #   - name: apisix-cert-volume
          #     mountPath: /etc/ssl/certs/apisix.crt
          #     subPath: apisix.crt
          # command:
          #   - sh
          #   - -c
          #   - |
          #     # Crear el directorio para los certificados si no existe
          #     mkdir -p /etc/ssl/certs && \
          #     # Crear el archivo ca-certificates.crt si no existe
          #     touch /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && \
          #     # Copiar el contenido existente de ca-certificates.crt a un archivo temporal
          #     cp /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt /tmp/ca-certificates.crt.bak && \
          #     # Añadir el contenido de apisix.crt al archivo temporal
          #     cat /etc/ssl/certs/apisix.crt >> /tmp/ca-certificates.crt.bak && \
          #     # Copiar el archivo temporal de vuelta a ca-certificates.crt
          #     cp /tmp/ca-certificates.crt.bak /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && \
          #     # Iniciar la aplicación principal
          #     exec nginx -g 'daemon off;'
      volumes:
        - name: config-volume
          configMap:
            name: config-garantias
        # - name: apisix-cert-volume
        #   secret:
        #     secretName: apisix-cert-secret-local-container
      imagePullSecrets:
        - name: harbor-credentials-nubo-front

---
apiVersion: v1

metadata:
  name: garantias-front-service
  namespace: nubo-front
spec:
  selector:
    app: garantias-front-app
  ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 80
      targetPort: 5007
  type: ClusterIP
```

## bases/apps/gestion-usuarios-front/config-gestion-usuarios-front.yml

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: config-gestion-usuarios-front
  namespace: nubo-front
data:
  default.conf: |
    server {
        listen       5002;
        listen  [::]:5002;
        server_name  localhost;

        #access_log  /var/log/nginx/host.access.log  main;

        location / {
            if ($request_method = 'OPTIONS') {
                 add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' '*';
                 add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods' 'GET, POST, OPTIONS, DELETE, PUT, PATCH';
                 add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers' 'Authorization, Content-Type';
                 add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Credentials' 'true';
                  return 204;
            }
            add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' '*';
            add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods' 'GET, POST, OPTIONS, DELETE, PUT, PATCH';
            add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers' 'Authorization, Content-Type';
            add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Credentials' 'true';
            
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            index  index.html index.htm;
        }
        
        location /assets/ {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            types {
                application/javascript js;
                text/css css;
            }
            add_header Cache-Control "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate";
        }

        
        error_page  404              /404.html;

        # redirect server error pages to the static page /50x.html
        #
        error_page   500 502 503 504  /50x.html;
        location = /50x.html {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
        }

        # proxy the PHP scripts to Apache listening on 127.0.0.1:80
        #
        #location ~ \.php$ {
        #    proxy_pass   http://127.0.0.1;
        #}

        # pass the PHP scripts to FastCGI server listening on 127.0.0.1:9000
        #
        #location ~ \.php$ {
        #    root           html;
        #    fastcgi_pass   127.0.0.1:9000;
        #    fastcgi_index  index.php;
        #    fastcgi_param  SCRIPT_FILENAME  /scripts$fastcgi_script_name;
        #    include        fastcgi_params;
        #}

        # deny access to .htaccess files, if Apache's document root
        # concurs with nginx's one
        #
        #location ~ /\.ht {
        #    deny  all;
        #}
    }
```

```yaml
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: gestion-usuarios-front-app
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: gestion-usuarios-front-app-container
          image: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/gestionusuarios-front:0.169.0
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "200m"
              memory: "256Mi"
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
          env:
            - name: VITE_REMOTE_UTILITIES
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: config-gestion-env-variable
                  key: VITE_REMOTE_UTILITIES
            - name: VITE_REMOTE_PARENT
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: config-gestion-env-variable
                  key: VITE_REMOTE_PARENT
            - name: VITE_DEV_USER_MANAGEMENT
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: config-gestion-env-variable
                  key: VITE_DEV_USER_MANAGEMENT
            - name: VITE_DEV_MASTER_PARTICIPANT
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: config-gestion-env-variable
                  key: VITE_DEV_MASTER_PARTICIPANT
            - name: VITE_MENU_URL
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: config-gestion-env-variable
                  key: VITE_MENU_URL
            - name: VITE_DEV_ENVIRONMENT
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: config-gestion-env-variable
                  key: VITE_DEV_ENVIRONMENT
            - name: VITE_DOMAIN_EMAIL_NUAM
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: config-gestion-env-variable
                  key: VITE_DOMAIN_EMAIL_NUAM
          ports:
            - containerPort: 5002
          volumeMounts:
            - name: config-volume
              mountPath: /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
              subPath: default.conf
            # - name: apisix-cert-volume
            #   mountPath: /etc/ssl/certs/apisix.crt
            #   subPath: apisix.crt
          # command:
          #   - sh
          #   - -c
          #   - |
          #     # Crear el directorio para los certificados si no existe
          #     mkdir -p /etc/ssl/certs && \
          #     # Crear el archivo ca-certificates.crt si no existe
          #     touch /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && \
          #     # Copiar el contenido existente de ca-certificates.crt a un archivo temporal
          #     cp /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt /tmp/ca-certificates.crt.bak && \
          #     # Añadir el contenido de apisix.crt al archivo temporal
          #     cat /etc/ssl/certs/apisix.crt >> /tmp/ca-certificates.crt.bak && \
          #     # Copiar el archivo temporal de vuelta a ca-certificates.crt
          #     cp /tmp/ca-certificates.crt.bak /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && \
          #     # Iniciar la aplicación principal
          #     exec nginx -g 'daemon off;'
      volumes:
        - name: config-volume
          configMap:
            name: config-gestion-usuarios-front
        # - name: apisix-cert-volume
        #   secret:
        #     secretName: apisix-cert-secret-local-container
      imagePullSecrets:
        - name: harbor-credentials-nubo-front
```

## bases/apps/horarios-front/config-horarios.yml

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: config-horarios
  namespace: nubo-front
data:
  default.conf: |
    server {
        listen       5012;
        listen  [::]:5012;
        server_name  localhost;

        #access_log  /var/log/nginx/host.access.log  main;

        location / {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            index  index.html index.htm;
            try_files $uri /index.html;
        }
        
        location /assets/ {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            types {
                application/javascript js;
                text/css css;
            }
            add_header Cache-Control "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate";
        }
        
        error_page  404              /404.html;

        # redirect server error pages to the static page /50x.html
        #
        error_page   500 502 503 504  /50x.html;
        location = /50x.html {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
        }

        # proxy the PHP scripts to Apache listening on 127.0.0.1:80
        #
        #location ~ \.php$ {
        #    proxy_pass   http://127.0.0.1;
        #}

        # pass the PHP scripts to FastCGI server listening on 127.0.0.1:9000
        #
        #location ~ \.php$ {
        #    root           html;
        #    fastcgi_pass   127.0.0.1:9000;
        #    fastcgi_index  index.php;
        #    fastcgi_param  SCRIPT_FILENAME  /scripts$fastcgi_script_name;
        #    include        fastcgi_params;
        #}

        # deny access to .htaccess files, if Apache's document root
        # concurs with nginx's one
        #
        #location ~ /\.ht {
        #    deny  all;
        #}
    }
```

## bases/apps/horarios-front/deploy-react-app.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: horarios-app
  namespace: nubo-front
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: horarios-front-app
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: horarios-front-app
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: horarios-front-app-container
          image: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/horarios-front:0.12.0
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "200m" # New 20250621
              memory: "256Mi"
            limits: # New 20250621
              cpu: "500m" # New 20250621
              memory: "512Mi"     
          env:
          - name: VITE_REMOTE_PARENT
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-horarios-env-variable
                key: VITE_REMOTE_PARENT
          - name: VITE_REMOTE_UTILITIES
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-horarios-env-variable
                key: VITE_REMOTE_UTILITIES
          ports:
            - containerPort: 5012
          volumeMounts:
            - name: config-volume
              mountPath: /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
              subPath: default.conf
          #   - name: apisix-cert-volume
          #     mountPath: /etc/ssl/certs/apisix.crt
          #     subPath: apisix.crt
          # command:
          #   - sh
          #   - -c
          #   - |
          #     # Crear el directorio para los certificados si no existe
          #     mkdir -p /etc/ssl/certs && \
          #     # Crear el archivo ca-certificates.crt si no existe
          #     touch /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && \
          #     # Copiar el contenido existente de ca-certificates.crt a un archivo temporal
          #     cp /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt /tmp/ca-certificates.crt.bak && \
          #     # Añadir el contenido de apisix.crt al archivo temporal
          #     cat /etc/ssl/certs/apisix.crt >> /tmp/ca-certificates.crt.bak && \
          #     # Copiar el archivo temporal de vuelta a ca-certificates.crt
          #     cp /tmp/ca-certificates.crt.bak /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && \
          #     # Iniciar la aplicación principal
          #     exec nginx -g 'daemon off;'
      volumes:
        - name: config-volume
          configMap:
            name: config-horarios
        # - name: apisix-cert-volume
        #   secret:
        #     secretName: apisix-cert-secret-local-container
      imagePullSecrets:
        - name: harbor-credentials-nubo-front
```

```yaml
            - name: DB_HIKARI_VALIDATION_TIMEOUT

            - name: DB_HIKARI_LEAK_DETECTION_THRESHOLD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
```
```yaml
                  name: nubo-back-secret-kafka

                secretKeyRef:
```

## bases/apps/maestro-participante-front/config-maestro-participante.yml

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: config-maestro-participante
  namespace: nubo-front
data:
  default.conf: |
    server {
        listen       5010;
        listen  [::]:5010;
        server_name  localhost;

        #access_log  /var/log/nginx/host.access.log  main;

        location / {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            index  index.html index.htm;
            try_files $uri /index.html;
        }
        
        location /assets/ {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            types {
                application/javascript js;
                text/css css;
            }
            add_header Cache-Control "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate";
        }
        
        error_page  404              /404.html;

        # redirect server error pages to the static page /50x.html
        #
        error_page   500 502 503 504  /50x.html;
        location = /50x.html {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
        }

        # proxy the PHP scripts to Apache listening on 127.0.0.1:80
        #
        #location ~ \.php$ {
        #    proxy_pass   http://127.0.0.1;
        #}

        # pass the PHP scripts to FastCGI server listening on 127.0.0.1:9000
        #
        #location ~ \.php$ {
        #    root           html;
        #    fastcgi_pass   127.0.0.1:9000;
        #    fastcgi_index  index.php;
        #    fastcgi_param  SCRIPT_FILENAME  /scripts$fastcgi_script_name;
        #    include        fastcgi_params;
        #}

        # deny access to .htaccess files, if Apache's document root
        # concurs with nginx's one
        #
        #location ~ /\.ht {
        #    deny  all;
        #}
    }
```

## bases/apps/maestro-participante-front/deploy-react-app.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: maestro-participante-app
  namespace: nubo-front
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: maestro-participante-front-app
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: maestro-participante-front-app
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: maestro-participante-front-app-container
          image: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/maestroparticipante-front:0.14.0
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "200m" # New 20250621
              memory: "256Mi"
            limits: # New 20250621
              cpu: "500m" # New 20250621
              memory: "512Mi"     
          env:
          - name: VITE_REMOTE_PARENT
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-maestro-participante-env-variable
                key: VITE_REMOTE_PARENT
          - name: VITE_REMOTE_UTILITIES
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-maestro-participante-env-variable
                key: VITE_REMOTE_UTILITIES
          ports:
            - containerPort: 5010
          volumeMounts:
            - name: config-volume
              mountPath: /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
              subPath: default.conf
          #   - name: apisix-cert-volume
          #     mountPath: /etc/ssl/certs/apisix.crt
          #     subPath: apisix.crt
          # command:
          #   - sh
          #   - -c
          #   - |
          #     # Crear el directorio para los certificados si no existe
          #     mkdir -p /etc/ssl/certs && \
          #     # Crear el archivo ca-certificates.crt si no existe
          #     touch /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && \
          #     # Copiar el contenido existente de ca-certificates.crt a un archivo temporal
          #     cp /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt /tmp/ca-certificates.crt.bak && \
          #     # Añadir el contenido de apisix.crt al archivo temporal
          #     cat /etc/ssl/certs/apisix.crt >> /tmp/ca-certificates.crt.bak && \
          #     # Copiar el archivo temporal de vuelta a ca-certificates.crt
          #     cp /tmp/ca-certificates.crt.bak /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && \
          #     # Iniciar la aplicación principal
          #     exec nginx -g 'daemon off;'
      volumes:
        - name: config-volume
          configMap:
            name: config-maestro-participante
        # - name: apisix-cert-volume
        #   secret:
        #     secretName: apisix-cert-secret-local-container
      imagePullSecrets:
        - name: harbor-credentials-nubo-front
```

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
```

## bases/apps/opcionesmenu-back/deploy-java-app.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: opcionesmenu-back-app
  namespace: nubo-back
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: opcionesmenu-back
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: opcionesmenu-back
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        fsGroup: 10001
        automountServiceAccountToken: false
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: opcionesmenu-back-app-container
          image: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/opcionesmenu-back:0.1.0
          imagePullPolicy: Always
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false  
            runAsNonRoot: true               
            runAsUser: 10001
            seccompProfile:
              type: RuntimeDefault               
            #readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "200m" 
              memory: "256Mi"
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
          env:
            - name: DB_USERNAME
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret
                  key: DB_USERNAME
            - name: DB_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret
                  key: DB_PASSWORD
            - name: DB_URL
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret
                  key: DB_URL
            - name: DB_HIKARI_MAXIMUM_POOL_SIZE
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret
                  key: DB_HIKARI_MAXIMUM_POOL_SIZE
            - name: DB_HIKARI_MINIMUM_IDLE
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret
                  key: DB_HIKARI_MINIMUM_IDLE
            - name: DB_HIKARI_IDLE_TIMEOUT
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret
                  key: DB_HIKARI_IDLE_TIMEOUT
            - name: DB_HIKARI_VALIDATION_TIMEOUT
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret
                  key: DB_HIKARI_VALIDATION_TIMEOUT
            - name: DB_HIKARI_LEAK_DETECTION_THRESHOLD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret
                  key: DB_HIKARI_LEAK_DETECTION_THRESHOLD
            - name: DB_HIKARI_MAX_LIFETIME
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret
                  key: DB_HIKARI_MAX_LIFETIME
            - name: DB_HIKARI_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret
                  key: DB_HIKARI_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT
            - name: SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret
                  key: SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
      imagePullSecrets:
        - name: harbor-credentials-nubo-back

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: opcionesmenu-service
  namespace: nubo-back
spec:
  selector:
    app: opcionesmenu-back
  ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 80
      targetPort: 8080
  type: ClusterIP

```

## bases/apps/opcionesmenu-front/config-opcionesmenu-front.yml

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: config-opcionesmenu-front
  namespace: nubo-front
data:
  default.conf: |
    server {
        listen       5004;
        listen  [::]:5004;
        server_name  localhost;

        #access_log  /var/log/nginx/host.access.log  main;

        location / {
            if ($request_method = 'OPTIONS') {
                 add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' '*';
                 add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods' 'GET, POST, OPTIONS, DELETE, PUT, PATCH';
                 add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers' 'Authorization, Content-Type';
                 add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Credentials' 'true';
                  return 204;
            }
            add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' '*';
            add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods' 'GET, POST, OPTIONS, DELETE, PUT, PATCH';
            add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers' 'Authorization, Content-Type';
            add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Credentials' 'true';
            
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            index  index.html index.htm;
        }
        
        location /assets/ {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            types {
                application/javascript js;
                text/css css;
            }
            add_header Cache-Control "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate";
        }

        
        error_page  404              /404.html;

        # redirect server error pages to the static page /50x.html
        #
        error_page   500 502 503 504  /50x.html;
        location = /50x.html {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
        }

        # proxy the PHP scripts to Apache listening on 127.0.0.1:80
        #
        #location ~ \.php$ {
        #    proxy_pass   http://127.0.0.1;
        #}

        # pass the PHP scripts to FastCGI server listening on 127.0.0.1:9000
        #
        #location ~ \.php$ {
        #    root           html;
        #    fastcgi_pass   127.0.0.1:9000;
        #    fastcgi_index  index.php;
        #    fastcgi_param  SCRIPT_FILENAME  /scripts$fastcgi_script_name;
        #    include        fastcgi_params;
        #}

        # deny access to .htaccess files, if Apache's document root
        # concurs with nginx's one
        #
        #location ~ /\.ht {
        #    deny  all;
        #}
    }
```

```yaml
                name: config-opmenu-env-variable
                key: VITE_REMOTE_UTILITIES

          ports:

      imagePullSecrets:
```

## bases/apps/operaciones-espec-front/config-operaciones-espec.yml

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: config-operaciones-espec
  namespace: nubo-front
data:
  default.conf: |
    server {
        listen       5006;
        listen  [::]:5006;
        server_name  localhost;

        #access_log  /var/log/nginx/host.access.log  main;

        location / {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            index  index.html index.htm;
        }
        
        location /assets/ {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            types {
                application/javascript js;
                text/css css;
            }
            add_header Cache-Control "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate";
        }
        
        error_page  404              /404.html;

        # redirect server error pages to the static page /50x.html
        #
        error_page   500 502 503 504  /50x.html;
        location = /50x.html {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
        }

        # proxy the PHP scripts to Apache listening on 127.0.0.1:80
        #
        #location ~ \.php$ {
        #    proxy_pass   http://127.0.0.1;
        #}

        # pass the PHP scripts to FastCGI server listening on 127.0.0.1:9000
        #
        #location ~ \.php$ {
        #    root           html;
        #    fastcgi_pass   127.0.0.1:9000;
        #    fastcgi_index  index.php;
        #    fastcgi_param  SCRIPT_FILENAME  /scripts$fastcgi_script_name;
        #    include        fastcgi_params;
        #}

        # deny access to .htaccess files, if Apache's document root
        # concurs with nginx's one
        #
        #location ~ /\.ht {
        #    deny  all;
        #}
    }
```

## bases/apps/operaciones-espec-front/deploy-react-app.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: operaciones-espec-front-app
  namespace: nubo-front
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: operaciones-espec-front-app
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: operaciones-espec-front-app
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: operaciones-espec-front-app-container
        image: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/operaciones-espec-front:0.83.0
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: "200m"
            memory: "256Mi"
          limits:
            cpu: "500m"
            memory: "512Mi"
        env:
          - name: VITE_REMOTE_PARENT
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-operaciones-espec-env-variable
                key: VITE_REMOTE_PARENT
          - name: VITE_REMOTE_UTILITIES
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-operaciones-espec-env-variable
                key: VITE_REMOTE_UTILITIES
          - name: VITE_DEV_USER_MANAGEMENT
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-operaciones-espec-env-variable
                key: VITE_DEV_USER_MANAGEMENT
          - name: VITE_OPERATIONS_URL
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-operaciones-espec-env-variable
                key: VITE_OPERATIONS_URL
          - name: VITE_MASTER_URL
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-operaciones-espec-env-variable
                key: VITE_MASTER_URL
          - name: VITE_SPECIAL_OPERATION_API_URL
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-operaciones-espec-env-variable
                key: VITE_SPECIAL_OPERATION_API_URL
          - name: VITE_PAYMENTANDCOLLECTIONS_API_URL
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-operaciones-espec-env-variable
                key: VITE_PAYMENTANDCOLLECTIONS_API_URL
          - name: VITE_SPECIAL_OPERATION_SOCKETS_URL
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-operaciones-espec-env-variable
                key: VITE_SPECIAL_OPERATION_SOCKETS_URL
          - name: VITE_CLOSE_API_URL
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-operaciones-espec-env-variable
                key: VITE_CLOSE_API_URL
          - name: VITE_SETTLEMENT_BANK_TRANSACTION_SOCKET
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-operaciones-espec-env-variable
                key: VITE_SETTLEMENT_BANK_TRANSACTION_SOCKET
        ports:
        - containerPort: 5006
        volumeMounts:
            - name: config-volume
              mountPath: /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
              subPath: default.conf
          #   - name: apisix-cert-volume
          #     mountPath: /etc/ssl/certs/apisix.crt
          #     subPath: apisix.crt
          # command:
          #   - sh
          #   - -c
          #   - |
          #     # Crear el directorio para los certificados si no existe
          #     mkdir -p /etc/ssl/certs && \
          #     # Crear el archivo ca-certificates.crt si no existe
          #     touch /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && \
          #     # Copiar el contenido existente de ca-certificates.crt a un archivo temporal
          #     cp /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt /tmp/ca-certificates.crt.bak && \
          #     # Añadir el contenido de apisix.crt al archivo temporal
          #     cat /etc/ssl/certs/apisix.crt >> /tmp/ca-certificates.crt.bak && \
          #     # Copiar el archivo temporal de vuelta a ca-certificates.crt
          #     cp /tmp/ca-certificates.crt.bak /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && \
          #     # Iniciar la aplicación principal
          #     exec nginx -g 'daemon off;'
      volumes:
        - name: config-volume
          configMap:
            name: config-operaciones-espec
        # - name: apisix-cert-volume
        #   secret:
        #     secretName: apisix-cert-secret-local-container
      imagePullSecrets:
        - name: harbor-credentials-nubo-front

---

    - protocol: TCP
      port: 80
      targetPort: 5006
  type: ClusterIP
```

## bases/apps/operaciones-front/config-operaciones.yml

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: config-operaciones
  namespace: nubo-front
data:
  default.conf: |
    server {
        listen       5006;
        listen  [::]:5006;
        server_name  localhost;

        #access_log  /var/log/nginx/host.access.log  main;

        location / {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            index  index.html index.htm;
        }
        
        location /assets/ {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            types {
                application/javascript js;
                text/css css;
            }
            add_header Cache-Control "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate";
        }
        
        error_page  404              /404.html;

        # redirect server error pages to the static page /50x.html
        #
        error_page   500 502 503 504  /50x.html;
        location = /50x.html {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
        }

        # proxy the PHP scripts to Apache listening on 127.0.0.1:80
        #
        #location ~ \.php$ {
        #    proxy_pass   http://127.0.0.1;
        #}

        # pass the PHP scripts to FastCGI server listening on 127.0.0.1:9000
        #
        #location ~ \.php$ {
        #    root           html;
        #    fastcgi_pass   127.0.0.1:9000;
        #    fastcgi_index  index.php;
        #    fastcgi_param  SCRIPT_FILENAME  /scripts$fastcgi_script_name;
        #    include        fastcgi_params;
        #}

        # deny access to .htaccess files, if Apache's document root
        # concurs with nginx's one
        #
        #location ~ /\.ht {
        #    deny  all;
        #}
    }
```

## bases/apps/operaciones-front/deploy-react-app.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: operaciones-front-app
  namespace: nubo-front
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: operaciones-front-app
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: operaciones-front-app
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: operaciones-front-app-container
          image: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/operaciones-front:0.220.0
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "200m"
              memory: "256Mi"
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
          env:
          - name: VITE_REMOTE_PARENT
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-operaciones-env-variable
                key: VITE_REMOTE_PARENT
          - name: VITE_REMOTE_UTILITIES
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-operaciones-env-variable
                key: VITE_REMOTE_UTILITIES
          - name: VITE_DEV_USER_MANAGEMENT
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-operaciones-env-variable
                key: VITE_DEV_USER_MANAGEMENT
          - name: VITE_OPERATIONS_URL
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-operaciones-env-variable
                key: VITE_OPERATIONS_URL
          - name: VITE_MASTER_URL
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-operaciones-env-variable
                key: VITE_MASTER_URL
          - name: VITE_ID_MASTER_ACCOUNT
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-operaciones-env-variable
                key: VITE_ID_MASTER_ACCOUNT
          ports:
            - containerPort: 5006
          volumeMounts:
            - name: config-volume
              mountPath: /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
              subPath: default.conf
          #   - name: apisix-cert-volume
          #     mountPath: /etc/ssl/certs/apisix.crt
          #     subPath: apisix.crt
          # command:
          #   - sh
          #   - -c
          #   - |
          #     # Crear el directorio para los certificados si no existe
          #     mkdir -p /etc/ssl/certs && \
          #     # Crear el archivo ca-certificates.crt si no existe
          #     touch /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && \
          #     # Copiar el contenido existente de ca-certificates.crt a un archivo temporal
          #     cp /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt /tmp/ca-certificates.crt.bak && \
          #     # Añadir el contenido de apisix.crt al archivo temporal
          #     cat /etc/ssl/certs/apisix.crt >> /tmp/ca-certificates.crt.bak && \
          #     # Copiar el archivo temporal de vuelta a ca-certificates.crt
          #     cp /tmp/ca-certificates.crt.bak /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && \
          #     # Iniciar la aplicación principal
          #     exec nginx -g 'daemon off;'
      volumes:
        - name: config-volume
          configMap:
            name: config-operaciones
        # - name: apisix-cert-volume
        #   secret:
        #     secretName: apisix-cert-secret-local-container
      imagePullSecrets:
        - name: harbor-credentials-nubo-front
```

## bases/apps/operaciones-query-back/deploy-java-app.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: operaciones-query-back-app
  namespace: nubo-back
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: operaciones-query-back
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: operaciones-query-back
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        fsGroup: 10001
        automountServiceAccountToken: false
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: operaciones-query-back-app-container
          image: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/operaciones-query-back:0.1.0
          imagePullPolicy: Always
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 10001
            seccompProfile:
              type: RuntimeDefault
            #readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "300m"
              memory: "768Mi"
            limits:
              cpu: "800m"
              memory: "1.5Gi"
          env:
            - name: DB_USERNAME
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
```

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: operaciones-rf-envio-regional-back-app
  namespace: nubo-back-integracion
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: operaciones-rf-envio-regional-back
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: operaciones-rf-envio-regional-back
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        fsGroup: 10001
        automountServiceAccountToken: false
      containers:
        - name: operaciones-rf-envio-regional-back-app-container
          image: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/rf-envio-regional-back:0.2.0-alpha.1
          imagePullPolicy: Always
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "200m" # New 20250621
              memory: "256Mi"
            limits: # New 20250621
              cpu: "500m" # New 20250621
              memory: "512Mi"
          env:
            - name: SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret-kafka
                  key: SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE
            - name: INTERNAL_KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret-kafka
                  key: KAFKA_NUBO_BOOTSTRAP_SERVER
            - name: INTERNAL_KAFKA_SECURITY_PROTOCOL
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret-kafka
                  key: KAFKA_PROPERTIES_SECURITY_PROTOCOL
            - name: INTERNAL_KAFKA_SASL_MECHANISM
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret-kafka
                  key: KAFKA_PROPERTIES_SASL_MECHANISM
            - name: INTERNAL_KAFKA_SASL_JAAS_CONFIG
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret-kafka
                  key: KAFKA_PROPERTIES_SASL_JAAS_CONFIG
            - name: INTERNAL_KAFKA_CONSUMER_ENABLED
              value: "true"
            - name: INTERNAL_KAFKA_CONSUMER_TOPIC
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret-kafka
                  key: KAFKA_NUBO_TOPIC_NAME_SEND_SETTLEMENT_INSTRUCTION
            - name: KAFKA_NUBO_INTERNO_GROUP_ID
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret-kafka
                  key: KAFKA_NUBO_GROUP_ID
            - name: INTERNAL_KAFKA_DLQ_TOPIC
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret-kafka
                  key: KAFKA_NUBO_TOPIC_DTL
            - name: REGIONAL_KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret-kafka
                  key: KAFKA_REGIONAL_BOOTSTRAP_SERVER
            - name: REGIONAL_KAFKA_PRODUCER_TOPIC
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret-kafka
                  key: KAFKA_REGIONAL_TOPIC_INSTRUCTION_SIIDJ
            - name: REGIONAL_KAFKA_SSL_TRUSTSTORE_LOCATION
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret-kafka
                  key: SSL_TRUSTSTORE_LOCATION
            - name: REGIONAL_KAFKA_SSL_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret-kafka
                  key: SSL_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD
            - name: REGIONAL_KAFKA_SSL_KEYSTORE_LOCATION
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret-kafka
                  key: SSL_KEYSTORE_LOCATION
            - name: REGIONAL_KAFKA_SSL_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret-kafka
                  key: SSL_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
          volumeMounts:
            - name: kafka-certificates
              mountPath: /app/certificates
      volumes:
        - name: kafka-certificates
          configMap:
            name: kafka-certificates
      imagePullSecrets:
        - name: harbor-credentials-nubo-back-integracion
---
```

## bases/apps/operaciones-rf-front/config-operaciones-rf.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: config-operaciones-rf
  namespace: nubo-front
data:
  default.conf: |
    server {
        listen       5013;
        listen  [::]:5013;
        server_name  localhost;

        #access_log  /var/log/nginx/host.access.log  main;

        location / {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            index  index.html index.htm;
        }
        
        location /assets/ {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            types {
                application/javascript js;
                text/css css;
            }
            add_header Cache-Control "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate";
        }
        
        error_page  404              /404.html;

        # redirect server error pages to the static page /50x.html
        #
        error_page   500 502 503 504  /50x.html;
        location = /50x.html {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
        }

        # proxy the PHP scripts to Apache listening on 127.0.0.1:80
        #
        #location ~ \.php$ {
        #    proxy_pass   http://127.0.0.1;
        #}

        # pass the PHP scripts to FastCGI server listening on 127.0.0.1:9000
        #
        #location ~ \.php$ {
        #    root           html;
        #    fastcgi_pass   127.0.0.1:9000;
        #    fastcgi_index  index.php;
        #    fastcgi_param  SCRIPT_FILENAME  /scripts$fastcgi_script_name;
        #    include        fastcgi_params;
        #}

        # deny access to .htaccess files, if Apache's document root
        # concurs with nginx's one
        #
        #location ~ /\.ht {
        #    deny  all;
        #}
    }
```

## bases/apps/operaciones-rf-front/deploy-react-app.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: operaciones-rf-front-app
  namespace: nubo-front
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: operaciones-rf-front-app
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: operaciones-rf-front-app
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: operaciones-rf-front-app-container
          image: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/operaciones-rf-front:0.2.0-alpha.1
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "200m"
              memory: "256Mi"
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
          env:
          - name: VITE_REMOTE_PARENT
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-operaciones-rf-env-variable
                key: VITE_REMOTE_PARENT
          - name: VITE_REMOTE_UTILITIES
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-operaciones-rf-env-variable
                key: VITE_REMOTE_UTILITIES
          - name: VITE_DEV_USER_MANAGEMENT
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-operaciones-rf-env-variable
                key: VITE_DEV_USER_MANAGEMENT
          ports:
            - containerPort: 5013
          volumeMounts:
            - name: config-volume
              mountPath: /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
              subPath: default.conf
          #   - name: apisix-cert-volume
          #     mountPath: /etc/ssl/certs/apisix.crt
          #     subPath: apisix.crt
          # command:
          #   - sh
          #   - -c
          #   - |
          #     # Crear el directorio para los certificados si no existe
          #     mkdir -p /etc/ssl/certs && \
          #     # Crear el archivo ca-certificates.crt si no existe
          #     touch /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && \
          #     # Copiar el contenido existente de ca-certificates.crt a un archivo temporal
          #     cp /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt /tmp/ca-certificates.crt.bak && \
          #     # Añadir el contenido de apisix.crt al archivo temporal
          #     cat /etc/ssl/certs/apisix.crt >> /tmp/ca-certificates.crt.bak && \
          #     # Copiar el archivo temporal de vuelta a ca-certificates.crt
          #     cp /tmp/ca-certificates.crt.bak /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && \
          #     # Iniciar la aplicación principal
          #     exec nginx -g 'daemon off;'
      volumes:
        - name: config-volume
          configMap:
            name: config-operaciones-rf
        # - name: apisix-cert-volume
        #   secret:
        #     secretName: apisix-cert-secret-local-container
      imagePullSecrets:
        - name: harbor-credentials-nubo-front

---

  namespace: nubo-front

  selector:
    app: operaciones-rf-front-app

    - protocol: TCP
      port: 80
      targetPort: 5013
  type: ClusterIP
```

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
```

```yaml
    app.kubernetes.io/name: comprobantes-prestamos-generacion-back

                  key: SFTP_PROTOCOL
            - name: FTP_HOST

                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: config-comprobantes-prestamos-generacion-back
                  key: SFTP_DECEVAL_HOST

                  name: config-comprobantes-prestamos-generacion-back
                  key: FTP_REDELIVERY_DELAY_MS                                            
            ## KAFKA                              
            - name: KAFKA_NUBO_RETRIES

                  key: KAFKA_NUBO_AUTO_OFFSET_RESET
            - name: KAFKA_PROPERTIES_SECURITY_PROTOCOL
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret
                  key: KAFKA_PROPERTIES_SECURITY_PROTOCOL
            - name: KAFKA_PROPERTIES_SASL_MECHANISM

                  key: KAFKA_NUBO_TOPIC_NAME_OTCLOAN_SETTLEMENT_FILE

              valueFrom:

                  key: KAFKA_NUBO_NOTIFICATION_REQUEST_TOPIC                                                                  
            - name: SPRING_PORT
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:

                  key: SPRING_PORT 
            ## BLOCKCHAIN
            - name: NUBO_URL_BLOCKCHAIN_LOANS_URL
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: config-comprobantes-prestamos-generacion-back
                  key: NUBO_URL_BLOCKCHAIN_LOANS_URL  
            - name: NUBO_URL_BLOCKCHAIN_LOANS_PATH
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: config-comprobantes-prestamos-generacion-back
                  key: NUBO_URL_BLOCKCHAIN_LOANS_PATH

                  key: NUBO_URL_BLOCKCHAIN_LOANS_FIRST_PAGE 
            - name: NUBO_URL_BLOCKCHAIN_LOANS_SIZE
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: config-comprobantes-prestamos-generacion-back

          ports:

      imagePullSecrets:
```
