## bases/apps/otcloan-fake-smtp-server/deploy_fake-smtp-server.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: fake-smtp-server
  namespace: nubo-back
  labels:
    app: fake-smtp-server
    app.kubernetes.io/name: fake-smtp-server
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: otcloan
    app.kubernetes.io/component: mock
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: fake-smtp-server
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: fake-smtp-server
        app.kubernetes.io/name: fake-smtp-server
        app.kubernetes.io/part-of: otcloan
        app.kubernetes.io/component: mock         
    spec:
      imagePullSecrets:
        - name: harbor-credentials-nubo
      containers:
        - name: fake-smtp-server
          image: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/axllent/mailpit:latest
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          args:
            - --pop3
            - "[::]:1110"
            - --pop3-auth-file
            - "/etc/mailpit/pop3-auth"
          env:
            - name: MP_SMTP_AUTH_ACCEPT_ANY
              value: "true"
            - name: MP_SMTP_AUTH_ALLOW_INSECURE
              value: "true"
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 512Mi
          volumeMounts:
            - name: pop3-auth
              mountPath: /etc/mailpit
              readOnly: true
          ports:
            - name: smtp
              containerPort: 1025
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8025
            - name: pop3
              containerPort: 1110
      volumes:
        - name: pop3-auth
          configMap:
            name: fake-smtp-pop3-auth
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: fake-smtp-server
  namespace: nubo-back
  labels:
    app: fake-smtp-server
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: fake-smtp-server
  ports:
    - name: smtp
      port: 1025
      targetPort: smtp
      protocol: TCP
    - name: http
      port: 8025
      targetPort: http
      protocol: TCP
    - name: pop3
      port: 1110
      targetPort: pop3
      protocol: TCP
```

## bases/apps/otcloan-jasper-service/deploy-java-app.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: jasper-service-app
  namespace: nubo-back
  labels:
    app: jasper-service
    app.kubernetes.io/name: jasper-service
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: otcloan
    app.kubernetes.io/component: backend  
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: jasper-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: jasper-service
        app.kubernetes.io/name: jasper-service
        app.kubernetes.io/part-of: otcloan
        app.kubernetes.io/component: backend          
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: jasper-service-app-container
          image: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/jasper-service:0.1.0
          imagePullPolicy: Always
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "200m"
              memory: "256Mi"
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
          env:
            - name: JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS
              value: "-Djava.awt.headless=true"
            - name: SERVER_PORT
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: config-jasper-service
                  key: SERVER_PORT
            - name: GRPC_SERVER_PORT
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: config-jasper-service
                  key: GRPC_SERVER_PORT
          ports:
            - containerPort: 9081
            - containerPort: 8082
      imagePullSecrets:
        - name: harbor-credentials-nubo-back

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: jasper-service-service
  namespace: nubo-back
spec:
  selector:
    app: jasper-service
  ports:
    - name: http
      protocol: TCP
      port: 80
      targetPort: 9081
    - name: grpc
      protocol: TCP
      port: 81
      targetPort: 8082

```

## bases/apps/otcloan-loan-mock-back-relay-01/configmap-loan-mock-back-relay-01.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
    name: config-loan-mock-back-relay-01-env
    namespace: nubo-back-integracion
data:
    DB_QUERY_DELAY_MICROSECONDS: "1000"
    RELAY_HTTP_ADDRESS: ":8000"
    RELAY_LOG_LEVEL: "info"
    RELAY_LOG_FORMAT: "json"
    RELAY_ROUTE_ID: "loan-mock-back-relay-01" 
    RELAY_WORKERS: "4"
    RELAY_RETRY_MAX: "8"
    RELAY_RETRY_BACKOFF: "2s"
    RELAY_POLL_INTERVAL: "250ms"
    RELAY_LEASE_DURATION: "30s"
    RELAY_SOURCE_TOPIC: "kafka-nubo-otcloan-instruction-co-producer"
    RELAY_SOURCE_GROUP_ID: "nubo-back-core"
    RELAY_SOURCE_PROTOCOL: "PLAINTEXT"
    RELAY_SOURCE_TLS_ENABLED: "false"
    RELAY_SOURCE_TLS_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY: "true"
    RELAY_SOURCE_SASL_ENABLED: "true"
    RELAY_DESTINATION_BROKERS: "kafka-bootstrap-bin-ti-qa-postneg.nuamx.com:443"
    RELAY_DESTINATION_TOPIC: "nuam-nbo-png.raw.nubo.instruction-co.protobuf"
    RELAY_DESTINATION_GROUP_ID: ""
    RELAY_DESTINATION_PROTOCOL: "PLAINTEXT"
    RELAY_DESTINATION_TLS_CA_FILE: "/mnt/certs/cluster-cert.pem"
    RELAY_DESTINATION_TLS_CERT_FILE: "/mnt/certs/nuam-nbo-png-user.consumer.pem"
    RELAY_DESTINATION_TLS_KEY_FILE: "/mnt/certs/nuam-nbo-png-user.consumer.key"
    RELAY_DESTINATION_TLS_ENABLED: "true"
    RELAY_DESTINATION_TLS_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY: "false" 
    RELAY_DESTINATION_SASL_ENABLED: "false"
    RELAY_DLQ_TOPIC: "destination.topic.DLQ"

```

    namespace: nubo-back
data:
    SERVICE_HOST: 0.0.0.0
    SERVICE_PORT: "8000"
    MS_AUDIT_LOGS_HOST: nbo-png-audit-log-service
    MS_AUDIT_LOGS_PORT: "80"

    RETRIES: "5"

    KAFKA_CLIENT_ID: "loan-guarantee-daemon"
    KAFKA_PRODUCER_TOPIC: "kafka-nubo-otcloan-trades-to-guarantees"
    KAFKA_PRODUCER_ACKS: "1"
    KAFKA_PRODUCER_RETRIES: "5"
    KAFKA_PRODUCER_BATCH_SIZE: "16384"
    KAFKA_PRODUCER_LINGER_MS: "5"
    KAFKA_PRODUCER_BUFFER_MEMORY: "33554432"
    KAFKA_PRODUCER_COMPRESSION: "snappy"
    KAFKA_PRODUCER_MAX_MESSAGE_BYTES: "1000000"
    KAFKA_TLS_ENABLED: "false"
    KAFKA_TLS_CA_FILE: ""
    KAFKA_TLS_CERT_FILE: ""
    KAFKA_TLS_KEY_FILE: ""
    KAFKA_TLS_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY: "false"
    KAFKA_CONSUMER_TOPIC:  kafka-nubo-otcloan-confirm-trade-guaranteed
    KAFKA_CONSUMER_GROUP_ID: nubo-back-core
    KAFKA_CONSUMER_AUTO_OFFSET_RESET: earliest
    LOAN_BACK_HOST: nbo-png-loan-back-service
    LOAN_BACK_PORT: "80"
    KAFKA_CONSUMER_ENABLED: "true"

## bases/apps/otcloan-operaciones-prestamos-mfe/config-operaciones-prestamos.yml

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: config-operaciones-prestamos
  namespace: nubo-front
data:
  default.conf: |
    server {
        listen       5011;
        listen  [::]:5011;
        server_name  localhost;

        #access_log  /var/log/nginx/host.access.log  main;

        location / {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            index  index.html index.htm;
            try_files $uri /index.html;
        }
        
        location /assets/ {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            types {
                application/javascript js;
                text/css css;
            }
            add_header Cache-Control "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate";
        }
        
        error_page  404              /404.html;

        # redirect server error pages to the static page /50x.html
        #
        error_page   500 502 503 504  /50x.html;
        location = /50x.html {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
        }

        # proxy the PHP scripts to Apache listening on 127.0.0.1:80
        #
        #location ~ \.php$ {
        #    proxy_pass   http://127.0.0.1;
        #}

        # pass the PHP scripts to FastCGI server listening on 127.0.0.1:9000
        #
        #location ~ \.php$ {
        #    root           html;
        #    fastcgi_pass   127.0.0.1:9000;
        #    fastcgi_index  index.php;
        #    fastcgi_param  SCRIPT_FILENAME  /scripts$fastcgi_script_name;
        #    include        fastcgi_params;
        #}

        # deny access to .htaccess files, if Apache's document root
        # concurs with nginx's one
        #
        #location ~ /\.ht {
        #    deny  all;
        #}
    }
```

## bases/apps/otcloan-operaciones-prestamos-mfe/deploy-react-app.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: operaciones-prestamos-mfe-app
  namespace: nubo-front
  labels:
    app: operaciones-prestamos-mfe-app
    app.kubernetes.io/name: operaciones-prestamos-mfe-app
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: otcloan
    app.kubernetes.io/component: frontend  
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: operaciones-prestamos-mfe-app
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: operaciones-prestamos-mfe-app
        app.kubernetes.io/name: operaciones-prestamos-mfe-app
        app.kubernetes.io/part-of: otcloan
        app.kubernetes.io/component: frontend        
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: operaciones-prestamos-mfe-app-container
          image: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/nbo-png-operaciones-prestamos-mfe:0.1.0
          env:
          - name: VITE_REMOTE_PARENT
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-operaciones-prestamos-env-variable
                key: VITE_REMOTE_PARENT
          - name: VITE_REMOTE_UTILITIES
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-operaciones-prestamos-env-variable
                key: VITE_REMOTE_UTILITIES
          - name: VITE_REMOTE_STOCK_SHOWCASE_MANAGEMENT
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-operaciones-prestamos-env-variable
                key: VITE_REMOTE_STOCK_SHOWCASE_MANAGEMENT
          - name: VITE_REMOTE_LOAN_OPERATIONS_MANAGEMENT
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-operaciones-prestamos-env-variable
                key: VITE_REMOTE_LOAN_OPERATIONS_MANAGEMENT
          - name: VITE_MSA_MANAGEMENT_BFF_API
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-operaciones-prestamos-env-variable
                key: VITE_MSA_MANAGEMENT_BFF_API
          ports:
            - containerPort: 5011
          volumeMounts:
            - name: config-volume
              mountPath: /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
              subPath: default.conf
          #   - name: apisix-cert-volume
          #     mountPath: /etc/ssl/certs/apisix.crt
          #     subPath: apisix.crt
          # command:
          #   - sh
          #   - -c
          #   - |
          #     # Crear el directorio para los certificados si no existe
          #     mkdir -p /etc/ssl/certs && \
          #     # Crear el archivo ca-certificates.crt si no existe
          #     touch /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && \
          #     # Copiar el contenido existente de ca-certificates.crt a un archivo temporal
          #     cp /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt /tmp/ca-certificates.crt.bak && \
          #     # Añadir el contenido de apisix.crt al archivo temporal
          #     cat /etc/ssl/certs/apisix.crt >> /tmp/ca-certificates.crt.bak && \
          #     # Copiar el archivo temporal de vuelta a ca-certificates.crt
          #     cp /tmp/ca-certificates.crt.bak /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && \
          #     # Iniciar la aplicación principal
          #     exec nginx -g 'daemon off;'
      volumes:
        - name: config-volume
          configMap:
            name: config-operaciones-prestamos
        # - name: apisix-cert-volume
        #   secret:
        #     secretName: apisix-cert-secret-local-container
      imagePullSecrets:
        - name: harbor-credentials-nubo-front

---

apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: operaciones-prestamos-mfe-service
  namespace: nubo-front
spec:
  selector:
    app: operaciones-prestamos-mfe-app
  ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 80
      targetPort: 5011
  type: ClusterIP
```

## bases/apps/otcloan-vitrinatitulos-mfe/config-vitrinatitulos.yml

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: config-vitrinatitulos
  namespace: nubo-front
data:
  default.conf: |
    server {
        listen       5009;
        listen  [::]:5009;
        server_name  localhost;

        #access_log  /var/log/nginx/host.access.log  main;

        location / {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            index  index.html index.htm;
            try_files $uri /index.html;
        }
        
        location /assets/ {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            types {
                application/javascript js;
                text/css css;
            }
            add_header Cache-Control "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate";
        }
        
        error_page  404              /404.html;

        # redirect server error pages to the static page /50x.html
        #
        error_page   500 502 503 504  /50x.html;
        location = /50x.html {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
        }

        # proxy the PHP scripts to Apache listening on 127.0.0.1:80
        #
        #location ~ \.php$ {
        #    proxy_pass   http://127.0.0.1;
        #}

        # pass the PHP scripts to FastCGI server listening on 127.0.0.1:9000
        #
        #location ~ \.php$ {
        #    root           html;
        #    fastcgi_pass   127.0.0.1:9000;
        #    fastcgi_index  index.php;
        #    fastcgi_param  SCRIPT_FILENAME  /scripts$fastcgi_script_name;
        #    include        fastcgi_params;
        #}

        # deny access to .htaccess files, if Apache's document root
        # concurs with nginx's one
        #
        #location ~ /\.ht {
        #    deny  all;
        #}
    }
```

## bases/apps/otcloan-vitrinatitulos-mfe/deploy-react-app.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: vitrinatitulos-mfe-app
  namespace: nubo-front
  labels:
    app: vitrinatitulos-mfe-app
    app.kubernetes.io/name: vitrinatitulos-mfe-app
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: otcloan
    app.kubernetes.io/component: frontend  
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: vitrinatitulos-mfe-app
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: vitrinatitulos-mfe-app
        app.kubernetes.io/name: vitrinatitulos-mfe-app
        app.kubernetes.io/part-of: otcloan
        app.kubernetes.io/component: frontend        
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: vitrinatitulos-mfe-app-container
          image: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/vitrina-titulos-mfe:0.57.0
          env:
          - name: VITE_REMOTE_PARENT
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-vitrinatitulos-env-variable
                key: VITE_REMOTE_PARENT
          - name: VITE_REMOTE_UTILITIES
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-vitrinatitulos-env-variable
                key: VITE_REMOTE_UTILITIES
          - name: VITE_DEV_USER_MANAGEMENT
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-vitrinatitulos-env-variable
                key: VITE_DEV_USER_MANAGEMENT
          - name: VITE_OPERATIONS_URL
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-vitrinatitulos-env-variable
                key: VITE_OPERATIONS_URL
          - name: VITE_MASTER_URL
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-vitrinatitulos-env-variable
                key: VITE_MASTER_URL
          - name: VITE_REMOTE_STOCK_SHOWCASE_MANAGEMENT
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-vitrinatitulos-env-variable
                key: VITE_REMOTE_STOCK_SHOWCASE_MANAGEMENT  
          - name: VITE_MARKET_DATA_BFF_API
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-vitrinatitulos-env-variable
                key: VITE_MARKET_DATA_BFF_API  
          - name: VITE_CONFIGURATION_BFF_API
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-vitrinatitulos-env-variable
                key: VITE_CONFIGURATION_BFF_API
          - name: VITE_VITRINA_BFF_API
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-vitrinatitulos-env-variable
                key: VITE_VITRINA_BFF_API                      
          ports:
            - containerPort: 5009
          volumeMounts:
            - name: config-volume
              mountPath: /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
              subPath: default.conf
          #   - name: apisix-cert-volume
          #     mountPath: /etc/ssl/certs/apisix.crt
          #     subPath: apisix.crt
          # command:
          #   - sh
          #   - -c
          #   - |
          #     # Crear el directorio para los certificados si no existe
          #     mkdir -p /etc/ssl/certs && \
          #     # Crear el archivo ca-certificates.crt si no existe
          #     touch /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && \
          #     # Copiar el contenido existente de ca-certificates.crt a un archivo temporal
          #     cp /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt /tmp/ca-certificates.crt.bak && \
          #     # Añadir el contenido de apisix.crt al archivo temporal
          #     cat /etc/ssl/certs/apisix.crt >> /tmp/ca-certificates.crt.bak && \
          #     # Copiar el archivo temporal de vuelta a ca-certificates.crt
          #     cp /tmp/ca-certificates.crt.bak /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && \
          #     # Iniciar la aplicación principal
          #     exec nginx -g 'daemon off;'
      volumes:
        - name: config-volume
          configMap:
            name: config-vitrinatitulos
        # - name: apisix-cert-volume
        #   secret:
        #     secretName: apisix-cert-secret-local-container
      imagePullSecrets:
        - name: harbor-credentials-nubo-front

## bases/apps/parent-container-front/config-parent-container.yml

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: config-parent-container
  namespace: nubo-front
data:
  default.conf: |
    server {
        listen       5000;
        listen  [::]:5000;
        server_name  localhost;

        #access_log  /var/log/nginx/host.access.log  main;
        gzip on;
        gzip_vary on;
        gzip_comp_level 6;
        gzip_min_length 1024;
        gzip_types
            text/plain
            text/css
            text/xml
            text/javascript
            application/json
            application/javascript
            application/xml
            image/svg+xml;
        location / {
            if ($request_method = 'OPTIONS') {
                 add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' '*';
                 add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods' 'GET, POST, OPTIONS, DELETE, PUT, PATCH';
                 add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers' 'Authorization, Content-Type';
                 add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Credentials' 'true';
                  return 204;
            }
            add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' '*';
            add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods' 'GET, POST, OPTIONS, DELETE, PUT, PATCH';
            add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers' 'Authorization, Content-Type';
            add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Credentials' 'true';

            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            index  index.html index.htm;
            try_files $uri /index.html;
            add_header Cache-Control "no-cache, must-revalidate" always;
        }

        location = /assets/remoteEntry.js {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            add_header Cache-Control "no-cache, must-revalidate" always;
        }
        
        location /assets/ {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=31536000, immutable";
            try_files $uri =404;
        }
        
        error_page  404              /404.html;

        # redirect server error pages to the static page /50x.html
        #
        error_page   500 502 503 504  /50x.html;
        location = /50x.html {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
        }

        # proxy the PHP scripts to Apache listening on 127.0.0.1:80
        #
        #location ~ \.php$ {
        #    proxy_pass   http://127.0.0.1;
        #}

        # pass the PHP scripts to FastCGI server listening on 127.0.0.1:9000
        #
        #location ~ \.php$ {
        #    root           html;
        #    fastcgi_pass   127.0.0.1:9000;
        #    fastcgi_index  index.php;
        #    fastcgi_param  SCRIPT_FILENAME  /scripts$fastcgi_script_name;
        #    include        fastcgi_params;
        #}

        # deny access to .htaccess files, if Apache's document root
        # concurs with nginx's one
        #
        #location ~ /\.ht {
        #    deny  all;
        #}
    }

```

## bases/apps/parent-container-front/deploy-react-app.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: parent-container-front-app
  namespace: nubo-front
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: parent-container-front-app
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: parent-container-front-app
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: parent-container-front-app-container
          image: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/parent-container-front:0.149.0
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "200m" # New 20250621
              memory: "256Mi"
            limits: # New 20250621
              cpu: "1000m" # New 20250621
              memory: "512Mi"
          env:
            - name: VITE_KEY_CAPTCHA
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: config-parent-env-variable
                  key: VITE_KEY_CAPTCHA
            - name: VITE_BASE_URL
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: config-parent-env-variable
                  key: VITE_BASE_URL

## bases/apps/participant-api-redis/deploy-go-app.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: nbo-png-participant-api-redis-app
  namespace: nubo-back
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: nbo-png-participant-api-redis
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: nbo-png-participant-api-redis
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: nbo-png-participant-api-redis-app-container
          image: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/nbo-png-participant-api-redis:0.4.0
          env:
            - name: DB_USERNAME
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret
                  key: DB_USERNAME
            - name: DB_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret
                  key: DB_PASSWORD
            - name: DB_URL
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret
                  key: DB_URL
            - name: REDIS_ADDR
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: config-participant-api-redis
                  key: REDIS_ADDR
            - name: REDIS_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: config-participant-api-redis
                  key: REDIS_PASSWORD
            - name: REDIS_DB
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: config-participant-api-redis
                  key: REDIS_DB
            - name: SERVICE_HOST
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: config-participant-api-redis
                  key: SERVICE_HOST 
            - name: SERVICE_PORT
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: config-participant-api-redis
                  key: SERVICE_PORT
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
      imagePullSecrets:
        - name: harbor-credentials-nubo-back

## bases/apps/perfiles-cmd-back/deploy-java-app.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: perfiles-cmd-back-app
  namespace: nubo-back
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: perfiles-cmd-back
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: perfiles-cmd-back
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        fsGroup: 10001
        automountServiceAccountToken: false
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: perfiles-cmd-back-app-container
          image: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/perfiles-cmd-back:0.1.0
          imagePullPolicy: Always
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false  
            runAsNonRoot: true               
            runAsUser: 10001
            seccompProfile:
              type: RuntimeDefault               
            #readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "200m" 
              memory: "256Mi"
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
          env:
            - name: DB_USERNAME
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret
                  key: DB_USERNAME
            - name: DB_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret
                  key: DB_PASSWORD
            - name: DB_URL
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret
                  key: DB_URL
            - name: DB_HIKARI_MAXIMUM_POOL_SIZE
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret
                  key: DB_HIKARI_MAXIMUM_POOL_SIZE
            - name: DB_HIKARI_MINIMUM_IDLE
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret
                  key: DB_HIKARI_MINIMUM_IDLE
            - name: DB_HIKARI_IDLE_TIMEOUT
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret
                  key: DB_HIKARI_IDLE_TIMEOUT
            - name: DB_HIKARI_VALIDATION_TIMEOUT
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret
                  key: DB_HIKARI_VALIDATION_TIMEOUT
            - name: DB_HIKARI_LEAK_DETECTION_THRESHOLD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret
                  key: DB_HIKARI_LEAK_DETECTION_THRESHOLD
            - name: DB_HIKARI_MAX_LIFETIME
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret
                  key: DB_HIKARI_MAX_LIFETIME
            - name: DB_HIKARI_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret
                  key: DB_HIKARI_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT
            - name: SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret
                  key: SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
      imagePullSecrets:
        - name: harbor-credentials-nubo-back

## bases/apps/reportes-front/config-reportes.yml

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: config-reportes
  namespace: nubo-front
data:
  default.conf: |
    server {
        listen       5014;
        listen  [::]:5014;
        server_name  localhost;

        #access_log  /var/log/nginx/host.access.log  main;

        location / {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            index  index.html index.htm;
        }
        
        location /assets/ {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            types {
                application/javascript js;
                text/css css;
            }
            add_header Cache-Control "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate";
        }
        
        error_page  404              /404.html;

        # redirect server error pages to the static page /50x.html
        #
        error_page   500 502 503 504  /50x.html;
        location = /50x.html {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
        }

        # proxy the PHP scripts to Apache listening on 127.0.0.1:80
        #
        #location ~ \.php$ {
        #    proxy_pass   http://127.0.0.1;
        #}

        # pass the PHP scripts to FastCGI server listening on 127.0.0.1:9000
        #
        #location ~ \.php$ {
        #    root           html;
        #    fastcgi_pass   127.0.0.1:9000;
        #    fastcgi_index  index.php;
        #    fastcgi_param  SCRIPT_FILENAME  /scripts$fastcgi_script_name;
        #    include        fastcgi_params;
        #}

        # deny access to .htaccess files, if Apache's document root
        # concurs with nginx's one
        #
        #location ~ /\.ht {
        #    deny  all;
        #}
    }
```

## bases/apps/reportes-front/deploy-react-app.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: reportes-front-app
  namespace: nubo-front
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: reportes-front-app
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: reportes-front-app
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: reportes-front-app-container
          image: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/reportes-front:0.335.0-alpha.2
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "200m"
              memory: "256Mi"
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
          env:
          - name: VITE_REMOTE_PARENT
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-reportes-env-variable
                key: VITE_REMOTE_PARENT
          - name: VITE_REMOTE_UTILITIES
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-reportes-env-variable
                key: VITE_REMOTE_UTILITIES
          - name: VITE_DEV_USER_MANAGEMENT
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-reportes-env-variable
                key: VITE_DEV_USER_MANAGEMENT
          - name: VITE_OPERATIONS_URL
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-reportes-env-variable
                key: VITE_OPERATIONS_URL
          - name: VITE_MASTER_URL
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-reportes-env-variable
                key: VITE_MASTER_URL
          - name: VITE_ID_MASTER_ACCOUNT
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-reportes-env-variable
                key: VITE_ID_MASTER_ACCOUNT
          ports:
            - containerPort: 5014
          volumeMounts:
            - name: config-volume
              mountPath: /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
              subPath: default.conf
          #   - name: apisix-cert-volume
          #     mountPath: /etc/ssl/certs/apisix.crt
          #     subPath: apisix.crt
          # command:
          #   - sh
          #   - -c
          #   - |
          #     # Crear el directorio para los certificados si no existe
          #     mkdir -p /etc/ssl/certs && \
          #     # Crear el archivo ca-certificates.crt si no existe
          #     touch /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && \
          #     # Copiar el contenido existente de ca-certificates.crt a un archivo temporal
          #     cp /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt /tmp/ca-certificates.crt.bak && \
          #     # Añadir el contenido de apisix.crt al archivo temporal
          #     cat /etc/ssl/certs/apisix.crt >> /tmp/ca-certificates.crt.bak && \
          #     # Copiar el archivo temporal de vuelta a ca-certificates.crt
          #     cp /tmp/ca-certificates.crt.bak /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && \
          #     # Iniciar la aplicación principal
          #     exec nginx -g 'daemon off;'
      volumes:
        - name: config-volume
          configMap:
            name: config-reportes
        # - name: apisix-cert-volume
        #   secret:
        #     secretName: apisix-cert-secret-local-container
      imagePullSecrets:
        - name: harbor-credentials-nubo-front

---

apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: reportes-front-service
  namespace: nubo-front
spec:
  selector:
    app: reportes-front-app
  ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 80
      targetPort: 5014
  type: ClusterIP
```

## bases/apps/riesgos-front/config-riesgos.yml

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: config-riesgos
  namespace: nubo-front
data:
  default.conf: |
    server {
        listen       5008;
        listen  [::]:5008;
        server_name  localhost;

        #access_log  /var/log/nginx/host.access.log  main;

        location / {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            index  index.html index.htm;
            try_files $uri /index.html;
        }
        
        location /assets/ {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            types {
                application/javascript js;
                text/css css;
            }
            add_header Cache-Control "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate";
        }
        
        error_page  404              /404.html;

        # redirect server error pages to the static page /50x.html
        #
        error_page   500 502 503 504  /50x.html;
        location = /50x.html {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
        }

        # proxy the PHP scripts to Apache listening on 127.0.0.1:80
        #
        #location ~ \.php$ {
        #    proxy_pass   http://127.0.0.1;
        #}

        # pass the PHP scripts to FastCGI server listening on 127.0.0.1:9000
        #
        #location ~ \.php$ {
        #    root           html;
        #    fastcgi_pass   127.0.0.1:9000;
        #    fastcgi_index  index.php;
        #    fastcgi_param  SCRIPT_FILENAME  /scripts$fastcgi_script_name;
        #    include        fastcgi_params;
        #}

        # deny access to .htaccess files, if Apache's document root
        # concurs with nginx's one
        #
        #location ~ /\.ht {
        #    deny  all;
        #}
    }
```

## bases/apps/sqlite-multizone-poc/common/app-configmap.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: sqlite-demo-app
  namespace: poc-sqlite-multizone
data:
  app.py: |
    import json
    import os
    import sqlite3
    from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
    from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlparse

    DB_PATH = os.environ.get("DB_PATH", "/data/demo.db")
    POD_NAME = os.environ.get("POD_NAME", "unknown")


    def connect():
        connection = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH, timeout=10)
        connection.execute(
            "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS events ("
            "id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "
            "pod_name TEXT NOT NULL, value TEXT NOT NULL, "
            "created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)"
        )
        connection.commit()
        return connection


    class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        def respond(self, status, payload):
            body = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
            self.send_response(status)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(body)

        def do_GET(self):
            if self.path == "/health":
                self.respond(200, {"status": "ok", "pod": POD_NAME})
                return

            if self.path != "/":
                self.respond(404, {"error": "not found"})
                return

            with connect() as connection:
                rows = connection.execute(
                    "SELECT id, pod_name, value, created_at FROM events ORDER BY id"
                ).fetchall()
            self.respond(200, {"pod": POD_NAME, "database": DB_PATH, "rows": rows})

        def do_POST(self):
            parsed = urlparse(self.path)
            if parsed.path != "/write":
                self.respond(404, {"error": "not found"})
                return

            value = parse_qs(parsed.query).get("value", [""])[0]
            if not value:
                self.respond(400, {"error": "query parameter 'value' is required"})
                return

            with connect() as connection:
                cursor = connection.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO events (pod_name, value) VALUES (?, ?)",
                    (POD_NAME, value),
                )
                connection.commit()
            self.respond(201, {"id": cursor.lastrowid, "pod": POD_NAME, "value": value})

        def log_message(self, format, *args):
            print(f"{self.address_string()} - {format % args}", flush=True)


    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(DB_PATH), exist_ok=True)
    with connect():
        pass
    ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8080), Handler).serve_forever()
```

## bases/apps/sqlite-multizone-poc/deployment.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: sqlite-shared-rwo
  namespace: poc-sqlite-multizone
spec:
  replicas: 1
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: sqlite-shared-rwo
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: sqlite-shared-rwo
    spec:
      nodeSelector:
        workload: aplicacion
      tolerations:
        - key: workload
          operator: Equal
          value: aplicacion
          effect: NoSchedule
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: sqlite-demo
          image: python:3.13-alpine
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          command: ["python", "/app/app.py"]
          env:
            - name: DB_PATH
              value: /data/demo.db
            - name: POD_NAME
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: metadata.name
            - name: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE
              value: "1"
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8080
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 5
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 10
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 25m
              memory: 32Mi
              ephemeral-storage: 32Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
              ephemeral-storage: 128Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          volumeMounts:
            - name: app
              mountPath: /app
              readOnly: true
            - name: data
              mountPath: /data
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp
      volumes:
        - name: app
          configMap:
            name: sqlite-demo-app
        - name: data
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: sqlite-shared-rwo
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir: {}
```

## bases/apps/utilities-front/config-utilities.yml

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: config-utilities
  namespace: nubo-front
data:
  default.conf: |
    server {
        listen       5001;
        listen  [::]:5001;
        server_name  localhost;

        #access_log  /var/log/nginx/host.access.log  main;

        location / {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            index  index.html index.htm;
        }
        
        location /assets/ {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            types {
                application/javascript js;
                text/css css;
            }
            add_header Cache-Control "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate";
        }
        
        error_page  404              /404.html;

        # redirect server error pages to the static page /50x.html
        #
        error_page   500 502 503 504  /50x.html;
        location = /50x.html {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
        }

        # proxy the PHP scripts to Apache listening on 127.0.0.1:80
        #
        #location ~ \.php$ {
        #    proxy_pass   http://127.0.0.1;
        #}

        # pass the PHP scripts to FastCGI server listening on 127.0.0.1:9000
        #
        #location ~ \.php$ {
        #    root           html;
        #    fastcgi_pass   127.0.0.1:9000;
        #    fastcgi_index  index.php;
        #    fastcgi_param  SCRIPT_FILENAME  /scripts$fastcgi_script_name;
        #    include        fastcgi_params;
        #}

        # deny access to .htaccess files, if Apache's document root
        # concurs with nginx's one
        #
        #location ~ /\.ht {
        #    deny  all;
        #}
    }
```

## bases/apps/utilities-front/deploy-react-app.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: utilities-front-app
  namespace: nubo-front
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: utilities-front-app
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: utilities-front-app
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: utilities-front-app-container
        image: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/utilities-front:0.185.0
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: "200m"
            memory: "256Mi"
          limits:
            cpu: "500m"
            memory: "512Mi"
        env:
          - name: VITE_REMOTE_PARENT
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-utilities-env-variable
                key: VITE_REMOTE_PARENT
          - name: VITE_DEV_USER_MANAGEMENT
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-utilities-env-variable
                key: VITE_DEV_USER_MANAGEMENT
          - name: VITE_DEV_MASTER_PARTICIPANT
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-utilities-env-variable
                key: VITE_DEV_MASTER_PARTICIPANT
          - name: VITE_MENU_URL
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-utilities-env-variable
                key: VITE_MENU_URL
          - name: VITE_WEBSOCKET_SERVER_URL
            valueFrom:
              configMapKeyRef:
                name: config-utilities-env-variable
                key: VITE_WEBSOCKET_SERVER_URL
        ports:
        - containerPort: 5001
        volumeMounts:
            - name: config-volume
              mountPath: /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
              subPath: default.conf
            # - name: apisix-cert-volume
            #   mountPath: /etc/ssl/certs/apisix.crt
            #   subPath: apisix.crt
          # command:
          #   - sh
          #   - -c
          #   - |
          #     # Crear el directorio para los certificados si no existe
          #     mkdir -p /etc/ssl/certs && \
          #     # Crear el archivo ca-certificates.crt si no existe
          #     touch /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && \
          #     # Copiar el contenido existente de ca-certificates.crt a un archivo temporal
          #     cp /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt /tmp/ca-certificates.crt.bak && \
          #     # Añadir el contenido de apisix.crt al archivo temporal
          #     cat /etc/ssl/certs/apisix.crt >> /tmp/ca-certificates.crt.bak && \
          #     # Copiar el archivo temporal de vuelta a ca-certificates.crt
          #     cp /tmp/ca-certificates.crt.bak /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && \
          #     # Iniciar la aplicación principal
          #     exec nginx -g 'daemon off;'
      volumes:
        - name: config-volume
          configMap:
            name: config-utilities
        # - name: apisix-cert-volume
        #   secret:
        #     secretName: apisix-cert-secret-local-container
      imagePullSecrets:
        - name: harbor-credentials-nubo-front

---

apiVersion: v1

  namespace: nubo-front
spec:

      port: 80
      targetPort: 5001
  type: ClusterIP

## bases/infrastructure/apisix/apisix-release.yaml

```yaml
---
apiVersion: helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v2
kind: HelmRelease
metadata:
  name: apisix
  namespace: api-gateway
spec:
  interval: 5m
  timeout: 5m
  chart:
    spec:
      chart: apisix
      version: '2.11.5'
      sourceRef:
        kind: HelmRepository
        name: apisix-repository
        namespace: flux-system
      interval: 5m
  releaseName: apisix
  install:
    remediation:
      retries: 3
  upgrade:
    remediation:
      retries: 3
  valuesFrom:
    - kind: ConfigMap
      name: values-apisix
      valuesKey: values.yaml
```

## bases/infrastructure/apisix/apisix-route.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: apisix.apache.org/v2
kind: ApisixRoute
metadata:
  name: httpserver-route
  namespace: nubo-back
spec:
  http:
    - name: rule3
      match:
        paths:
          - /*
      backends:
        - serviceName: gestion-usuarios-service
          servicePort: 80
    - name: rule4
      match:
        paths:
          - /menu-api/*
      backends:
        - serviceName: opcionesmenu-service
          servicePort: 80
    - name: rule5
      match:
        paths:
          - /master-participant-api/*
      backends:
        - serviceName: maestro-participante-back-service
          servicePort: 80
    - name: rule6
      match:
        paths:
          - /operations-api/*
      backends:
        - serviceName: operaciones-back-service
          servicePort: 80
    - name: rule7
      match:
        paths:
          - /master-third-parties-api/*
      backends:
        - serviceName: maestro-terceros-back-service
          servicePort: 80
    - name: rule8
      match:
        paths:
          - /receipts-api/*
      backends:
        - serviceName: comprobantes-back-service
          servicePort: 80
    - name: rule9
      match:
        paths:
          - /operations-rules-api/*
      backends:
        - serviceName: operaciones-reglas-back-service
          servicePort: 80
    - name: rule10
      match:
        paths:
          - /operations-calculation-api/*
      backends:
        - serviceName: operaciones-calculos-back-service
          servicePort: 80
    - name: rule11
      match:
        paths:
          - /special-operations-api/*
      backends:
        - serviceName: operaciones-espec-back-service
          servicePort: 80
    - name: rule12
      match:
        paths:
          - /operations-status-api/*
      backends:
        - serviceName: operaciones-estados-back-service
          servicePort: 80
    - name: rule13
      match:
        paths:
          - /special-operations-consult-folios-api/*
      backends:
        - serviceName: operaciones-espec-consulta-folios-back-service
          servicePort: 80
    - name: rule15
      match:
        paths:
          - /special-operation-calculation-api/*
      backends:
        - serviceName: operaciones-espec-calculos-back-service
          servicePort: 80
    - name: rule16
      match:
        paths:
          - /special-operations-receipts-api/*
      backends:
        - serviceName: comprobante-operaciones-especiales-back-service
          servicePort: 80
    - name: rule17
      match:
        paths:
          - /operations-custody-status-api/*
      backends:
        - serviceName: operaciones-custodio-estados-back-service

## bases/infrastructure/apisix/config-map-values.yaml

````yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: values-apisix
  namespace: api-gateway
data:
  values.yaml: |
    #
    # Licensed to the Apache Software Foundation (ASF) under one or more
    # contributor license agreements.  See the NOTICE file distributed with
    # this work for additional information regarding copyright ownership.
    # The ASF licenses this file to You under the Apache License, Version 2.0
    # (the "License"); you may not use this file except in compliance with
    # the License.  You may obtain a copy of the License at
    #
    #     http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
    #
    # Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
    # distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
    # WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
    # See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
    # limitations under the License.

    global:
      # e.g.
      # imagePullSecrets:
      #   - my-registry-secrets
      #   - other-registry-secrets
      # -- Global Docker registry secret names as an array
      imagePullSecrets: "[REDACTED]"

    image:
      # -- Apache APISIX image repository
      repository: apache/apisix
      # -- Apache APISIX image pull policy
      pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
      # -- Apache APISIX image tag
      # Overrides the image tag whose default is the chart appVersion.
      tag: 3.14.1-ubuntu

    # -- set false to use `Deployment`, set true to use `DaemonSet`
    useDaemonSet: false
    # -- if useDaemonSet is true or autoscaling.enabled is true, replicaCount not become effective
    replicaCount: 1

    # -- Set [priorityClassName](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/pod-priority-preemption/#pod-priority) for Apache APISIX pods
    priorityClassName: ""
    # -- Annotations to add to each pod
    podAnnotations: {}
    # -- Set the securityContext for Apache APISIX pods
    podSecurityContext: {}
      # fsGroup: 2000
    # -- Set the securityContext for Apache APISIX container
    securityContext: {}
      # capabilities:
      #   drop:
      #   - ALL
      # readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
      # runAsNonRoot: true
      # runAsUser: 1000

    # -- See https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/run-application/configure-pdb/ for more details
    podDisruptionBudget:
      # -- Enable or disable podDisruptionBudget
      enabled: false
      # -- Set the `minAvailable` of podDisruptionBudget. You can specify only one of `maxUnavailable` and `minAvailable` in a single PodDisruptionBudget.
      # See [Specifying a Disruption Budget for your Application](https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/run-application/configure-pdb/#specifying-a-poddisruptionbudget)
      # for more details
      minAvailable: 90%
      # -- Set the maxUnavailable of podDisruptionBudget
      maxUnavailable: 1

    # -- Set pod resource requests & limits
    resources: {}
      # -- Use the host's network namespace

      # We usually recommend not to specify default resources and to leave this as a conscious
      # choice for the user. This also increases chances charts run on environments with little
      # resources, such as Minikube. If you do want to specify resources, uncomment the following
      # lines, adjust them as necessary, and remove the curly braces after 'resources:'.
      # limits:
      #   cpu: 100m
      #   memory: 128Mi
      # requests:
      #   cpu: 100m
      #   memory: 128Mi
    hostNetwork: false

    # -- Node labels for Apache APISIX pod assignment
    nodeSelector: {}
    # -- List of node taints to tolerate
    tolerations: []
    # -- Set affinity for Apache APISIX deploy
    affinity: {}
    # -- Topology Spread Constraints for pod assignment spread across your cluster among failure-domains
    # ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-topology-spread-constraints/#spread-constraints-for-pods
    topologySpreadConstraints: []

    # -- timezone is the timezone where apisix uses.
    # For example: "UTC" or "Asia/Shanghai"
    # This value will be set on apisix container's environment variable TZ.
    # You may need to set the timezone to be consistent with your local time zone,
    # otherwise the apisix's logs may used to retrieve event maybe in wrong timezone.
    timezone: ""

    # -- extraEnvVars An array to add extra env vars
    # e.g:
    # extraEnvVars:
    #   - name: FOO
    #     value: "bar"
    #   - name: FOO2
    #     valueFrom:
    #       secretKeyRef:
    #         name: SECRET_NAME
    #         key: KEY
    extraEnvVars: []

    updateStrategy: {}
      # type: RollingUpdate

    # -- Additional Kubernetes resources to deploy with the release.
    extraDeploy: []

    # -- Additional `volume`, See [Kubernetes Volumes](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/storage/volumes/) for the detail.
    extraVolumes: []
    # - name: extras
    #   emptyDir: {}

    # -- Additional `volume`, See [Kubernetes Volumes](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/storage/volumes/) for the detail.
    extraVolumeMounts: []
    # - name: extras
    #   mountPath: /usr/share/extras
    #   readOnly: true

    # -- Additional `initContainers`, See [Kubernetes initContainers](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/init-containers/) for the detail.
    extraInitContainers: []
    # - name: init-myservice
    #   image: busybox:1.28
    #   command: ['sh', '-c', "until nslookup myservice.$(cat /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/namespace).svc.cluster.local; do echo waiting for myservice; sleep 2; done"]

    # -- Additional `containers`, See [Kubernetes containers](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/) for the detail.
    extraContainers: []

    initContainer:
      # -- Init container image
      image: busybox
      # -- Init container tag
      tag: 1.28

    autoscaling:
      enabled: false
      # -- HPA version, the value is "v2" or "v2beta1", default "v2"
      version: v2
      minReplicas: 1
      maxReplicas: 100
      targetCPUUtilizationPercentage: 80
      targetMemoryUtilizationPercentage: 80

    nameOverride: ""
    fullnameOverride: ""

    serviceAccount:
      create: false
      annotations: {}
      name: ""

    rbac:
      create: false

    service:
      # -- Apache APISIX service type for user access itself
      type: NodePort
      # -- Setting how the Service route external traffic
      # If you want to keep the client source IP, you can set this to Local.

      # ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/access-application-cluster/create-external-load-balancer/#preserving-the-client-source-ip
      externalTrafficPolicy: Cluster
      # type: LoadBalancer
      # annotations:
      #   service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-type: nlb
      externalIPs: []
      # -- Apache APISIX service settings for http
      http:
        enabled: true
        servicePort: 80
        containerPort: 9080
        # -- Support multiple http ports, See [Configuration](https://github.com/apache/apisix/blob/0bc65ea9acd726f79f80ae0abd8f50b7eb172e3d/conf/config-default.yaml#L24)
        additionalContainerPorts: []
          # - port: 9081
          #   enable_http2: true          # If not set, the default value is `false`.
          # - ip: 127.0.0.2               # Specific IP, If not set, the default value is `0.0.0.0`.
          #   port: 9082
          #   enable_http2: true
      # -- Apache APISIX service settings for tls
      tls:
        servicePort: 443
        # nodePort: 4443

      # -- Apache APISIX service settings for stream. L4 proxy (TCP/UDP)
      stream:
        enabled: false
        tcp: []
        udp: []
      #  - secretName: apisix-tls
      #    hosts:
      #      - chart-example.local
      # -- Override default labels assigned to Apache APISIX gateway resources
      labelsOverride: {}
      # labelsOverride:
      #   app.kubernetes.io/name: "{{ .Release.Name }}"
      #   app.kubernetes.io/instance: '{{ include "apisix.name" . }}'

    # -- Using ingress access Apache APISIX service
    ingress:
      enabled: false
      # -- (number) Service port to send traffic. Defaults to `service.http.servicePort`.
      servicePort:
      # -- Ingress annotations
      annotations: {}
        # kubernetes.io/ingress.class: nginx
        # kubernetes.io/tls-acme: "true"
      hosts:
        - host: apisix.local
          paths: []
      tls: []

    control:
      # -- Enable Control API
      enabled: true
      service:
        # -- Control annotations
        annotations: {}
        # -- Control service type
        type: ClusterIP
        # loadBalancerIP: a.b.c.d
        # loadBalancerSourceRanges:
        #   - "143.231.0.0/16"
        # -- IPs for which nodes in the cluster will also accept traffic for the servic
        externalIPs: []

        # -- NodePort (only if control.service.type is NodePort)
        # nodePort: 32000

        # -- which ip to listen on for Apache APISIX Control API
        ip: "127.0.0.1"
        # -- which port to use for Apache APISIX Control API
        port: 9090
        # -- Service port to use for Apache APISIX Control API
        servicePort: 9090
      # -- Using ingress access Apache APISIX Control service
      ingress:
        enabled: false
        # -- Ingress annotations
        annotations:
          {}
          # kubernetes.io/ingress.class: nginx
          # kubernetes.io/tls-acme: "true"
        # -- Ingress Class Name
        # className: "nginx"
        hosts:
          - host: apisix-control.local
            paths:
              - "/*"
        tls: []
      #  - secretName: apisix-tls
      #    hosts:
      #      - chart-example.local

    # -- Observability configuration.
    metrics:
      serviceMonitor:
        # -- Enable or disable Apache APISIX serviceMonitor
        enabled: false
        # -- namespace where the serviceMonitor is deployed, by default, it is the same as the namespace of the apisix
        namespace: ""
        # -- name of the serviceMonitor, by default, it is the same as the apisix fullname
        name: ""
        # -- interval at which metrics should be scraped
        interval: 15s
        # -- @param serviceMonitor.labels ServiceMonitor extra labels
        labels: {}
        # -- @param serviceMonitor.annotations ServiceMonitor annotations
        annotations: {}

    apisix:
      # -- Enable nginx IPv6 resolver
      enableIPv6: true
      enableHTTP2: true

      # -- Whether the APISIX version number should be shown in Server header
      enableServerTokens: true

      # -- Use Pod metadata.uid as the APISIX id.
      setIDFromPodUID: false

      # -- Whether to add a custom lua module
      luaModuleHook:
        enabled: false
        # -- extend lua_package_path to load third party code
        luaPath: ""
        # -- the hook module which will be used to inject third party code into APISIX
        # use the lua require style like: "module.say_hello"
        hookPoint: ""
        # -- configmap that stores the codes
        configMapRef:
          # -- Name of the ConfigMap where the lua module codes store
          name: ""
          # mounts decides how to mount the codes to the container.
          mounts:
            # -- Name of the ConfigMap key, for setting the mapping relationship between ConfigMap key and the lua module code path.
            - key: ""
            # -- Filepath of the plugin code, for setting the mapping relationship between ConfigMap key and the lua module code path.
              path: ""

      ssl:
        enabled: false
        containerPort: 9443
        # -- Support multiple https ports, See [Configuration](https://github.com/apache/apisix/blob/0bc65ea9acd726f79f80ae0abd8f50b7eb172e3d/conf/config-default.yaml#L99)
        additionalContainerPorts: []
          # - ip: 127.0.0.3           # Specific IP, If not set, the default value is `0.0.0.0`.
          #   port: 9445
          #   enable_http3: true
        # -- Specifies the name of Secret contains trusted CA certificates in the PEM format used to verify the certificate when APISIX needs to do SSL/TLS handshaking with external services (e.g. etcd)
        existingCASecret: "[REDACTED]"
        # -- Filename be used in the apisix.ssl.existingCASecret
        certCAFilename: ""
        enableHTTP3: false
        # -- TLS protocols allowed to use.
        sslProtocols: "TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3"
        # -- TLS ciphers allowed to use.
        sslCiphers: "ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-ECDSA-CHACHA20-POLY1305:ECDHE-RSA-CHACHA20-POLY1305:DHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:DHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:DHE-RSA-CHACHA20-POLY1305:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA256:ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA:ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA384:ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA:ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA:DHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256:DHE-RSA-AES256-SHA256:AES128-GCM-SHA256:AES256-GCM-SHA384:AES128-SHA256:AES256-SHA256:AES128-SHA:AES256-SHA:DES-CBC3-SHA"
        # -- Define SNI to fallback if none is presented by client
        fallbackSNI: ""

      router:
        # -- Defines how apisix handles routing:
        # - radixtree_uri: match route by uri(base on radixtree)
        # - radixtree_host_uri: match route by host + uri(base on radixtree)
        # - radixtree_uri_with_parameter: match route by uri with parameters
        http: radixtree_host_uri

      fullCustomConfig:
        # -- Enable full customized config.yaml
        enabled: false
        # -- If apisix.fullCustomConfig.enabled is true, full customized config.yaml.
        # Please note that other settings about APISIX config will be ignored
        config: {}

      deployment:
        # -- Apache APISIX deployment mode
        # Optional: traditional, decoupled, standalone
        #
        # ref: https://apisix.apache.org/docs/apisix/deployment-modes/
        mode: traditional

        # -- Deployment role
        # Optional: traditional, data_plane, control_plane
        #
        # ref: https://apisix.apache.org/docs/apisix/deployment-modes/
        role: "traditional"
        role_traditional:
          # enum: etcd, yaml
          config_provider: "etcd"

      admin:
        # -- Enable Admin API
        enabled: true
        # -- Enable Embedded Admin UI
        enable_admin_ui: true
        # -- admin service type
        type: ClusterIP
        # loadBalancerIP: a.b.c.d
        # loadBalancerSourceRanges:
        #   - "143.231.0.0/16"
        # -- IPs for which nodes in the cluster will also accept traffic for the servic
        externalIPs: []
        # -- which ip to listen on for Apache APISIX admin API. Set to `"[::]"` when on IPv6 single stack
        ip: 0.0.0.0
        # -- which port to use for Apache APISIX admin API
        port: 9180
        # -- Service port to use for Apache APISIX admin API
        servicePort: 9180
        # -- Admin API support CORS response headers
        cors: true
        # -- Admin API credentials
        credentials:
          # -- Apache APISIX admin API admin role credentials
          admin: edd1c9f034335f136f87ad84b625c8f1
          # -- Apache APISIX admin API viewer role credentials
          viewer: 4054f7cf07e344346cd3f287985e76a2

          # -- The APISIX Helm chart supports storing user credentials in a secret.
          # The secret needs to contain two keys, admin and viewer, with their respective values set.
          secretName: "[REDACTED]"
          # -- Name of the admin role key in the secret, overrides the default key name "admin"
          secretAdminKey: "[REDACTED]"
          # -- Name of the viewer role key in the secret, overrides the default key name "viewer"
          secretViewerKey: "[REDACTED]"

        allow:
          # -- The client IP CIDR allowed to access Apache APISIX Admin API service.
          ipList:
            - 127.0.0.1/24
        # -- Using ingress access Apache APISIX admin service
        ingress:
          enabled: false
          # -- Ingress annotations
          annotations:
            {}
            # kubernetes.io/ingress.class: nginx
            # kubernetes.io/tls-acme: "true"
          hosts:
            - host: apisix-admin.local
              paths:
                - "/apisix"
          tls: []
        #  - secretName: apisix-tls
        #    hosts:
        #      - chart-example.local

      nginx:
        workerRlimitNofile: "20480"
        workerConnections: "10620"
        workerProcesses: auto
        enableCPUAffinity: true
        # -- Timeout during which a keep-alive client connection will stay open on the server side.
        keepaliveTimeout: 60s
        envs: []
        # access log and error log configuration
        logs:
          # -- Enable access log or not, default true
          enableAccessLog: true
          # -- Access log path
          accessLog: "/dev/stdout"
          # -- Access log format
          accessLogFormat: '$remote_addr - $remote_user [$time_local] $http_host \"$request\" $status $body_bytes_sent $request_time \"$http_referer\" \"$http_user_agent\" $upstream_addr $upstream_status $upstream_response_time \"$upstream_scheme://$upstream_host$upstream_uri\"'
          # -- Allows setting json or default characters escaping in variables
          accessLogFormatEscape: default
          # -- Error log path
          errorLog: "/dev/stderr"
          # -- Error log level
          errorLogLevel: "warn"
        # -- Custom configuration snippet.
        configurationSnippet:
          main: |

          httpStart: |

          httpEnd: |

          httpSrv: |

          httpAdmin: |

          stream: |

        # -- Add custom [lua_shared_dict](https://github.com/openresty/lua-nginx-module?tab=readme-ov-file#lua_shared_dict) settings,
        # click [here](https://github.com/apache/apisix-helm-chart/blob/master/charts/apisix/values.yaml#L27-L30) to learn the format of a shared dict
        customLuaSharedDicts: []
          # - name: foo
          #   size: 10k
          # - name: bar
          #   size: 1m

        # -- Override default [lua_shared_dict](https://github.com/apache/apisix/blob/master/conf/config.yaml.example#L250-L276) settings,
        # click [here](https://github.com/apache/apisix-helm-chart/blob/master/charts/apisix/values.yaml#L27-L30) to learn the format of a shared dict
        luaSharedDicts: []
          # - name: prometheus-metrics
          #   size: 20m

      discovery:
        # -- Enable or disable Apache APISIX integration service discovery
        enabled: false
        # -- Service discovery registry. Refer to [configuration under discovery](https://github.com/apache/apisix/blob/master/conf/config.yaml.example#L307) for example.
        # Also see [example of using external service discovery](https://apisix.apache.org/docs/ingress-controller/1.8.0/tutorials/external-service-discovery/).
        registry: {}
          # Integration service discovery registry. E.g eureka\dns\nacos\consul_kv
          # reference:
          # https://apisix.apache.org/docs/apisix/discovery/#configuration-for-eureka
          # https://apisix.apache.org/docs/apisix/discovery/dns/#service-discovery-via-dns
          # https://apisix.apache.org/docs/apisix/discovery/consul_kv/#configuration-for-consul-kv
          # https://apisix.apache.org/docs/apisix/discovery/nacos/#configuration-for-nacos
          # https://apisix.apache.org/docs/apisix/discovery/kubernetes/#configuration
          #
          # an eureka example:
          # ```
          # eureka:
          #   host:
          #     - "http://${username}:[REDACTED]@${eureka_host1}:${eureka_port1}"
          #     - "http://${username}:[REDACTED]@${eureka_host2}:${eureka_port2}"
          #   prefix: "/eureka/"
          #   fetch_interval: 30
          #   weight: 100
          #   timeout:
          #     connect: 2000
          #     send: 2000
          #     read: 5000
          # ```
          #
          # the minimal Kubernetes example:
          # ```
          # kubernetes: {}
          # ```
          #
          # The prerequisites for the above minimal Kubernetes example:
          #  1. [Optional] Set `.serviceAccount.create` to `true` to create a dedicated ServiceAccount.
          #     It is recommended to do so, otherwise the default ServiceAccount "default" will be used.
          #  2. [Required] Set `.rbac.create` to `true` to create and bind the necessary RBAC resources.
          #     This grants the ServiceAccount in use to List-Watch Kubernetes Endpoints resources.
          #  3. [Required] Include the following environment variables in `.nginx.envs` to pass them into
          #     nginx worker processes (https://nginx.org/en/docs/ngx_core_module.html#env):
          #      - KUBERNETES_SERVICE_HOST
          #      - KUBERNETES_SERVICE_PORT
          #     This is for allowing the default `host` and `port` of `.discovery.registry.kubernetes.service`.

      dns:
        resolvers:
          - 127.0.0.1
          - 172.20.0.10
          - 114.114.114.114
          - 223.5.5.5
          - 1.1.1.1
          - 8.8.8.8
        validity: 30
        timeout: 5

      vault:
        # -- Enable or disable the vault integration
        enabled: false
        # -- The host address where the vault server is running.
        host: ""
        # -- HTTP timeout for each request.
        timeout: 10
        # -- The generated token from vault instance that can grant access to read data from the vault.
        token: "[REDACTED]"
        # -- Prefix allows you to better enforcement of policies.
        prefix: ""

      prometheus:
        # ref: https://apisix.apache.org/docs/apisix/plugins/prometheus/
        enabled: false
        # -- path of the metrics endpoint
        path: /apisix/prometheus/metrics
        # -- prefix of the metrics
        metricPrefix: apisix_
        # -- container port where the metrics are exposed
        containerPort: 9091

      # -- Customize the list of APISIX plugins to enable. By default, APISIX's [default plugins](https://github.com/apache/apisix/blob/master/apisix/cli/config.lua#L196) are automatically used.
      plugins:           # plugin list
        - real-ip
        - proxy-rewrite
        - server-info
        - authz-keycloak
        - cors
        - limit-conn
        - limit-count
        - limit-req
        - csrf
        - openid-connect
        
      # -- Customize the list of APISIX stream_plugins to enable. By default, APISIX's [default stream_plugins](https://github.com/apache/apisix/blob/master/apisix/cli/config.lua#L294) are automatically used.
      stream_plugins: []

      # -- Set APISIX plugin attributes. By default, APISIX's [plugin_attr](https://github.com/apache/apisix/blob/master/apisix/cli/config.lua#L295) are automatically used.
      # See [configuration example](https://github.com/apache/apisix/blob/master/conf/config.yaml.example#L591).
      pluginAttrs: {}

      extPlugin:
        # -- Enable External Plugins. See [external plugin](https://apisix.apache.org/docs/apisix/next/external-plugin/)
        enabled: false
        # -- the command and its arguements to run as a subprocess
        cmd: ["/path/to/apisix-plugin-runner/runner", "run"]

      wasm:
        # -- Enable Wasm Plugins. See [wasm plugin](https://apisix.apache.org/docs/apisix/next/wasm/)
        enabled: false
        plugins: []

      # -- customPlugins allows you to mount your own HTTP plugins.
      customPlugins:
        # -- Whether to configure some custom plugins
        enabled: false
        # -- the lua_path that tells APISIX where it can find plugins,
        # note the last ';' is required.
        luaPath: "/opts/custom_plugins/?.lua"
        plugins:
          # -- plugin name.
          - name: "plugin-name"
            # -- plugin attrs
            attrs: {}
            # -- plugin codes can be saved inside configmap object.
            configMap:
              # -- name of configmap.
              name: "configmap-name"
              # -- since keys in configmap is flat, mountPath allows to define the mount
              # path, so that plugin codes can be mounted hierarchically.
              mounts:
                - key: "the-file-name"
                  path: "mount-path"

      status:
        ip: "0.0.0.0"
        port: 7085

      # -- When configured, APISIX will trust the `X-Forwarded-*` Headers passed in requests from the IP/CIDR in the list.
      trustedAddresses:
        - 127.0.0.1

    # -- external etcd configuration. If etcd.enabled is false, these configuration will be used.
    externalEtcd:
      # -- if etcd.enabled is false, use external etcd, support multiple address, if your etcd cluster enables TLS, please use https scheme, e.g. https://127.0.0.1:2379.
      host:
        # host or ip e.g. http://172.20.128.89:2379
        - http://etcd.host:2379
      # -- if etcd.enabled is false, user for external etcd. Set empty to disable authentication
      user: root
      # -- if etcd.enabled is true, use etcd.auth.rbac.rootPassword instead.
      # -- if etcd.enabled is false and externalEtcd.existingSecret is not empty, the password should store in the corresponding secret
      # -- if etcd.enabled is false and externalEtcd.existingSecret is empty, externalEtcd.password is the passsword for external etcd.
      password: "[REDACTED]"
      # -- if externalEtcd.existingSecret is the name of secret containing the external etcd password
      existingSecret: "[REDACTED]"
      # -- externalEtcd.secretPasswordKey Key inside the secret containing the external etcd password
      secretPasswordKey: "[REDACTED]"

    # -- etcd configuration
    # use the FQDN address or the IP of the etcd
    etcd:
      # -- install built-in etcd by default, set false if do not want to install built-in etcd together,
      # this etcd is based on bitnamilegacy/etcd helm chart and latest bitnami docker image, only for development and testing purposes,
      # if you want to use etcd in production, we recommend you to install etcd by yourself and use `externalEtcd` to connect it.
      enabled: true
      # -- docker image for built-in etcd
      image:
        registry: docker.io
        repository: bitnamilegacy/etcd
        # -- `bitnamilegacy/etcd` only provide `latest` tag now, ref: https://github.com/bitnami/containers/issues/83267,
        # you can switch `etcd.image.repository` to `bitnamilegacy/etcd` to use old versioned tags.
        tag: latest
      persistence:
        enabled: true
        size: 10Gi 
        storageClass: ebs-sc-gp3  

      # -- apisix configurations prefix
      prefix: "/apisix"
      # -- Set the timeout value in seconds for subsequent socket operations from apisix to etcd cluster
      timeout: 30

      # -- if etcd.enabled is true, set more values of bitnamilegacy/etcd helm chart
      auth:
        rbac:
          # -- No authentication by default. Switch to enable RBAC authentication
          create: false
          # -- root password for etcd. Requires etcd.auth.rbac.create to be true.
          rootPassword: "[REDACTED]"
        tls:
          # -- enable etcd client certificate
          enabled: false
          # -- name of the secret contains etcd client cert
          existingSecret: "[REDACTED]"
          # -- etcd client cert filename using in etcd.auth.tls.existingSecret
          certFilename: ""
          # -- etcd client cert key filename using in etcd.auth.tls.existingSecret
          certKeyFilename: ""
          # -- whether to verify the etcd endpoint certificate when setup a TLS connection to etcd
          verify: true
          # -- specify the TLS Server Name Indication extension, the ETCD endpoint hostname will be used when this setting is unset.
          sni: ""

      # -- ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/security-context/#set-the-security-context-for-a-container
      # -- added for backward compatibility with old kubernetes versions, as seccompProfile is not supported in kubernetes < 1.19
      containerSecurityContext:
        enabled: false

      service:
        port: 2379

      replicaCount: 3
      autoCompactionRetention: "1h"
      autoCompactionMode: "periodic"

    # -- Ingress controller configuration
    ingress-controller:
      enabled: false


````

## bases/infrastructure/cert-manager/operator/helmrelease.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v2
kind: HelmRelease
metadata:
  name: cert-manager
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 15m
  chart:
    spec:
      chart: cert-manager
      version: "v1.15.3"
      sourceRef:
        kind: HelmRepository
        name: cert-manager
        namespace: flux-system
      interval: 1m
  install:
    crds: CreateReplace
    createNamespace: true  # 🪄 Aquí está la clave para crear el namespace automáticamente
    remediation:
      retries: 3
  upgrade:
    crds: CreateReplace
    remediation:
      retries: 3
  uninstall:
    keepHistory: false
  targetNamespace: cert-manager
  releaseName: cert-manager
  values:
    installCRDs: true
    replicaCount: 2
    podDisruptionBudget:
      enabled: true
      minAvailable: 1
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: 10m
        memory: 64Mi
      limits:
        cpu: 100m
        memory: 256Mi
    prometheus:
      servicemonitor:
        enabled: false
        labels:
          release: kube-prometheus-stack
    webhook:
      replicaCount: 2
      podDisruptionBudget:
        enabled: true
        minAvailable: 1
      resources:
        requests:
          cpu: 10m
          memory: 32Mi
        limits:
          cpu: 50m
          memory: 64Mi
    cainjector:
      replicaCount: 2
      podDisruptionBudget:
        enabled: true
        minAvailable: 1
      resources:
        requests:
          cpu: 10m
          memory: 32Mi
        limits:
          cpu: 50m
          memory: 64Mi
    startupapicheck:
      enabled: true
      resources:
        requests:
          cpu: 10m
          memory: 32Mi
        limits:
          cpu: 20m
          memory: 64Mi
    global:
      podSecurityPolicy:
        enabled: false
      priorityClassName: system-cluster-critical
    nodeSelector:
      kubernetes.io/os: linux
    tolerations: []
    affinity: {}
```
