## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/apps/operaciones-custodio-estados-back/kustomization.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
# Multizona (docs/plans/manual-configuracion-microservicios-multizona.md):
# HPA 2-4 por CPU, reparto por AZ, PDB, recursos, probes TCP, seguridad del pod.
resources:
  - ../../../../bases/apps/operaciones-custodio-estados-back
  - hpa.yaml
  - pdb.yaml
patches:
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/image
        value: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/operaciones-custodio-estados-back:0.58.0-beta.1

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/cpu
        value: 999m

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/memory
        value: 999Mi
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/nodeSelector
        value:
          workload: aplicacion
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/tolerations
        value:
          - key: workload
            operator: Equal
            value: aplicacion
            effect: NoSchedule
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  # Recursos: request de CPU bajo para que las replicas entren en los nodos aplicacion
  # (el HPA escala al 70% de 100m). Memoria: la de la base; ajustar con kubectl top.
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/requests/cpu
        value: 100m
      # Las replicas las maneja el HPA (hpa.yaml).
      - op: remove
        path: /spec/replicas
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Reparto de replicas entre zonas y nodos. Despliegue sin corte: crea el pod nuevo
  # antes de bajar el viejo (importante con 1 replica durante la migracion).
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/topologySpreadConstraints
        value:
          - maxSkew: 1
            topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
            whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
            nodeTaintsPolicy: Honor
            labelSelector:
              matchLabels:
                app: operaciones-custodio-estados-back
            matchLabelKeys:
              - pod-template-hash
          - maxSkew: 1
            topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
            whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
            labelSelector:
              matchLabels:
                app: operaciones-custodio-estados-back
            matchLabelKeys:
              - pod-template-hash
      - op: add
        path: /spec/strategy
        value:
          type: RollingUpdate
          rollingUpdate:
            maxSurge: 1
            maxUnavailable: 0
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Seguridad del pod: sin token de ServiceAccount (no usa la API de Kubernetes).
  # Usuario de la imagen sin verificar: no se fuerza runAsNonRoot ni se quitan capabilities.
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/automountServiceAccountToken
        value: false
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/securityContext
        value:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Probes TCP al 8080 (sin endpoint de salud verificado). Arranque hasta 180 s.
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/startupProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 36
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/readinessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 10
          failureThreshold: 3
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/livenessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 20
          failureThreshold: 3
    target:
      kind: Deployment

```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/apps/operaciones-estados-back/kustomization.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
# Multizona (docs/plans/manual-configuracion-microservicios-multizona.md):
# HPA 2-4 por CPU, reparto por AZ, PDB, recursos, probes TCP, seguridad del pod.
resources:
  - ../../../../bases/apps/operaciones-estados-back
  - hpa.yaml
  - pdb.yaml
patches:
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/image
        value: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/operaciones-estados-back:0.24.1-beta.2

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/cpu
        value: 999m

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/memory
        value: 999Mi 
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/nodeSelector
        value:
          workload: aplicacion
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/tolerations
        value:
          - key: workload
            operator: Equal
            value: aplicacion
            effect: NoSchedule
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  # Recursos: request de CPU bajo para que las replicas entren en los nodos aplicacion
  # (el HPA escala al 70% de 100m). Memoria: la de la base; ajustar con kubectl top.
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/requests/cpu
        value: 100m
      # Las replicas las maneja el HPA (hpa.yaml).
      - op: remove
        path: /spec/replicas
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Reparto de replicas entre zonas y nodos. Despliegue bajando un pod antes de crear otro:
  # los pods viejos tienen anti-afinidad obligatoria por zona y bloquearian un pod extra.
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/topologySpreadConstraints
        value:
          - maxSkew: 1
            topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
            whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
            nodeTaintsPolicy: Honor
            labelSelector:
              matchLabels:
                app: operaciones-estados-back
            matchLabelKeys:
              - pod-template-hash
          - maxSkew: 1
            topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
            whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
            labelSelector:
              matchLabels:
                app: operaciones-estados-back
            matchLabelKeys:
              - pod-template-hash
      - op: add
        path: /spec/strategy
        value:
          type: RollingUpdate
          rollingUpdate:
            maxSurge: 0
            maxUnavailable: 1
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Seguridad del pod: la base ya corre como no root, pero declara automountServiceAccountToken
  # dentro de securityContext (Kubernetes lo ignora y monta el token). Se mueve al pod.
  - patch: |-
      - op: remove
        path: /spec/template/spec/securityContext/automountServiceAccountToken
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/automountServiceAccountToken
        value: false
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/securityContext/capabilities
        value:
          drop:
            - ALL
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Probes TCP al 8080 (sin endpoint de salud verificado). Arranque hasta 180 s.
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/startupProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 36
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/readinessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 10
          failureThreshold: 3
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/livenessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 20
          failureThreshold: 3
    target:
      kind: Deployment
```


## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/apps/operaciones-fracciones-contado-back/kustomization.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
# Multizona 3 AZ (manual: docs/plans/manual-configuracion-microservicios-multizona.md).
# HPA 3-6 por CPU, reparto 1 por AZ, PDB, probes TCP.
# Kafka: los topics que usa tienen 1 particion; solo 1 replica consume a la vez (las demas
# quedan de respaldo). Escalar ayuda al trafico HTTP (/operations-fractionation-api).
resources:
  - ../../../../bases/apps/operaciones-fracciones-contado-back
  - hpa.yaml
  - pdb.yaml
patches:
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/image
        value: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/operaciones-fracciones-contado-back:0.68.4-beta.3

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/cpu
        value: 999m

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/memory
        value: 999Mi

      # Uso medido ~430Mi (JVM + Kafka + Hibernate): el request de la base (256Mi) quedaba corto.
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/requests/memory
        value: 512Mi

      # Las replicas las maneja el HPA (hpa.yaml).
      - op: remove
        path: /spec/replicas
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/nodeSelector
        value:
          workload: aplicacion
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/tolerations
        value:
          - key: workload
            operator: Equal
            value: aplicacion
            effect: NoSchedule
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Reemplaza la anti-afinidad obligatoria por zona: limitaba a 1 pod por AZ (maximo 3)
  # y por eso no se podia escalar a 6.
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/topologySpreadConstraints
        value:
          - maxSkew: 1
            topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
            whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
            nodeTaintsPolicy: Honor
            labelSelector:
              matchLabels:
                app: operaciones-fracciones-contado-back
            matchLabelKeys:
              - pod-template-hash
          - maxSkew: 1
            topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
            whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
            labelSelector:
              matchLabels:
                app: operaciones-fracciones-contado-back
            matchLabelKeys:
              - pod-template-hash
      - op: add
        path: /spec/strategy
        value:
          type: RollingUpdate
          rollingUpdate:
            maxSurge: 0
            maxUnavailable: 1
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  # Seguridad del pod. La imagen corre como javauser (uid 1001), no como root.
  # No usa la API de Kubernetes ni necesita capabilities de Linux.
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/automountServiceAccountToken
        value: false
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/securityContext
        value:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1001
          runAsGroup: 1001
          seccompProfile:
            type: RuntimeDefault
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/securityContext
        value:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
              - ALL
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  # Probes TCP al 8080: el servicio no expone /actuator/health (404).
  # Arranque no medido (logs rotados): startupProbe tolera hasta 180 s.
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/startupProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 36
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/readinessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 10
          failureThreshold: 3
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/livenessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 20
          failureThreshold: 3
    target:
      kind: Deployment

```

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
# Multizona (docs/plans/manual-configuracion-microservicios-multizona.md):
# HPA 2-4 por CPU, reparto por AZ, PDB, recursos, probes TCP, seguridad del pod.
resources:
  - ../../../../bases/apps/operaciones-front
  - hpa.yaml
  - pdb.yaml
patches:
  - path: ./snippets/config-operaciones-env-variable.yml
  - path: ./snippets/config-operaciones.yml
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/image
        value: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/operaciones-front:0.328.0-rc.14

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/cpu
        value: 999m

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/memory
        value: 999Mi
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/nodeSelector
        value:
          workload: aplicacion
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/tolerations
        value:
          - key: workload
            operator: Equal
            value: aplicacion
            effect: NoSchedule
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  # Recursos: request de CPU bajo para que las replicas entren en los nodos aplicacion
  # (el HPA escala al 70% de 50m). Memoria: la de la base; ajustar con kubectl top.
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/requests/cpu
        value: 50m
      # Las replicas las maneja el HPA (hpa.yaml).
      - op: remove
        path: /spec/replicas
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Reparto de replicas entre zonas y nodos. Despliegue sin corte: crea el pod nuevo
  # antes de bajar el viejo (importante con 1 replica durante la migracion).
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/topologySpreadConstraints
        value:
          - maxSkew: 1
            topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
            whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
            nodeTaintsPolicy: Honor
            labelSelector:
              matchLabels:
                app: operaciones-front-app
            matchLabelKeys:
              - pod-template-hash
          - maxSkew: 1
            topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
            whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
            labelSelector:
              matchLabels:
                app: operaciones-front-app
            matchLabelKeys:
              - pod-template-hash
      - op: add
        path: /spec/strategy
        value:
          type: RollingUpdate
          rollingUpdate:
            maxSurge: 1
            maxUnavailable: 0
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Seguridad del pod: sin token de ServiceAccount (no usa la API de Kubernetes).
  # Usuario de la imagen sin verificar: no se fuerza runAsNonRoot ni se quitan capabilities.
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/automountServiceAccountToken
        value: false
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/securityContext
        value:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Probes TCP al 5006 (sin endpoint de salud verificado). Arranque hasta 120 s.
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/startupProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 5006
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 24
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/readinessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 5006
          periodSeconds: 10
          failureThreshold: 3
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/livenessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 5006
          periodSeconds: 20
          failureThreshold: 3
    target:
      kind: Deployment
```

```yaml
﻿apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/apps/operaciones-front/snippets/config-operaciones.yml

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: config-operaciones
  namespace: nubo-front
data:
  default.conf: |
    server {
        listen       5006;
        listen  [::]:5006;
        server_name  localhost;

        # --- Compresión en runtime ---
        # Si el build de este remote usa vite-plugin-compression
        # (igual que nubo-front), migrar a gzip_static + brotli_static
        # más adelante: mejor ratio y cero costo de CPU por request.
        gzip on;
        gzip_vary on;
        gzip_proxied any;
        gzip_comp_level 6;
        gzip_min_length 256;
        gzip_types
            text/plain
            text/css
            text/xml
            application/json
            application/javascript
            application/xml+rss
            application/atom+xml
            image/svg+xml
            font/woff2;

        # --- Cache de metadata de archivos ---
        open_file_cache max=1000 inactive=20s;
        open_file_cache_valid 30s;
        open_file_cache_min_uses 2;
        open_file_cache_errors on;

        # --- Tuning de sockets, relevante en 3G por latencia alta ---
        sendfile on;
        tcp_nopush on;
        tcp_nodelay on;
        keepalive_timeout 65;

        # Sin CORS: se confirmó que este remote se consume desde el
        # mismo origen/gateway que el host, no hace falta.

        location / {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            index  index.html index.htm;

            # FIX: tiene rutas propias (/operaciones/crear, /detalle, etc).
            # Sin try_files, acceder directo o refrescar en una ruta
            # interna devuelve 404.
            try_files $uri /index.html;

            # index.html nunca se cachea: referencia los chunks con
            # hash de cada build.
            add_header Cache-Control "no-cache, must-revalidate" always;
        }

        # remoteEntry.js NO debe cachearse largo: es el manifest que el
        # host lee para saber qué versión de este remote cargar.
        location = /assets/remoteEntry.js {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            add_header Cache-Control "no-cache, must-revalidate" always;
        }

        location /assets/ {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            types {
                application/javascript js;
                text/css css;
                image/svg+xml svg;
                application/json json;
                font/woff2 woff2;
            }
            # Cache largo e inmutable: válido si estos archivos tienen
            # hash en el nombre (patrón estándar de Vite/Webpack).
            # Antes tenía no-cache/no-store, forzando redescarga
            # completa en cada visita — el mayor costo en 3G.
            add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=31536000, immutable" always;
        }

        error_page  404              /404.html;
        error_page  500 502 503 504  /50x.html;
        location = /50x.html {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
        }
    }

```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/apps/operaciones-orquestador-ext-back/kustomization.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
# Multizona (docs/plans/manual-configuracion-microservicios-multizona.md):
# HPA 2-4 por CPU, reparto por AZ, PDB, recursos, probes TCP, seguridad del pod.
resources:
  - ../../../../bases/apps/operaciones-orquestador-ext-back
  - ./configmap-env-variable.yaml
  - hpa.yaml
  - pdb.yaml
patches:
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/image
        value: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/operaciones-orquestador-ext-back:0.8.12-beta.16

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/cpu
        value: 999m

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/memory
        value: 999Mi 
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/nodeSelector
        value:
          workload: aplicacion
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/tolerations
        value:
          - key: workload
            operator: Equal
            value: aplicacion
            effect: NoSchedule
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  # Recursos: request de CPU bajo para que las replicas entren en los nodos aplicacion
  # (el HPA escala al 70% de 100m). Memoria: la de la base; ajustar con kubectl top.
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/requests/cpu
        value: 100m
      # Las replicas las maneja el HPA (hpa.yaml).
      - op: remove
        path: /spec/replicas
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Reparto de replicas entre zonas y nodos. Despliegue sin corte: crea el pod nuevo
  # antes de bajar el viejo (importante con 1 replica durante la migracion).
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/topologySpreadConstraints
        value:
          - maxSkew: 1
            topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
            whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
            nodeTaintsPolicy: Honor
            labelSelector:
              matchLabels:
                app: operaciones-orquestador-ext-back
            matchLabelKeys:
              - pod-template-hash
          - maxSkew: 1
            topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
            whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
            labelSelector:
              matchLabels:
                app: operaciones-orquestador-ext-back
            matchLabelKeys:
              - pod-template-hash
      - op: add
        path: /spec/strategy
        value:
          type: RollingUpdate
          rollingUpdate:
            maxSurge: 1
            maxUnavailable: 0
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Seguridad del pod: sin token de ServiceAccount (no usa la API de Kubernetes).
  # Usuario de la imagen sin verificar: no se fuerza runAsNonRoot ni se quitan capabilities.
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/automountServiceAccountToken
        value: false
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/securityContext
        value:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Probes TCP al 8080: sin Service, pero escucha en el 8080 (verificado en /proc/net/tcp6 el 28/09).
  # Arranque medido 14-20 s; startupProbe tolera hasta 180 s.
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/startupProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 36
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/readinessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 10
          failureThreshold: 3
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/livenessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 20
          failureThreshold: 3
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/volumeMounts
        value:
          - name: cause-catalog
            mountPath: /app/config
            readOnly: true
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/volumes
        value:
          - name: cause-catalog
            configMap:
              name: api-client-cause-catalog
              optional: true
    target:
      kind: Deployment
```


## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/apps/operaciones-query-back/kustomization.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
# Piloto multizona (manual: docs/plans/manual-configuracion-microservicios-multizona.md).
# 3 AZ: HPA 6-9 por CPU (2 a 3 por AZ), reparto por zona, PDB y probes TCP (el servicio no expone Actuator).
resources:
  - ../../../../bases/apps/operaciones-query-back
  - hpa.yaml
  - pdb.yaml
patches:
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/image
        value: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/operaciones-query-back:0.99.0-beta.12

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/cpu
        value: 999m

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/memory
        value: 999Mi

      # Las replicas las maneja el HPA (hpa.yaml). Si el Deployment fijara un numero,
      # Flux lo reaplicaria en cada reconciliacion y pelearia con el HPA.
      - op: remove
        path: /spec/replicas
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/nodeSelector
        value:
          workload: aplicacion
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/tolerations
        value:
          - key: workload
            operator: Equal
            value: aplicacion
            effect: NoSchedule
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  # Multizona: 3 AZ. Reemplaza la anti-afinidad obligatoria (limitaba a 3 replicas).
  # Zona: obligatorio (maxSkew 1). Nodo: preferido. matchLabelKeys: cada rollout reparte 1 por AZ.
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/topologySpreadConstraints
        value:
          - maxSkew: 1
            topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
            whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
            nodeTaintsPolicy: Honor
            labelSelector:
              matchLabels:
                app: operaciones-query-back
            matchLabelKeys:
              - pod-template-hash
          - maxSkew: 1
            topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
            whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
            labelSelector:
              matchLabels:
                app: operaciones-query-back
            matchLabelKeys:
              - pod-template-hash
      # Rollout de a un pod: no requiere capacidad extra (nodos aplicacion al 73-80% de CPU
      # pedida) y permite migrar desde la anti-afinidad obligatoria sin bloquearse.
      - op: add
        path: /spec/strategy
        value:
          type: RollingUpdate
          rollingUpdate:
            maxSurge: 0
            maxUnavailable: 1
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  # Seguridad del pod. La base declara automountServiceAccountToken dentro de securityContext,
  # donde Kubernetes lo ignora (el token se monta igual): se mueve al nivel del pod.
  # El servicio no usa la API de Kubernetes. Sin capabilities de Linux (Spring Boot en 8080 no las necesita).
  - patch: |-
      - op: remove
        path: /spec/template/spec/securityContext/automountServiceAccountToken
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/automountServiceAccountToken
        value: false
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/securityContext/capabilities
        value:
          drop:
            - ALL
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  # Probes por TCP al 8080: el servicio no expone /actuator/health (404). Arranque medido: ~21 s.
  # Pasar a HTTP cuando la app exponga Actuator (ver manual).
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/startupProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 24
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/readinessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 10
          failureThreshold: 3
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/livenessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 20
          failureThreshold: 3
    target:
      kind: Deployment

```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/apps/opes-borde-respuesta-back/kustomization.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - ../../../../bases/apps/opes-borde-respuesta-back
  - hpa.yaml
  - pdb.yaml
patches:
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/image
        value: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/ops-boundary-response:0.12.0

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/cpu
        value: 999m

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/memory
        value: 999Mi
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/nodeSelector
        value:
          workload: aplicacion
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/tolerations
        value:
          - key: workload
            operator: Equal
            value: aplicacion
            effect: NoSchedule
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  # Alta disponibilidad multizona: HPA 2-4, PDB, reparto por zona y rollout sin corte.
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/requests/cpu
        value: 100m
      - op: remove
        path: /spec/replicas
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/topologySpreadConstraints
        value:
        - maxSkew: 1
          topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
          whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
          nodeTaintsPolicy: Honor
          labelSelector:
            matchLabels: &id001
              app: opes-borde-respuesta-back
          matchLabelKeys:
          - pod-template-hash
        - maxSkew: 1
          topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
          whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
          labelSelector:
            matchLabels: *id001
          matchLabelKeys:
          - pod-template-hash
      - op: add
        path: /spec/strategy
        value:
          type: RollingUpdate
          rollingUpdate:
            maxSurge: 1
            maxUnavailable: 0
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/automountServiceAccountToken
        value: false
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/securityContext/allowPrivilegeEscalation
        value: false
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/startupProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 36
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/readinessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 10
          failureThreshold: 3
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/livenessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 20
          failureThreshold: 3
    target:
      kind: Deployment
      name: opes-borde-respuesta-back-app

```

```yaml
      target:
```


## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/apps/otcloan-account-adapter/kustomization.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
- ../../../../bases/apps/otcloan-account-adapter
- hpa.yaml
- pdb.yaml
patches:
  - path: ./snippets/configmap-account-adapter.yaml
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/image
        value: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/nbo-png-account-adapter:0.34.0-rc.1
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/nodeSelector
        value:
          workload: aplicacion
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/tolerations
        value:
          - key: workload
            operator: Equal
            value: aplicacion
            effect: NoSchedule
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  # Alta disponibilidad multizona: HPA 2-4, PDB, reparto por zona y rollout sin corte.
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources
        value:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 512Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 999m
            memory: 999Mi
      - op: remove
        path: /spec/replicas
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/topologySpreadConstraints
        value:
        - maxSkew: 1
          topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
          whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
          nodeTaintsPolicy: Honor
          labelSelector:
            matchLabels: &id001
              app: nbo-png-account-adapter
          matchLabelKeys:
          - pod-template-hash
        - maxSkew: 1
          topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
          whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
          labelSelector:
            matchLabels: *id001
          matchLabelKeys:
          - pod-template-hash
      - op: add
        path: /spec/strategy
        value:
          type: RollingUpdate
          rollingUpdate:
            maxSurge: 1
            maxUnavailable: 0
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/automountServiceAccountToken
        value: false
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/securityContext
        value:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/startupProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8000
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 36
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/readinessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8000
          periodSeconds: 10
          failureThreshold: 3
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/livenessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8000
          periodSeconds: 20
          failureThreshold: 3
    target:
      kind: Deployment
      name: nbo-png-account-adapter

```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/apps/paquetes-custodios-cmd-back/kustomization.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
# Multizona (docs/plans/manual-configuracion-microservicios-multizona.md):
# HPA 2-4 por CPU, reparto por AZ, PDB, recursos, probes TCP, seguridad del pod.
resources:
  - ../../../../bases/apps/paquetes-custodios-cmd-back
  - hpa.yaml
  - pdb.yaml
patches:
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/image
        value: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/paquetes-custodios-cmd-back:0.19.0-rc.1

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/cpu
        value: 999m

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/memory
        value: 999Mi 
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/nodeSelector
        value:
          workload: aplicacion
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/tolerations
        value:
          - key: workload
            operator: Equal
            value: aplicacion
            effect: NoSchedule
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  # Recursos: request de CPU bajo para que las replicas entren en los nodos aplicacion
  # (el HPA escala al 70% de 100m). Memoria: la de la base; ajustar con kubectl top.
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/requests/cpu
        value: 100m
      # Las replicas las maneja el HPA (hpa.yaml).
      - op: remove
        path: /spec/replicas
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Reparto de replicas entre zonas y nodos. Despliegue sin corte: crea el pod nuevo
  # antes de bajar el viejo (importante con 1 replica durante la migracion).
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/topologySpreadConstraints
        value:
          - maxSkew: 1
            topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
            whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
            nodeTaintsPolicy: Honor
            labelSelector:
              matchLabels:
                app: paquetes-custodios-cmd-back
            matchLabelKeys:
              - pod-template-hash
          - maxSkew: 1
            topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
            whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
            labelSelector:
              matchLabels:
                app: paquetes-custodios-cmd-back
            matchLabelKeys:
              - pod-template-hash
      - op: add
        path: /spec/strategy
        value:
          type: RollingUpdate
          rollingUpdate:
            maxSurge: 1
            maxUnavailable: 0
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Seguridad del pod: la base ya corre como no root, pero declara automountServiceAccountToken
  # dentro de securityContext (Kubernetes lo ignora y monta el token). Se mueve al pod.
  - patch: |-
      - op: remove
        path: /spec/template/spec/securityContext/automountServiceAccountToken
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/automountServiceAccountToken
        value: false
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/securityContext/capabilities
        value:
          drop:
            - ALL
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Probes TCP al 8080 (sin endpoint de salud verificado). Arranque hasta 180 s.
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/startupProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 36
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/readinessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 10
          failureThreshold: 3
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/livenessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 20
          failureThreshold: 3
    target:
      kind: Deployment

```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/apps/parent-container-front/snippets/config-parent-container.yml

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: config-parent-container
  namespace: nubo-front
data:
  default.conf: |
    server {
        listen       5000;
        listen  [::]:5000;
        server_name  localhost;
        #access_log  /var/log/nginx/host.access.log  main;
        gzip on;
        gzip_vary on;
        gzip_comp_level 6;
        gzip_min_length 1024;
        gzip_types
            text/plain
            text/css
            text/xml
            text/javascript
            application/json
            application/javascript
            application/xml
            image/svg+xml;
        location / {
            if ($request_method = 'OPTIONS') {
                 add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' '*';
                 add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods' 'GET, POST, OPTIONS, DELETE, PUT, PATCH';
                 add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers' 'Authorization, Content-Type';
                 add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Credentials' 'true';
                  return 204;
            }
            add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' '*';
            add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods' 'GET, POST, OPTIONS, DELETE, PUT, PATCH';
            add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers' 'Authorization, Content-Type';
            add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Credentials' 'true';
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            index  index.html index.htm;
            try_files $uri /index.html;
            add_header Cache-Control "no-cache, must-revalidate" always;
        }
        location = /assets/remoteEntry.js {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            add_header Cache-Control "no-cache, must-revalidate" always;
        }
        location /assets/ {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=31536000, immutable";
            try_files $uri =404;
        }
        error_page  404              /404.html;
        # redirect server error pages to the static page /50x.html
        #
        error_page   500 502 503 504  /50x.html;
        location = /50x.html {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
        }
        # proxy the PHP scripts to Apache listening on 127.0.0.1:80
        #
        #location ~ \.php$ {
        #    proxy_pass   http://127.0.0.1;
        #}
        # pass the PHP scripts to FastCGI server listening on 127.0.0.1:9000
        #
        #location ~ \.php$ {
        #    root           html;
        #    fastcgi_pass   127.0.0.1:9000;
        #    fastcgi_index  index.php;
        #    fastcgi_param  SCRIPT_FILENAME  /scripts$fastcgi_script_name;
        #    include        fastcgi_params;
        #}
        # deny access to .htaccess files, if Apache's document root
        # concurs with nginx's one
        #
        #location ~ /\.ht {
        #    deny  all;
        #}
    }
```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/apps/perfiles-cmd-back/kustomization.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
# Multizona (docs/plans/manual-configuracion-microservicios-multizona.md):
# HPA 2-4 por CPU, reparto por AZ, PDB, recursos, probes TCP, seguridad del pod.
resources:
  - ../../../../bases/apps/perfiles-cmd-back
  - hpa.yaml
  - pdb.yaml
patches:
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/image
        value: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/perfiles-cmd-back:0.10.1-rc.1

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/cpu
        value: 999m

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/memory
        value: 999Mi
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/nodeSelector
        value:
          workload: aplicacion
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/tolerations
        value:
          - key: workload
            operator: Equal
            value: aplicacion
            effect: NoSchedule
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  # Recursos: request de CPU bajo para que las replicas entren en los nodos aplicacion
  # (el HPA escala al 70% de 100m). Memoria: la de la base; ajustar con kubectl top.
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/requests/cpu
        value: 100m
      # Las replicas las maneja el HPA (hpa.yaml).
      - op: remove
        path: /spec/replicas
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Reparto de replicas entre zonas y nodos. Despliegue sin corte: crea el pod nuevo
  # antes de bajar el viejo (importante con 1 replica durante la migracion).
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/topologySpreadConstraints
        value:
          - maxSkew: 1
            topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
            whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
            nodeTaintsPolicy: Honor
            labelSelector:
              matchLabels:
                app: perfiles-cmd-back
            matchLabelKeys:
              - pod-template-hash
          - maxSkew: 1
            topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
            whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
            labelSelector:
              matchLabels:
                app: perfiles-cmd-back
            matchLabelKeys:
              - pod-template-hash
      - op: add
        path: /spec/strategy
        value:
          type: RollingUpdate
          rollingUpdate:
            maxSurge: 1
            maxUnavailable: 0
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Seguridad del pod: la base ya corre como no root, pero declara automountServiceAccountToken
  # dentro de securityContext (Kubernetes lo ignora y monta el token). Se mueve al pod.
  - patch: |-
      - op: remove
        path: /spec/template/spec/securityContext/automountServiceAccountToken
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/automountServiceAccountToken
        value: false
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/securityContext/capabilities
        value:
          drop:
            - ALL
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Probes TCP al 8080 (sin endpoint de salud verificado). Arranque hasta 180 s.
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/startupProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 36
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/readinessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 10
          failureThreshold: 3
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/livenessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 20
          failureThreshold: 3
    target:
      kind: Deployment

```

```yaml
  - ../../../../bases/apps/perfiles-query-back
  - hpa.yaml
  - pdb.yaml
patches:
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/image
        value: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/perfiles-query-back:0.20.0-rc.1

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/cpu
        value: 999m

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/memory
        value: 999Mi
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/nodeSelector
        value:
          workload: aplicacion
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/tolerations
        value:
          - key: workload
            operator: Equal
            value: aplicacion
            effect: NoSchedule
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  # Recursos: request de CPU bajo para que las replicas entren en los nodos aplicacion
  # (el HPA escala al 70% de 100m). Memoria: la de la base; ajustar con kubectl top.
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/requests/cpu
        value: 100m
      # Las replicas las maneja el HPA (hpa.yaml).
      - op: remove
        path: /spec/replicas
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Reparto de replicas entre zonas y nodos. Despliegue sin corte: crea el pod nuevo
  # antes de bajar el viejo (importante con 1 replica durante la migracion).
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/topologySpreadConstraints
        value:
          - maxSkew: 1
            topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
            whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
            nodeTaintsPolicy: Honor
            labelSelector:
              matchLabels:
                app: perfiles-query-back
            matchLabelKeys:
              - pod-template-hash
          - maxSkew: 1
            topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
            whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
            labelSelector:
              matchLabels:
                app: perfiles-query-back
            matchLabelKeys:
              - pod-template-hash
      - op: add
        path: /spec/strategy
        value:
          type: RollingUpdate
          rollingUpdate:
            maxSurge: 1
            maxUnavailable: 0
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Seguridad del pod: la base ya corre como no root, pero declara automountServiceAccountToken
  # dentro de securityContext (Kubernetes lo ignora y monta el token). Se mueve al pod.
  - patch: |-
      - op: remove
        path: /spec/template/spec/securityContext/automountServiceAccountToken
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/automountServiceAccountToken
        value: false
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/securityContext/capabilities
        value:
          drop:
            - ALL
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Probes TCP al 8080 (sin endpoint de salud verificado). Arranque hasta 180 s.
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/startupProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 36
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/readinessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 10
          failureThreshold: 3
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/livenessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 20
          failureThreshold: 3
    target:
      kind: Deployment

```

```yaml
kind: Kustomization
# Multizona (docs/plans/manual-configuracion-microservicios-multizona.md):

patches:

        value: 999m
        
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/memory
        value: 999Mi

      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/-
        value:
          name: KAFKA_NUBO_DATA_PREFIX_FOLIO
          value: "true"
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/-
        value:
          name: KAFKA_NUBO_DATA_COUNTRY
          value: "CO"
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/nodeSelector
        value:
          workload: aplicacion
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/tolerations
        value:
          - key: workload
            operator: Equal
            value: aplicacion
            effect: NoSchedule
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  # Recursos: request de CPU bajo para que las replicas entren en los nodos aplicacion
  # (el HPA escala al 70% de 100m). Memoria: la de la base; ajustar con kubectl top.
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/requests/cpu
        value: 100m
      # Las replicas las maneja el HPA (hpa.yaml).
      - op: remove
        path: /spec/replicas
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Reparto de replicas entre zonas y nodos. Despliegue sin corte: crea el pod nuevo
  # antes de bajar el viejo (importante con 1 replica durante la migracion).
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/topologySpreadConstraints
        value:
          - maxSkew: 1
            topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
            whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
            nodeTaintsPolicy: Honor
            labelSelector:
              matchLabels:
                app: persistencia-data-nasdaq-back
            matchLabelKeys:
              - pod-template-hash
          - maxSkew: 1
            topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
            whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
            labelSelector:
              matchLabels:
                app: persistencia-data-nasdaq-back
            matchLabelKeys:
              - pod-template-hash
      - op: add
        path: /spec/strategy
        value:
          type: RollingUpdate
          rollingUpdate:
            maxSurge: 1
            maxUnavailable: 0
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Seguridad del pod: la base ya corre como no root, pero declara automountServiceAccountToken
  # dentro de securityContext (Kubernetes lo ignora y monta el token). Se mueve al pod.
  - patch: |-
      - op: remove
        path: /spec/template/spec/securityContext/automountServiceAccountToken
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/automountServiceAccountToken
        value: false
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/securityContext/capabilities
        value:
          drop:
            - ALL
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Probes TCP al 8080: sin Service, pero escucha en el 8080 (verificado en /proc/net/tcp6 el 28/09).
  # Arranque medido 14-20 s; startupProbe tolera hasta 180 s.
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/startupProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 36
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/readinessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 10
          failureThreshold: 3
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/livenessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 20
          failureThreshold: 3
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Anotación de contexto de seguridad de Dynatrace (perfilamiento de usuarios). Solo producción.
  - target:
      kind: Namespace
    patch: |-
      apiVersion: v1
      kind: Namespace
      metadata:
        name: todos-los-namespaces
        annotations:
          metadata.dynatrace.com/dt.security_context: SC-NUBO
```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/apps/rd-sincronizacion-cuentas-banco-participantes-back/kustomization.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
# Multizona (docs/plans/manual-configuracion-microservicios-multizona.md):
# HPA 2-4 por CPU, reparto por AZ, PDB, recursos, probes TCP, seguridad del pod.
resources:
  - ../../../../bases/apps/rd-sincronizacion-cuentas-banco-participantes-back
  - hpa.yaml
  - pdb.yaml
patches:
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/image
        value: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/sincronizacion-cuentas-banco-participantes-back:0.3.0-beta.1

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/cpu
        value: 999m

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/memory
        value: 999Mi
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/nodeSelector
        value:
          workload: aplicacion
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/tolerations
        value:
          - key: workload
            operator: Equal
            value: aplicacion
            effect: NoSchedule
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  # Recursos: request de CPU bajo para que las replicas entren en los nodos aplicacion
  # (el HPA escala al 70% de 100m). Memoria: la de la base; ajustar con kubectl top.
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/requests/cpu
        value: 100m
      # Las replicas las maneja el HPA (hpa.yaml).
      - op: remove
        path: /spec/replicas
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Reparto de replicas entre zonas y nodos. Despliegue sin corte: crea el pod nuevo
  # antes de bajar el viejo (importante con 1 replica durante la migracion).
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/topologySpreadConstraints
        value:
          - maxSkew: 1
            topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
            whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
            nodeTaintsPolicy: Honor
            labelSelector:
              matchLabels:
                app: sincronizacion-cuentas-banco-participantes-back
            matchLabelKeys:
              - pod-template-hash
          - maxSkew: 1
            topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
            whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
            labelSelector:
              matchLabels:
                app: sincronizacion-cuentas-banco-participantes-back
            matchLabelKeys:
              - pod-template-hash
      - op: add
        path: /spec/strategy
        value:
          type: RollingUpdate
          rollingUpdate:
            maxSurge: 1
            maxUnavailable: 0
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Seguridad del pod: la base ya corre como no root, pero declara automountServiceAccountToken
  # dentro de securityContext (Kubernetes lo ignora y monta el token). Se mueve al pod.
  - patch: |-
      - op: remove
        path: /spec/template/spec/securityContext/automountServiceAccountToken
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/automountServiceAccountToken
        value: false
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/securityContext/capabilities
        value:
          drop:
            - ALL
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Probes TCP al 8080: sin Service, pero escucha en el 8080 (verificado en /proc/net/tcp6 el 28/09).
  # Arranque medido 14-20 s; startupProbe tolera hasta 180 s.
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/startupProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 36
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/readinessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 10
          failureThreshold: 3
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/livenessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 20
          failureThreshold: 3
    target:
      kind: Deployment

```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/apps/rd-sincronizacion-participantes-eq-back/kustomization.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
# Multizona (docs/plans/manual-configuracion-microservicios-multizona.md):
# HPA 2-4 por CPU, reparto por AZ, PDB, recursos, seguridad del pod.
# Sin probes: no tiene Service y no esta verificado que escuche en el 8080.
resources:
  - ../../../../bases/apps/rd-sincronizacion-participantes-eq-back
  - hpa.yaml
  - pdb.yaml
patches:
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/image
        value: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/sincronizacion-participantes-equivalencia-back:0.4.1-rc.1

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/cpu
        value: 999m

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/memory
        value: 999Mi
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/nodeSelector
        value:
          workload: aplicacion
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/tolerations
        value:
          - key: workload
            operator: Equal
            value: aplicacion
            effect: NoSchedule
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  # Recursos: request de CPU bajo para que las replicas entren en los nodos aplicacion
  # (el HPA escala al 70% de 100m). Memoria: la de la base; ajustar con kubectl top.
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/requests/cpu
        value: 100m
      # Las replicas las maneja el HPA (hpa.yaml).
      - op: remove
        path: /spec/replicas
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Reparto de replicas entre zonas y nodos. Despliegue sin corte: crea el pod nuevo
  # antes de bajar el viejo (importante con 1 replica durante la migracion).
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/topologySpreadConstraints
        value:
          - maxSkew: 1
            topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
            whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
            nodeTaintsPolicy: Honor
            labelSelector:
              matchLabels:
                app: sincronizacion-participantes-equivalencia-back
            matchLabelKeys:
              - pod-template-hash
          - maxSkew: 1
            topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
            whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
            labelSelector:
              matchLabels:
                app: sincronizacion-participantes-equivalencia-back
            matchLabelKeys:
              - pod-template-hash
      - op: add
        path: /spec/strategy
        value:
          type: RollingUpdate
          rollingUpdate:
            maxSurge: 1
            maxUnavailable: 0
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Seguridad del pod: la base ya corre como no root, pero declara automountServiceAccountToken
  # dentro de securityContext (Kubernetes lo ignora y monta el token). Se mueve al pod.
  - patch: |-
      - op: remove
        path: /spec/template/spec/securityContext/automountServiceAccountToken
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/automountServiceAccountToken
        value: false
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/securityContext/capabilities
        value:
          drop:
            - ALL
    target:
      kind: Deployment

```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/apps/reglas-negocio-horarios-back/kustomization.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
# Multizona (docs/plans/manual-configuracion-microservicios-multizona.md):
# HPA 2-4 por CPU, reparto por AZ, PDB, recursos, probes TCP, seguridad del pod.
resources:
- ../../../../bases/apps/reglas-negocio-horarios-back
- hpa.yaml
- pdb.yaml
patches:
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/image
        value: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/reglas-negocio-horarios-back:0.13.0

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/cpu
        value: 999m

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/memory
        value: 999Mi
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/nodeSelector
        value:
          workload: aplicacion
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/tolerations
        value:
          - key: workload
            operator: Equal
            value: aplicacion
            effect: NoSchedule
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  # Recursos: request de CPU bajo para que las replicas entren en los nodos aplicacion
  # (el HPA escala al 70% de 100m). Memoria: la de la base; ajustar con kubectl top.
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/requests/cpu
        value: 100m
      # Las replicas las maneja el HPA (hpa.yaml).
      - op: remove
        path: /spec/replicas
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Reparto de replicas entre zonas y nodos. Despliegue sin corte: crea el pod nuevo
  # antes de bajar el viejo (importante con 1 replica durante la migracion).
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/topologySpreadConstraints
        value:
          - maxSkew: 1
            topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
            whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
            nodeTaintsPolicy: Honor
            labelSelector:
              matchLabels:
                app: reglas-negocio-horarios-back
            matchLabelKeys:
              - pod-template-hash
          - maxSkew: 1
            topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
            whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
            labelSelector:
              matchLabels:
                app: reglas-negocio-horarios-back
            matchLabelKeys:
              - pod-template-hash
      - op: add
        path: /spec/strategy
        value:
          type: RollingUpdate
          rollingUpdate:
            maxSurge: 1
            maxUnavailable: 0
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Seguridad del pod: sin token de ServiceAccount (no usa la API de Kubernetes).
  # Usuario de la imagen sin verificar: no se fuerza runAsNonRoot ni se quitan capabilities.
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/automountServiceAccountToken
        value: false
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/securityContext
        value:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Probes TCP al 8080 (sin endpoint de salud verificado). Arranque hasta 180 s.
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/startupProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 36
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/readinessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 10
          failureThreshold: 3
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/livenessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 20
          failureThreshold: 3
    target:
      kind: Deployment

```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/apps/reportes-descarga-cmd/kustomization.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
# Multizona (docs/plans/manual-configuracion-microservicios-multizona.md):
# HPA 2-4 por CPU, reparto por AZ, PDB, recursos, probes TCP, seguridad del pod.
resources:
  - ../../../../bases/apps/reportes-descarga-cmd
  - hpa.yaml
  - pdb.yaml
patches:
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/image
        value: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/reportes-descarga-cmd:0.12.1-beta.1

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/cpu
        value: 999m

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/memory
        value: 999Mi
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/nodeSelector
        value:
          workload: aplicacion
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/tolerations
        value:
          - key: workload
            operator: Equal
            value: aplicacion
            effect: NoSchedule
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  # Recursos: request de CPU bajo para que las replicas entren en los nodos aplicacion
  # (el HPA escala al 70% de 100m). Memoria: la de la base; ajustar con kubectl top.
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/requests/cpu
        value: 100m
      # Las replicas las maneja el HPA (hpa.yaml).
      - op: remove
        path: /spec/replicas
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Reparto de replicas entre zonas y nodos. Despliegue sin corte: crea el pod nuevo
  # antes de bajar el viejo (importante con 1 replica durante la migracion).
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/topologySpreadConstraints
        value:
          - maxSkew: 1
            topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
            whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
            nodeTaintsPolicy: Honor
            labelSelector:
              matchLabels:
                app: reportes-descarga-cmd
            matchLabelKeys:
              - pod-template-hash
          - maxSkew: 1
            topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
            whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
            labelSelector:
              matchLabels:
                app: reportes-descarga-cmd
            matchLabelKeys:
              - pod-template-hash
      - op: add
        path: /spec/strategy
        value:
          type: RollingUpdate
          rollingUpdate:
            maxSurge: 1
            maxUnavailable: 0
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Seguridad del pod: sin token de ServiceAccount (no usa la API de Kubernetes).
  # Usuario de la imagen sin verificar: no se fuerza runAsNonRoot ni se quitan capabilities.
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/automountServiceAccountToken
        value: false
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/securityContext
        value:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Probes TCP al 8080 (sin endpoint de salud verificado). Arranque hasta 180 s.
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/startupProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 36
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/readinessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 10
          failureThreshold: 3
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/livenessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 20
          failureThreshold: 3
    target:
      kind: Deployment

```

```yaml
patches:
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/image
        value: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/respuesta-liquidacion-deceval-back:0.10.1

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/cpu
        value: 999m

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/memory
        value: 999Mi
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/nodeSelector
        value:
          workload: aplicacion
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/tolerations
        value:
          - key: workload
            operator: Equal
            value: aplicacion
            effect: NoSchedule
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  # Alta disponibilidad multizona: HPA 2-4, PDB, reparto por zona y rollout sin corte.
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/requests/cpu
        value: 100m
      - op: remove
        path: /spec/replicas
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/topologySpreadConstraints
        value:
        - maxSkew: 1
          topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
          whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
          nodeTaintsPolicy: Honor
          labelSelector:
            matchLabels: &id001
              app: respuesta-liquidacion-deceval-back
          matchLabelKeys:
          - pod-template-hash
        - maxSkew: 1
          topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
          whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
          labelSelector:
            matchLabels: *id001
          matchLabelKeys:
          - pod-template-hash
      - op: add
        path: /spec/strategy
        value:
          type: RollingUpdate
          rollingUpdate:
            maxSurge: 1
            maxUnavailable: 0
      - op: remove
        path: /spec/template/spec/securityContext/automountServiceAccountToken
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/automountServiceAccountToken
        value: false
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/securityContext/allowPrivilegeEscalation
        value: false
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/startupProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 36
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/readinessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 10
          failureThreshold: 3
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/livenessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 20
          failureThreshold: 3
    target:
      kind: Deployment
      name: respuesta-liquidacion-deceval-back-app
```


## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/apps/sqlite-multizone-poc/scenarios/independent-rwo-3az/statefulset.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: sqlite-independent
  namespace: poc-sqlite-multizone
spec:
  serviceName: sqlite-independent
  replicas: 3
  podManagementPolicy: Parallel
  persistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy:
    whenDeleted: Delete
    whenScaled: Retain
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: sqlite-independent
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: sqlite-independent
    spec:
      nodeSelector:
        workload: aplicacion
      tolerations:
        - key: workload
          operator: Equal
          value: aplicacion
          effect: NoSchedule
      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:
          requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
            - labelSelector:
                matchLabels:
                  app: sqlite-independent
              topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: sqlite-demo
          image: python:3.13-alpine
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          command: ["python", "/app/app.py"]
          env:
            - name: POD_NAME
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: metadata.name
            - name: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE
              value: "1"
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8080
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 5
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 10
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 25m
              memory: 32Mi
              ephemeral-storage: 32Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
              ephemeral-storage: 128Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          volumeMounts:
            - name: app
              mountPath: /app
              readOnly: true
            - name: data
              mountPath: /data
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp
      volumes:
        - name: app
          configMap:
            name: sqlite-demo-app
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir: {}
  volumeClaimTemplates:
    - metadata:
        name: data
      spec:
        accessModes:
          - ReadWriteOnce
        storageClassName: ebs-sc-gp3
        resources:
          requests:
            storage: 1Gi
```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/apps/sqlite-multizone-poc/scenarios/stateless-3az/deployment.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: sqlite-stateless
  namespace: poc-sqlite-multizone
spec:
  replicas: 3
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxUnavailable: 1
      maxSurge: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: sqlite-stateless
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: sqlite-stateless
    spec:
      nodeSelector:
        workload: aplicacion
      tolerations:
        - key: workload
          operator: Equal
          value: aplicacion
          effect: NoSchedule
      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:
          requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
            - labelSelector:
                matchLabels:
                  app: sqlite-stateless
              topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: sqlite-demo
          image: python:3.13-alpine
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          command: ["python", "/app/app.py"]
          env:
            - name: DB_PATH
              value: /data/demo.db
            - name: POD_NAME
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: metadata.name
            - name: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE
              value: "1"
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8080
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 5
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 10
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 25m
              memory: 32Mi
              ephemeral-storage: 32Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
              ephemeral-storage: 128Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          volumeMounts:
            - name: app
              mountPath: /app
              readOnly: true
            - name: data
              mountPath: /data
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp
      volumes:
        - name: app
          configMap:
            name: sqlite-demo-app
        - name: data
          emptyDir:
            sizeLimit: 256Mi
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir:
            sizeLimit: 64Mi
```

```yaml
    value:
```

```yaml
          secretKeyRef:

      - name: DB_PASSWORD
        valueFrom:
          secretKeyRef:
            name: secret-from-vault
            key: DB_PASSWORD
      - name: DB_URL
        valueFrom:
          configMapKeyRef:
            name: nubo-back-configmap
            key: DB_URL
      - name: DB_HIKARI_MAXIMUM_POOL_SIZE
        valueFrom:
          configMapKeyRef:
            name: nubo-back-configmap
            key: DB_HIKARI_MAXIMUM_POOL_SIZE
      - name: DB_HIKARI_MINIMUM_IDLE
        valueFrom:
          configMapKeyRef:
            name: nubo-back-configmap
            key: DB_HIKARI_MINIMUM_IDLE
      - name: DB_HIKARI_IDLE_TIMEOUT
        valueFrom:
          configMapKeyRef:
            name: nubo-back-configmap
            key: DB_HIKARI_IDLE_TIMEOUT
```
