## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/apps/transformador-masivo-operaciones-back/kustomization.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - ../../../../bases/apps/transformador-masivo-operaciones-back
  - hpa.yaml
  - pdb.yaml
patches:
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/image
        value: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/transformador-masivo-operaciones-back:0.4.0

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/cpu
        value: 999m

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/memory
        value: 999Mi
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/nodeSelector
        value:
          workload: aplicacion
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/tolerations
        value:
          - key: workload
            operator: Equal
            value: aplicacion
            effect: NoSchedule
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  # Alta disponibilidad multizona: HPA 2-4, PDB, reparto por zona y rollout sin corte.
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/requests/cpu
        value: 100m
      - op: remove
        path: /spec/replicas
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/topologySpreadConstraints
        value:
        - maxSkew: 1
          topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
          whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
          nodeTaintsPolicy: Honor
          labelSelector:
            matchLabels: &id001
              app: transformador-masivo-operaciones-back
          matchLabelKeys:
          - pod-template-hash
        - maxSkew: 1
          topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
          whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
          labelSelector:
            matchLabels: *id001
          matchLabelKeys:
          - pod-template-hash
      - op: add
        path: /spec/strategy
        value:
          type: RollingUpdate
          rollingUpdate:
            maxSurge: 1
            maxUnavailable: 0
      - op: remove
        path: /spec/template/spec/securityContext/automountServiceAccountToken
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/automountServiceAccountToken
        value: false
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/securityContext/allowPrivilegeEscalation
        value: false
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/startupProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 36
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/readinessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 10
          failureThreshold: 3
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/livenessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 20
          failureThreshold: 3
    target:
      kind: Deployment
      name: transformador-masivo-operaciones-back-app

```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/apps/utilities-front/kustomization.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
# Multizona (docs/plans/manual-configuracion-microservicios-multizona.md):
# HPA 2-4 por CPU, reparto por AZ, PDB, recursos, probes TCP, seguridad del pod.
resources:
  - ../../../../bases/apps/utilities-front
  - hpa.yaml
  - pdb.yaml
patches:
  - path: ./snippets/config-utilities-env-variable.yml
  - path: ./snippets/config-utilities.yml
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/image
        value: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/utilities-front:0.252.1-rc.6

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/cpu
        value: 999m

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/memory
        value: 999Mi
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/nodeSelector
        value:
          workload: aplicacion
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/tolerations
        value:
          - key: workload
            operator: Equal
            value: aplicacion
            effect: NoSchedule
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  # Recursos: request de CPU bajo para que las replicas entren en los nodos aplicacion
  # (el HPA escala al 70% de 50m). Memoria: la de la base; ajustar con kubectl top.
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/requests/cpu
        value: 50m
      # Las replicas las maneja el HPA (hpa.yaml).
      - op: remove
        path: /spec/replicas
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Reparto de replicas entre zonas y nodos. Despliegue sin corte: crea el pod nuevo
  # antes de bajar el viejo (importante con 1 replica durante la migracion).
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/topologySpreadConstraints
        value:
          - maxSkew: 1
            topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
            whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
            nodeTaintsPolicy: Honor
            labelSelector:
              matchLabels:
                app: utilities-front-app
            matchLabelKeys:
              - pod-template-hash
          - maxSkew: 1
            topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
            whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
            labelSelector:
              matchLabels:
                app: utilities-front-app
            matchLabelKeys:
              - pod-template-hash
      - op: add
        path: /spec/strategy
        value:
          type: RollingUpdate
          rollingUpdate:
            maxSurge: 1
            maxUnavailable: 0
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Seguridad del pod: sin token de ServiceAccount (no usa la API de Kubernetes).
  # Usuario de la imagen sin verificar: no se fuerza runAsNonRoot ni se quitan capabilities.
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/automountServiceAccountToken
        value: false
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/securityContext
        value:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Probes TCP al 5001 (sin endpoint de salud verificado). Arranque hasta 120 s.
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/startupProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 5001
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 24
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/readinessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 5001
          periodSeconds: 10
          failureThreshold: 3
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/livenessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 5001
          periodSeconds: 20
          failureThreshold: 3
    target:
      kind: Deployment

```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/apps/utilities-front/snippets/config-utilities.yml

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: config-utilities
  namespace: nubo-front
data:
  default.conf: |
    server {
        listen       5001;
        listen  [::]:5001;
        server_name  localhost;

        # --- Compresión en runtime ---
        # Si el build de este remote usa vite-plugin-compression
        # (igual que nubo-front), migrar a gzip_static + brotli_static
        # más adelante: mejor ratio y cero costo de CPU por request.
        gzip on;
        gzip_vary on;
        gzip_proxied any;
        gzip_comp_level 6;
        gzip_min_length 256;
        gzip_types
            text/plain
            text/css
            text/xml
            application/json
            application/javascript
            application/xml+rss
            application/atom+xml
            image/svg+xml
            font/woff2;

        # --- Cache de metadata de archivos ---
        open_file_cache max=1000 inactive=20s;
        open_file_cache_valid 30s;
        open_file_cache_min_uses 2;
        open_file_cache_errors on;

        # --- Tuning de sockets, relevante en 3G por latencia alta ---
        sendfile on;
        tcp_nopush on;
        tcp_nodelay on;
        keepalive_timeout 65;

        # Sin CORS: se confirmó que este remote se consume desde el
        # mismo origen/gateway que el host, no hace falta.

        location / {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            index  index.html index.htm;

            # Sin try_files: este remote solo expone módulos/hooks vía
            # Module Federation, no tiene rutas de navegación propias.
        }

        # remoteEntry.js NO debe cachearse largo: es el manifest que el
        # host lee para saber qué versión de este remote cargar. Si se
        # cachea igual que los assets, un deploy de este remote no se
        # reflejará en el host hasta que expire el cache del navegador.
        location = /assets/remoteEntry.js {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            add_header Cache-Control "no-cache, must-revalidate" always;
        }

        location /assets/ {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            types {
                application/javascript js;
                text/css css;
                image/svg+xml svg;
                application/json json;
                font/woff2 woff2;
            }
            # Cache largo e inmutable: válido si estos archivos tienen
            # hash en el nombre (patrón estándar de Vite/Webpack).
            # Antes tenía no-cache/no-store, forzando redescarga
            # completa en cada visita — el mayor costo en 3G.
            add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=31536000, immutable" always;
        }

        error_page  404              /404.html;
        error_page  500 502 503 504  /50x.html;
        location = /50x.html {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
        }
    }

```

      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/readinessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 10
          failureThreshold: 3
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/livenessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 20
          failureThreshold: 3
    target:
      kind: Deployment

```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/apps/web-socket-server-client-back/kustomization.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
# Multizona (docs/plans/manual-configuracion-microservicios-multizona.md):
# 1 replica: consume notificaciones de Kafka con un group id fijo y las envia a los
# clientes WebSocket conectados a ESE pod. Con 2 replicas cada mensaje llega a un solo pod
# y los clientes del otro no lo reciben. Escalar requiere broadcast (group id por pod) o broker.
# recursos, probes TCP, seguridad del pod.
resources:
  - ../../../../bases/apps/web-socket-server-client-back
patches:
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/image
        value: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/web-socket-server-client-back:0.10.0
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/nodeSelector
        value:
          workload: aplicacion
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/tolerations
        value:
          - key: workload
            operator: Equal
            value: aplicacion
            effect: NoSchedule
    target:
      kind: Deployment

  # Recursos: la base no define requests ni limits (pod BestEffort).
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources
        value:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 512Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 999m
            memory: 999Mi
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Seguridad del pod: sin token de ServiceAccount (no usa la API de Kubernetes).
  # Usuario de la imagen sin verificar: no se fuerza runAsNonRoot ni se quitan capabilities.
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/automountServiceAccountToken
        value: false
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/securityContext
        value:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Probes TCP al 8080 (sin endpoint de salud verificado). Arranque hasta 180 s.
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/startupProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 36
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/readinessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 10
          failureThreshold: 3
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/livenessProbe
        value:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 20
          failureThreshold: 3
    target:
      kind: Deployment

```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/infrastructure/apisix/kustomization.yaml

````yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
- ../../../../bases/infrastructure/apisix
# Etapa 2a-ii (docs/plans/plan-multizona-labels-taints-nubo-postnegociacion-prod.md §6.3):
# nodeSelector/tolerations hacia el nodegroup infra (gateway + etcd embebido).
# etcd: 3 replicas 1/1/1 con anti-afinidad obligatoria por zona.
# Gateway: HPA (6-9 replicas, CPU 70% del request), spread por zona y por nodo, PDB.
# El gateway no guarda datos; la configuracion vive en etcd (docs/plans/informe-poc-multizona-almacenamiento-prod.md 7.8).
patches:
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /data/values.yaml
        value: |
            #
            # Licensed to the Apache Software Foundation (ASF) under one or more
            # contributor license agreements.  See the NOTICE file distributed with
            # this work for additional information regarding copyright ownership.
            # The ASF licenses this file to You under the Apache License, Version 2.0
            # (the "License"); you may not use this file except in compliance with
            # the License.  You may obtain a copy of the License at
            #
            #     http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
            #
            # Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
            # distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
            # WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
            # See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
            # limitations under the License.
        
            global:
              # e.g.
              # imagePullSecrets:
              #   - my-registry-secrets
              #   - other-registry-secrets
              # -- Global Docker registry secret names as an array
              imagePullSecrets: "[REDACTED]"
        
            image:
              # -- Apache APISIX image repository
              repository: apache/apisix
              # -- Apache APISIX image pull policy
              pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
              # -- Apache APISIX image tag
              # Overrides the image tag whose default is the chart appVersion.
              tag: 3.14.1-ubuntu
        
            # -- set false to use `Deployment`, set true to use `DaemonSet`
            useDaemonSet: false
            # -- if useDaemonSet is true or autoscaling.enabled is true, replicaCount not become effective
            replicaCount: 6
        
            # -- Set [priorityClassName](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/pod-priority-preemption/#pod-priority) for Apache APISIX pods
            priorityClassName: ""
            # -- Annotations to add to each pod
            podAnnotations: {}
            # -- Set the securityContext for Apache APISIX pods
            podSecurityContext: {}
              # fsGroup: 2000
            # -- Set the securityContext for Apache APISIX container
            securityContext: {}
              # capabilities:
              #   drop:
              #   - ALL
              # readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
              # runAsNonRoot: true
              # runAsUser: 1000
        
            # -- See https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/run-application/configure-pdb/ for more details
            podDisruptionBudget:
              # -- Enable or disable podDisruptionBudget
              enabled: true
              # -- Set the `minAvailable` of podDisruptionBudget. You can specify only one of `maxUnavailable` and `minAvailable` in a single PodDisruptionBudget.
              # See [Specifying a Disruption Budget for your Application](https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/run-application/configure-pdb/#specifying-a-poddisruptionbudget)
              # for more details
              # Vacio a proposito: si tiene valor tiene prioridad, y "90%" con 3 replicas bloquea todo drain.
              minAvailable: ""
              # -- Set the maxUnavailable of podDisruptionBudget
              maxUnavailable: 1
        
            # -- Set pod resource requests & limits
            resources:
              requests:
                cpu: 250m
                memory: 128Mi   # uso medido ~54Mi con 2 workers
              limits:
                # Tope por pod: protege a PostgreSQL, Kafka y etcd, que comparten los nodos infra.
                # El HPA escala al 70% del request (175m), mucho antes de llegar a este limite.
                cpu: 1000m
                memory: 1Gi
              # -- Use the host's network namespace
        
              # We usually recommend not to specify default resources and to leave this as a conscious
              # choice for the user. This also increases chances charts run on environments with little
              # resources, such as Minikube. If you do want to specify resources, uncomment the following
              # lines, adjust them as necessary, and remove the curly braces after 'resources:'.
              # limits:
              #   cpu: 100m
              #   memory: 128Mi
              # requests:
              #   cpu: 100m
              #   memory: 128Mi
            hostNetwork: false
        
            # -- Node labels for Apache APISIX pod assignment
            nodeSelector:
              workload: infra
            # -- List of node taints to tolerate
            tolerations:
              - key: workload
                operator: Equal
                value: infra
                effect: NoSchedule
            # -- Set affinity for Apache APISIX deploy
            affinity: {}
            # -- Topology Spread Constraints for pod assignment spread across your cluster among failure-domains
            # ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-topology-spread-constraints/#spread-constraints-for-pods
            # matchLabelKeys: el reparto cuenta solo los pods de la misma version (ReplicaSet).
            # Sin esto, durante un rollout los pods viejos distorsionan el conteo y los nuevos
            # pueden quedar 2 en una zona y 0 en otra (paso el 2026-09-27 con apisix.v5).
            topologySpreadConstraints:
              - maxSkew: 1
                topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
                whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
                nodeTaintsPolicy: Honor
                labelSelector:
                  matchLabels:
                    app.kubernetes.io/name: apisix
                    app.kubernetes.io/instance: apisix
                matchLabelKeys:
                  - pod-template-hash
              - maxSkew: 1
                topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
                whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
                labelSelector:
                  matchLabels:
                    app.kubernetes.io/name: apisix
                    app.kubernetes.io/instance: apisix
                matchLabelKeys:
                  - pod-template-hash
        
            # -- timezone is the timezone where apisix uses.
            # For example: "UTC" or "Asia/Shanghai"
            # This value will be set on apisix container's environment variable TZ.
            # You may need to set the timezone to be consistent with your local time zone,
            # otherwise the apisix's logs may used to retrieve event maybe in wrong timezone.
            timezone: ""
        
            # -- extraEnvVars An array to add extra env vars
            # e.g:
            # extraEnvVars:
            #   - name: FOO
            #     value: "bar"
            #   - name: FOO2
            #     valueFrom:
            #       secretKeyRef:
            #         name: SECRET_NAME
            #         key: KEY
            extraEnvVars: []
        
            updateStrategy: {}
              # type: RollingUpdate
        
            # -- Additional Kubernetes resources to deploy with the release.
            extraDeploy: []
        
            # -- Additional `volume`, See [Kubernetes Volumes](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/storage/volumes/) for the detail.
            extraVolumes: []
            # - name: extras
            #   emptyDir: {}
        
            # -- Additional `volume`, See [Kubernetes Volumes](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/storage/volumes/) for the detail.
            extraVolumeMounts: []
            # - name: extras
            #   mountPath: /usr/share/extras
            #   readOnly: true
        
            # -- Additional `initContainers`, See [Kubernetes initContainers](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/init-containers/) for the detail.
            extraInitContainers: []
            # - name: init-myservice
            #   image: busybox:1.28
            #   command: ['sh', '-c', "until nslookup myservice.$(cat /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/namespace).svc.cluster.local; do echo waiting for myservice; sleep 2; done"]
        
            # -- Additional `containers`, See [Kubernetes containers](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/) for the detail.
            extraContainers: []
        
            initContainer:
              # -- Init container image
              image: busybox
              # -- Init container tag
              tag: 1.28
        
            autoscaling:
              enabled: true
              # -- HPA version, the value is "v2" or "v2beta1", default "v2"
              version: v2
              # Minimo 6 (2 por AZ): capacidad base para la carga habitual. Maximo 9 (3 por AZ).
              minReplicas: 6
              maxReplicas: 9
              targetCPUUtilizationPercentage: 70
              # Sin metrica de memoria: la memoria de nginx/Lua no baja con la carga.
              targetMemoryUtilizationPercentage: null
        
            nameOverride: ""
            fullnameOverride: ""
        
            serviceAccount:
              create: false
              annotations: {}
              name: ""
        
            rbac:
              create: false
        
            service:
              # -- Apache APISIX service type for user access itself
              type: ClusterIP  # Envoy llega por el Service; no hace falta abrir un puerto en cada nodo
              # -- Setting how the Service route external traffic
              # If you want to keep the client source IP, you can set this to Local.
        
              # ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/access-application-cluster/create-external-load-balancer/#preserving-the-client-source-ip
              externalTrafficPolicy: Cluster
              # type: LoadBalancer
              # annotations:
              #   service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-type: nlb
              externalIPs: []
              # -- Apache APISIX service settings for http
              http:
                enabled: true
                servicePort: 80
                containerPort: 9080
                # -- Support multiple http ports, See [Configuration](https://github.com/apache/apisix/blob/0bc65ea9acd726f79f80ae0abd8f50b7eb172e3d/conf/config-default.yaml#L24)
                additionalContainerPorts: []
                  # - port: 9081
                  #   enable_http2: true          # If not set, the default value is `false`.
                  # - ip: 127.0.0.2               # Specific IP, If not set, the default value is `0.0.0.0`.
                  #   port: 9082
                  #   enable_http2: true
              # -- Apache APISIX service settings for tls
              tls:
                servicePort: 443
                # nodePort: 4443
        
              # -- Apache APISIX service settings for stream. L4 proxy (TCP/UDP)
              stream:
                enabled: false
                tcp: []
                udp: []
              #  - secretName: apisix-tls
              #    hosts:
              #      - chart-example.local
              # -- Override default labels assigned to Apache APISIX gateway resources
              labelsOverride: {}
              # labelsOverride:
              #   app.kubernetes.io/name: "{{ .Release.Name }}"
              #   app.kubernetes.io/instance: '{{ include "apisix.name" . }}'
        
            # -- Using ingress access Apache APISIX service
            ingress:
              enabled: false
              # -- (number) Service port to send traffic. Defaults to `service.http.servicePort`.
              servicePort:
              # -- Ingress annotations
              annotations: {}
                # kubernetes.io/ingress.class: nginx
                # kubernetes.io/tls-acme: "true"
              hosts:
                - host: apisix.local
                  paths: []
              tls: []
        
            control:
              # -- Enable Control API
              enabled: true
              service:
                # -- Control annotations
                annotations: {}
                # -- Control service type
                type: ClusterIP
                # loadBalancerIP: a.b.c.d
                # loadBalancerSourceRanges:
                #   - "143.231.0.0/16"
                # -- IPs for which nodes in the cluster will also accept traffic for the servic
                externalIPs: []
        
                # -- NodePort (only if control.service.type is NodePort)
                # nodePort: 32000
        
                # -- which ip to listen on for Apache APISIX Control API
                ip: "127.0.0.1"
                # -- which port to use for Apache APISIX Control API
                port: 9090
                # -- Service port to use for Apache APISIX Control API
                servicePort: 9090
              # -- Using ingress access Apache APISIX Control service
              ingress:
                enabled: false
                # -- Ingress annotations
                annotations:
                  {}
                  # kubernetes.io/ingress.class: nginx
                  # kubernetes.io/tls-acme: "true"
                # -- Ingress Class Name
                # className: "nginx"
                hosts:
                  - host: apisix-control.local
                    paths:
                      - "/*"
                tls: []
              #  - secretName: apisix-tls
              #    hosts:
              #      - chart-example.local
        
            # -- Observability configuration.
            metrics:
              serviceMonitor:
                # -- Enable or disable Apache APISIX serviceMonitor
                enabled: false
                # -- namespace where the serviceMonitor is deployed, by default, it is the same as the namespace of the apisix
                namespace: ""
                # -- name of the serviceMonitor, by default, it is the same as the apisix fullname
                name: ""
                # -- interval at which metrics should be scraped
                interval: 15s
                # -- @param serviceMonitor.labels ServiceMonitor extra labels
                labels: {}
                # -- @param serviceMonitor.annotations ServiceMonitor annotations
                annotations: {}
        
            apisix:
              # -- Enable nginx IPv6 resolver
              enableIPv6: true
              enableHTTP2: true
        
              # -- Whether the APISIX version number should be shown in Server header
              enableServerTokens: false  # no exponer la version de APISIX en las respuestas
        
              # -- Use Pod metadata.uid as the APISIX id.
              setIDFromPodUID: false
        
              # -- Whether to add a custom lua module
              luaModuleHook:
                enabled: false
                # -- extend lua_package_path to load third party code
                luaPath: ""
                # -- the hook module which will be used to inject third party code into APISIX
                # use the lua require style like: "module.say_hello"
                hookPoint: ""
                # -- configmap that stores the codes
                configMapRef:
                  # -- Name of the ConfigMap where the lua module codes store
                  name: ""
                  # mounts decides how to mount the codes to the container.
                  mounts:
                    # -- Name of the ConfigMap key, for setting the mapping relationship between ConfigMap key and the lua module code path.
                    - key: ""
                    # -- Filepath of the plugin code, for setting the mapping relationship between ConfigMap key and the lua module code path.
                      path: ""
        
              ssl:
                enabled: false
                containerPort: 9443
                # -- Support multiple https ports, See [Configuration](https://github.com/apache/apisix/blob/0bc65ea9acd726f79f80ae0abd8f50b7eb172e3d/conf/config-default.yaml#L99)
                additionalContainerPorts: []
                  # - ip: 127.0.0.3           # Specific IP, If not set, the default value is `0.0.0.0`.
                  #   port: 9445
                  #   enable_http3: true
                # -- Specifies the name of Secret contains trusted CA certificates in the PEM format used to verify the certificate when APISIX needs to do SSL/TLS handshaking with external services (e.g. etcd)
                existingCASecret: "[REDACTED]"
                # -- Filename be used in the apisix.ssl.existingCASecret
                certCAFilename: ""
                enableHTTP3: false
                # -- TLS protocols allowed to use.
                sslProtocols: "TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3"
                # -- TLS ciphers allowed to use.
                sslCiphers: "ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-ECDSA-CHACHA20-POLY1305:ECDHE-RSA-CHACHA20-POLY1305:DHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:DHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:DHE-RSA-CHACHA20-POLY1305:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA256:ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA:ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA384:ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA:ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA:DHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256:DHE-RSA-AES256-SHA256:AES128-GCM-SHA256:AES256-GCM-SHA384:AES128-SHA256:AES256-SHA256:AES128-SHA:AES256-SHA:DES-CBC3-SHA"
                # -- Define SNI to fallback if none is presented by client
                fallbackSNI: ""
        
              router:
                # -- Defines how apisix handles routing:
                # - radixtree_uri: match route by uri(base on radixtree)
                # - radixtree_host_uri: match route by host + uri(base on radixtree)
                # - radixtree_uri_with_parameter: match route by uri with parameters
                http: radixtree_host_uri
        
              fullCustomConfig:
                # -- Enable full customized config.yaml
                enabled: false
                # -- If apisix.fullCustomConfig.enabled is true, full customized config.yaml.
                # Please note that other settings about APISIX config will be ignored
                config: {}
        
              deployment:
                # -- Apache APISIX deployment mode
                # Optional: traditional, decoupled, standalone
                #
                # ref: https://apisix.apache.org/docs/apisix/deployment-modes/
                mode: traditional
        
                # -- Deployment role
                # Optional: traditional, data_plane, control_plane
                #
                # ref: https://apisix.apache.org/docs/apisix/deployment-modes/
                role: "traditional"
                role_traditional:
                  # enum: etcd, yaml
                  config_provider: "etcd"
        
              admin:
                # -- Enable Admin API
                enabled: true
                # -- Enable Embedded Admin UI
                enable_admin_ui: false  # consola web desactivada; la Admin API sigue disponible
                # -- admin service type
                type: ClusterIP
                # loadBalancerIP: a.b.c.d
                # loadBalancerSourceRanges:
                #   - "143.231.0.0/16"
                # -- IPs for which nodes in the cluster will also accept traffic for the servic
                externalIPs: []
                # -- which ip to listen on for Apache APISIX admin API. Set to `"[::]"` when on IPv6 single stack
                ip: 0.0.0.0
                # -- which port to use for Apache APISIX admin API
                port: 9180
                # -- Service port to use for Apache APISIX admin API
                servicePort: 9180
                # -- Admin API support CORS response headers
                cors: true
                # -- Admin API credentials
                credentials:
                  # -- Apache APISIX admin API admin role credentials
                  admin: edd1c9f034335f136f87ad84b625c8f1
                  # -- Apache APISIX admin API viewer role credentials
                  viewer: 4054f7cf07e344346cd3f287985e76a2
        
                  # -- The APISIX Helm chart supports storing user credentials in a secret.
                  # The secret needs to contain two keys, admin and viewer, with their respective values set.
                  secretName: "[REDACTED]"
                  # -- Name of the admin role key in the secret, overrides the default key name "admin"
                  secretAdminKey: "[REDACTED]"
                  # -- Name of the viewer role key in the secret, overrides the default key name "viewer"
                  secretViewerKey: "[REDACTED]"
        
                allow:
                  # -- The client IP CIDR allowed to access Apache APISIX Admin API service.
                  ipList:
                    - 127.0.0.1/24
                # -- Using ingress access Apache APISIX admin service
                ingress:
                  enabled: false
                  # -- Ingress annotations
                  annotations:
                    {}
                    # kubernetes.io/ingress.class: nginx
                    # kubernetes.io/tls-acme: "true"
                  hosts:
                    - host: apisix-admin.local
                      paths:
                        - "/apisix"
                  tls: []
                #  - secretName: apisix-tls
                #    hosts:
                #      - chart-example.local
        
              nginx:
                workerRlimitNofile: "20480"
                workerConnections: "10620"
                # Fijo en 2: "auto" crea un worker por CPU del nodo (8) e ignora el limite del contenedor.
                workerProcesses: "2"
                # Sin afinidad: con 2 pods en el mismo nodo, ambos fijarian sus workers a los mismos cores.
                enableCPUAffinity: false
                # -- Timeout during which a keep-alive client connection will stay open on the server side.
                keepaliveTimeout: 60s
                envs: []
                # access log and error log configuration
                logs:
                  # -- Enable access log or not, default true
                  enableAccessLog: true
                  # -- Access log path
                  accessLog: "/dev/stdout"
                  # -- Access log format
                  accessLogFormat: '$remote_addr - $remote_user [$time_local] $http_host \"$request\" $status $body_bytes_sent $request_time \"$http_referer\" \"$http_user_agent\" $upstream_addr $upstream_status $upstream_response_time \"$upstream_scheme://$upstream_host$upstream_uri\"'
                  # -- Allows setting json or default characters escaping in variables
                  accessLogFormatEscape: default
                  # -- Error log path
                  errorLog: "/dev/stderr"
                  # -- Error log level
                  errorLogLevel: "warn"
                # -- Custom configuration snippet.
                configurationSnippet:
                  main: |
        
                  httpStart: |
        
                  httpEnd: |
        
                  httpSrv: |
        
                  httpAdmin: |
        
                  stream: |
        
                # -- Add custom [lua_shared_dict](https://github.com/openresty/lua-nginx-module?tab=readme-ov-file#lua_shared_dict) settings,
                # click [here](https://github.com/apache/apisix-helm-chart/blob/master/charts/apisix/values.yaml#L27-L30) to learn the format of a shared dict
                customLuaSharedDicts: []
                  # - name: foo
                  #   size: 10k
                  # - name: bar
                  #   size: 1m
        
                # -- Override default [lua_shared_dict](https://github.com/apache/apisix/blob/master/conf/config.yaml.example#L250-L276) settings,
                # click [here](https://github.com/apache/apisix-helm-chart/blob/master/charts/apisix/values.yaml#L27-L30) to learn the format of a shared dict
                luaSharedDicts: []
                  # - name: prometheus-metrics
                  #   size: 20m
        
              discovery:
                # -- Enable or disable Apache APISIX integration service discovery
                enabled: false
                # -- Service discovery registry. Refer to [configuration under discovery](https://github.com/apache/apisix/blob/master/conf/config.yaml.example#L307) for example.
                # Also see [example of using external service discovery](https://apisix.apache.org/docs/ingress-controller/1.8.0/tutorials/external-service-discovery/).
                registry: {}
                  # Integration service discovery registry. E.g eureka\dns\nacos\consul_kv
                  # reference:
                  # https://apisix.apache.org/docs/apisix/discovery/#configuration-for-eureka
                  # https://apisix.apache.org/docs/apisix/discovery/dns/#service-discovery-via-dns
                  # https://apisix.apache.org/docs/apisix/discovery/consul_kv/#configuration-for-consul-kv
                  # https://apisix.apache.org/docs/apisix/discovery/nacos/#configuration-for-nacos
                  # https://apisix.apache.org/docs/apisix/discovery/kubernetes/#configuration
                  #
                  # an eureka example:
                  # ```
                  # eureka:
                  #   host:
                  #     - "http://${username}:[REDACTED]@${eureka_host1}:${eureka_port1}"
                  #     - "http://${username}:[REDACTED]@${eureka_host2}:${eureka_port2}"
                  #   prefix: "/eureka/"
                  #   fetch_interval: 30
                  #   weight: 100
                  #   timeout:
                  #     connect: 2000
                  #     send: 2000
                  #     read: 5000
                  # ```
                  #
                  # the minimal Kubernetes example:
                  # ```
                  # kubernetes: {}
                  # ```
                  #
                  # The prerequisites for the above minimal Kubernetes example:
                  #  1. [Optional] Set `.serviceAccount.create` to `true` to create a dedicated ServiceAccount.
                  #     It is recommended to do so, otherwise the default ServiceAccount "default" will be used.
                  #  2. [Required] Set `.rbac.create` to `true` to create and bind the necessary RBAC resources.
                  #     This grants the ServiceAccount in use to List-Watch Kubernetes Endpoints resources.
                  #  3. [Required] Include the following environment variables in `.nginx.envs` to pass them into
                  #     nginx worker processes (https://nginx.org/en/docs/ngx_core_module.html#env):
                  #      - KUBERNETES_SERVICE_HOST
                  #      - KUBERNETES_SERVICE_PORT
                  #     This is for allowing the default `host` and `port` of `.discovery.registry.kubernetes.service`.
        
              dns:
                resolvers:
                  - 127.0.0.1
                  - 172.20.0.10
                  - 114.114.114.114
                  - 223.5.5.5
                  - 1.1.1.1
                  - 8.8.8.8
                validity: 30
                timeout: 5
        
              vault:
                # -- Enable or disable the vault integration
                enabled: false
                # -- The host address where the vault server is running.
                host: ""
                # -- HTTP timeout for each request.
                timeout: 10
                # -- The generated token from vault instance that can grant access to read data from the vault.
                token: "[REDACTED]"
                # -- Prefix allows you to better enforcement of policies.
                prefix: ""
        
              prometheus:
                # ref: https://apisix.apache.org/docs/apisix/plugins/prometheus/
                enabled: false
                # -- path of the metrics endpoint
                path: /apisix/prometheus/metrics
                # -- prefix of the metrics
                metricPrefix: apisix_
                # -- container port where the metrics are exposed
                containerPort: 9091
        
              # -- Customize the list of APISIX plugins to enable. By default, APISIX's [default plugins](https://github.com/apache/apisix/blob/master/apisix/cli/config.lua#L196) are automatically used.
              plugins:           # plugin list
                - real-ip
                - proxy-rewrite
                - server-info
                - authz-keycloak
                - cors
                - limit-conn
                - limit-count
                - limit-req
                - csrf
                - openid-connect
                
              # -- Customize the list of APISIX stream_plugins to enable. By default, APISIX's [default stream_plugins](https://github.com/apache/apisix/blob/master/apisix/cli/config.lua#L294) are automatically used.
              stream_plugins: []
        
              # -- Set APISIX plugin attributes. By default, APISIX's [plugin_attr](https://github.com/apache/apisix/blob/master/apisix/cli/config.lua#L295) are automatically used.
              # See [configuration example](https://github.com/apache/apisix/blob/master/conf/config.yaml.example#L591).
              pluginAttrs: {}
        
              extPlugin:
                # -- Enable External Plugins. See [external plugin](https://apisix.apache.org/docs/apisix/next/external-plugin/)
                enabled: false
                # -- the command and its arguements to run as a subprocess
                cmd: ["/path/to/apisix-plugin-runner/runner", "run"]
        
              wasm:
                # -- Enable Wasm Plugins. See [wasm plugin](https://apisix.apache.org/docs/apisix/next/wasm/)
                enabled: false
                plugins: []
        
              # -- customPlugins allows you to mount your own HTTP plugins.
              customPlugins:
                # -- Whether to configure some custom plugins
                enabled: false
                # -- the lua_path that tells APISIX where it can find plugins,
                # note the last ';' is required.
                luaPath: "/opts/custom_plugins/?.lua"
                plugins:
                  # -- plugin name.
                  - name: "plugin-name"
                    # -- plugin attrs
                    attrs: {}
                    # -- plugin codes can be saved inside configmap object.
                    configMap:
                      # -- name of configmap.
                      name: "configmap-name"
                      # -- since keys in configmap is flat, mountPath allows to define the mount
                      # path, so that plugin codes can be mounted hierarchically.
                      mounts:
                        - key: "the-file-name"
                          path: "mount-path"
        
              status:
                ip: "0.0.0.0"
                port: 7085
        
              # -- When configured, APISIX will trust the `X-Forwarded-*` Headers passed in requests from the IP/CIDR in the list.
              trustedAddresses:
                - 127.0.0.1
        
            # -- external etcd configuration. If etcd.enabled is false, these configuration will be used.
            externalEtcd:
              # -- if etcd.enabled is false, use external etcd, support multiple address, if your etcd cluster enables TLS, please use https scheme, e.g. https://127.0.0.1:2379.
              host:
                # host or ip e.g. http://172.20.128.89:2379
                - http://etcd.host:2379
              # -- if etcd.enabled is false, user for external etcd. Set empty to disable authentication
              user: root
              # -- if etcd.enabled is true, use etcd.auth.rbac.rootPassword instead.
              # -- if etcd.enabled is false and externalEtcd.existingSecret is not empty, the password should store in the corresponding secret
              # -- if etcd.enabled is false and externalEtcd.existingSecret is empty, externalEtcd.password is the passsword for external etcd.
              password: "[REDACTED]"
              # -- if externalEtcd.existingSecret is the name of secret containing the external etcd password
              existingSecret: "[REDACTED]"
              # -- externalEtcd.secretPasswordKey Key inside the secret containing the external etcd password
              secretPasswordKey: "[REDACTED]"
        
            # -- etcd configuration
            # use the FQDN address or the IP of the etcd
            etcd:
              # -- install built-in etcd by default, set false if do not want to install built-in etcd together,
              # this etcd is based on bitnamilegacy/etcd helm chart and latest bitnami docker image, only for development and testing purposes,
              # if you want to use etcd in production, we recommend you to install etcd by yourself and use `externalEtcd` to connect it.
              enabled: true
              # -- docker image for built-in etcd
              image:
                registry: docker.io
                repository: bitnamilegacy/etcd
                # -- `bitnamilegacy/etcd` only provide `latest` tag now, ref: https://github.com/bitnami/containers/issues/83267,
                # you can switch `etcd.image.repository` to `bitnamilegacy/etcd` to use old versioned tags.
                tag: latest
              persistence:
                enabled: true
                size: 10Gi 
                storageClass: ebs-sc-gp3  
        
              # -- apisix configurations prefix
              prefix: "/apisix"
              # -- Set the timeout value in seconds for subsequent socket operations from apisix to etcd cluster
              timeout: 30
        
              # -- if etcd.enabled is true, set more values of bitnamilegacy/etcd helm chart
              auth:
                rbac:
                  # -- No authentication by default. Switch to enable RBAC authentication
                  create: false
                  # -- root password for etcd. Requires etcd.auth.rbac.create to be true.
                  rootPassword: "[REDACTED]"
                tls:
                  # -- enable etcd client certificate
                  enabled: false
                  # -- name of the secret contains etcd client cert
                  existingSecret: "[REDACTED]"
                  # -- etcd client cert filename using in etcd.auth.tls.existingSecret
                  certFilename: ""
                  # -- etcd client cert key filename using in etcd.auth.tls.existingSecret
                  certKeyFilename: ""
                  # -- whether to verify the etcd endpoint certificate when setup a TLS connection to etcd
                  verify: true
                  # -- specify the TLS Server Name Indication extension, the ETCD endpoint hostname will be used when this setting is unset.
                  sni: ""
        
              # -- ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/security-context/#set-the-security-context-for-a-container
              # -- added for backward compatibility with old kubernetes versions, as seccompProfile is not supported in kubernetes < 1.19
              containerSecurityContext:
                enabled: false
        
              service:
                port: 2379
        
              replicaCount: 3
              nodeSelector:
                workload: infra
              tolerations:
                - key: workload
                  operator: Equal
                  value: infra
                  effect: NoSchedule
              affinity:
                podAntiAffinity:
                  requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
                    - labelSelector:
                        matchExpressions:
                          - key: app.kubernetes.io/name
                            operator: In
                            values: ["etcd"]
                          - key: app.kubernetes.io/instance
                            operator: In
                            values: ["apisix"]
                      topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
              autoCompactionRetention: "1h"
              autoCompactionMode: "periodic"
        
            # -- Ingress controller configuration
            ingress-controller:
              enabled: false
        
    target:
      kind: ConfigMap
      name: values-apisix
  # Produccion enruta por envoy-gateway (main-gateway), no por ALB Ingress.
  # ingress-apisix.yaml en el base trae subnets/host/cert-arn de QA (nubo-qa) y
  # no debe desplegarse en este overlay: se elimina en lugar de corregir sus valores.
  - patch: |-
      $patch: delete
      apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
      kind: Ingress
      metadata:
        name: ingress-apisix
        namespace: api-gateway
  # ingress-service.yaml del base es otro Ingress de QA (host nbo-qa, certificado y subnets de
  # otra cuenta). En prod nunca creo balanceador (sin ADDRESS); se elimina por la misma razon.
  - patch: |-
      $patch: delete
      apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
      kind: Ingress
      metadata:
        name: ingress-service
        namespace: nubo-front

````

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/infrastructure/cloudnative-operator/kustomization.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
- ../../../../bases/infrastructure/cloudnative-operator
# Fase 4 (docs/plans/plan-multizona-labels-taints-nubo-postnegociacion-prod.md):
# nodeSelector/tolerations hacia infra. Values confirmados contra el values.yaml
# oficial de cloudnative-pg/charts (nodeSelector/tolerations a nivel raiz en
# ambos charts, mismo nivel que replicaCount).
patches:
  - target:
      group: helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io
      version: v2
      kind: HelmRelease
      name: cloudnative-pg-operator
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/chart/spec/version
        value: 0.29.1
      - op: add
        path: /spec/values/nodeSelector
        value:
          workload: infra
      - op: add
        path: /spec/values/tolerations
        value:
          - key: workload
            operator: Equal
            value: infra
            effect: NoSchedule
  # Barman: plugin v0.15.1 (chart 0.8.1) solo en produccion
  - target:
      group: helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io

    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/chart/spec/version

      - op: add
        path: /spec/values/nodeSelector
        value:
          workload: infra
      - op: add
        path: /spec/values/tolerations
        value:
          - key: workload
            operator: Equal

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/infrastructure/cluster-autoscaler/helmrelease.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v2
kind: HelmRelease
metadata:
  name: cluster-autoscaler
  namespace: kube-system
spec:
  interval: 5m
  timeout: 10m
  releaseName: cluster-autoscaler
  chart:
    spec:
      chart: cluster-autoscaler
      version: "9.59.0"
      sourceRef:
        kind: HelmRepository
        name: cluster-autoscaler
        namespace: flux-system
      interval: 1h
  install:
    remediation:
      retries: 3
  upgrade:
    remediation:
      remediateLastFailure: true
      retries: 3
  values:
    autoDiscovery:
      clusterName: eks-nbo-postneg-prod-eks
    awsRegion: us-east-1
    cloudProvider: aws
    image:
      repository: registry.k8s.io/autoscaling/cluster-autoscaler
      tag: v1.36.1
      pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
    replicaCount: 2
    rbac:
      create: true
      serviceAccount:
        create: true
        name: cluster-autoscaler
        automountServiceAccountToken: true
    nodeSelector:
      workload: infra
    tolerations:
      - key: workload
        operator: Equal
        value: infra
        effect: NoSchedule
    topologySpreadConstraints:
      - maxSkew: 1
        topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
        whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
        labelSelector:
          matchLabels:
            app.kubernetes.io/instance: cluster-autoscaler
    extraArgs:
      balance-similar-node-groups: "true"
      expander: least-waste
      leader-elect: "true"
      scale-down-enabled: "true"
      scale-down-delay-after-add: 30m
      scale-down-unneeded-time: 20m
      scale-down-utilization-threshold: "0.45"
      skip-nodes-with-local-storage: "true"
      skip-nodes-with-system-pods: "true"
      v: "4"
      write-status-configmap: "true"
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: 100m
        memory: 300Mi
      limits:
        cpu: 500m
        memory: 600Mi
    podDisruptionBudget:
      maxUnavailable: 1
    priorityClassName: system-cluster-critical
```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/infrastructure/descheduler/helmrelease.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v2
kind: HelmRelease
metadata:
  name: descheduler
  namespace: kube-system
spec:
  interval: 15m
  timeout: 10m
  releaseName: descheduler
  chart:
    spec:
      chart: descheduler
      version: "0.36.0"
      sourceRef:
        kind: HelmRepository
        name: descheduler
        namespace: flux-system
      interval: 1h
  install:
    remediation:
      retries: 3
  upgrade:
    remediation:
      remediateLastFailure: true
      retries: 3
  values:
    kind: CronJob
    schedule: "*/15 * * * *"
    successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 3
    failedJobsHistoryLimit: 3
    ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 3600
    cmdOptions:
      v: 4
    deschedulerPolicyAPIVersion: descheduler/v1alpha2
    deschedulerPolicy:
      nodeSelector: workload=aplicacion
      maxNoOfPodsToEvictPerNode: 1
      maxNoOfPodsToEvictPerNamespace: 1
      maxNoOfPodsToEvictTotal: 3
      gracePeriodSeconds: 60
      profiles:
        - name: application-topology
          pluginConfig:
            - name: DefaultEvictor
              args:
                nodeFit: true
                minReplicas: 2
                minPodAge: 10m
                noEvictionPolicy: Mandatory
                podProtections:
                  extraEnabled:
                    - PodsWithPVC
                    - PodsWithoutPDB
            - name: RemovePodsViolatingTopologySpreadConstraint
              args:
                constraints:
                  - DoNotSchedule
                  - ScheduleAnyway
                namespaces:
                  include:
                    - nubo-back
                    - nubo-back-integracion
                    - nubo-front
          plugins:
            balance:
              enabled:
                - RemovePodsViolatingTopologySpreadConstraint
    nodeSelector:
      workload: infra
    tolerations:
      - key: workload
        operator: Equal
        value: infra
        effect: NoSchedule
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: 100m
        memory: 128Mi
      limits:
        cpu: 300m
        memory: 256Mi
    podSecurityContext:
      runAsNonRoot: true
      runAsUser: 1000
      runAsGroup: 1000
      seccompProfile:
        type: RuntimeDefault
```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/infrastructure/envoy-gateway/gateway.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Gateway
metadata:
  name: main-gateway
  namespace: envoy-gateway-system
spec:
  gatewayClassName: envoy
  listeners:
    # 1. Tráfico HTTP (Puerto 80)
    - name: http-co-prod
      protocol: HTTP
      port: 80
      hostname: "*.co.nuam.com"
      allowedRoutes:
        namespaces:
          from: All

    # 2. Listener HTTPS para Nubo Front
    - name: https-nbo-front-prod
      protocol: HTTPS
      port: 443
      hostname: "nubo.co.nuam.com"
      allowedRoutes:
        namespaces:
          from: All
      tls:
        mode: Terminate
        certificateRefs:
          - name: wildcard-co-nuam-com-tls

    # 3. Listener HTTPS para APISIX Gateway
    - name: https-apisix-prod
      protocol: HTTPS
      port: 443
      hostname: "apigateway.co.nuam.com"
      allowedRoutes:
        namespaces:
          from: All
      tls:
        mode: Terminate
        certificateRefs:
          - name: wildcard-co-nuam-com-tls

    # 3b. NUEVO: Listener HTTPS para el hostname real en uso (apigateway-nubo)
    - name: https-apisix-nubo-prod
      protocol: HTTPS
      port: 443
      hostname: "apigateway-nubo.co.nuam.com"
      allowedRoutes:
        namespaces:
          from: All
      tls:
        mode: Terminate
        certificateRefs:
          - name: wildcard-co-nuam-com-tls

    # 4. NUEVO: Listener HTTPS para SFTPGo Client (https://sftpclient.co.nuam.com)
    - name: https-sftpclient-prod
      protocol: HTTPS
      port: 443
      hostname: "sftpclient.co.nuam.com"
      allowedRoutes:
        namespaces:
          from: All
      tls:
        mode: Terminate
        certificateRefs:
          - name: wildcard-co-nuam-com-tls

    # 5. Listener TCP para PostgreSQL (Puerto 5432)
    - name: postgres-listener
      protocol: TCP
      port: 5432
      allowedRoutes:
        kinds:
          - kind: TCPRoute
        namespaces:
          from: All

    # 6. Listener TCP para Kafka (Puerto 9094)
    - name: kafka-listener
      protocol: TCP
      port: 9094
      allowedRoutes:
        kinds:
          - kind: TCPRoute
        namespaces:
          from: All

    # 7. Listener TCP para SFTP nativo (Corregido a Puerto 22 para hacer match con AWS NLB)
    - name: sftp-listener
      protocol: TCP
      port: 22
      allowedRoutes:
        kinds:
          - kind: TCPRoute
        namespaces:
          from: All
   
   # 8. NUEVO: Listener HTTPS para Grafana (https://grafana.co.nuam.com)
    - name: https-grafana-prod
      protocol: HTTPS
      port: 443
      hostname: "grafana.co.nuam.com"
      allowedRoutes:
        namespaces:
          from: All
      tls:
        mode: Terminate
        certificateRefs:
          - name: wildcard-co-nuam-com-tls       
          
```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/infrastructure/envoy-gateway/httproute-apisix-gateway-prod.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata:
  name: apisix-gateway-route-prod
  namespace: api-gateway
spec:
  hostnames:
    - apigateway.co.nuam.com
    - apigateway-nubo.co.nuam.com

  parentRefs:
    - name: main-gateway
      namespace: envoy-gateway-system
      sectionName: https-apisix-prod
    - name: main-gateway
      namespace: envoy-gateway-system
      sectionName: https-apisix-nubo-prod
      
  rules:
    - matches:
        - path:
            type: PathPrefix
            value: /

      filters:
        - type: RequestHeaderModifier
          requestHeaderModifier:
            add:
              - name: X-Forwarded-Proto
                value: "https"
              - name: X-Forwarded-Host
                value: apigateway.co.nuam.com
        - type: ResponseHeaderModifier
          responseHeaderModifier:
            remove:
              - Connection
              - Keep-Alive
              - Transfer-Encoding
              - Upgrade
              - Proxy-Connection

      backendRefs:
        - name: apisix-gateway
          port: 80
```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/infrastructure/envoy-gateway/kustomization.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

resources:
  # Bases
  - ../../../../bases/infrastructure/envoy-gateway/envoy-proxy.yaml
  - ../../../../bases/infrastructure/envoy-gateway/gateway-class.yaml
  - ../../../../bases/infrastructure/envoy-gateway/client-traffic-policy.yaml
  # Recurso Gateway principal
  - ./gateway.yaml
  - ./external-secret-tls.yaml
  # Rutas HTTP / HTTPS
  - ./httproute-apisix-gateway-prod.yaml
  - ./httproute-apisix-http-redirect-prod.yaml
  - ./httproute-grafana-prod.yaml
  - ./httproute-nubofront-prod.yaml
  # Configuración SFTP (TCP)
  - ./httproute-sftpclient-prod.yaml
  - ./sftp-traffic-policy-prod.yaml

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/infrastructure/envoy-gateway/patches/envoy-proxy-prod.patch.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: gateway.envoyproxy.io/v1alpha1
kind: EnvoyProxy
metadata:
  name: envoyproxy-aws
  namespace: envoy-gateway-system
spec:
  provider:
    type: Kubernetes
    kubernetes:
      envoyService:
        annotations:
          # Estas 3 líneas son las que faltan para que AWS deje de estar en "pending"
          service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-type: "external"
          service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-nlb-target-type: "ip"
          service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-scheme: "internal"
          
          # Tus configuraciones actuales (mantenerlas igual)
          service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-subnets: "subnet-05a6277212a3b09a5,subnet-000ef3a21cbab67a4,subnet-041f971fc1660299b"
          service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-private-ipv4-addresses: "10.253.208.10,10.253.212.10,10.253.216.10"
      envoyDeployment:
        replicas: 3
        pod:
          nodeSelector:
            workload: infra
          tolerations:
            - key: workload
              operator: Equal
              value: infra
              effect: NoSchedule
          topologySpreadConstraints:
            - maxSkew: 1
              topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
              whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
              labelSelector:
                matchLabels:
                  gateway.envoyproxy.io/owning-gateway-name: main-gateway
                  gateway.envoyproxy.io/owning-gateway-namespace: envoy-gateway-system

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
- ../../../../bases/infrastructure/envoy-gateway/envoy-release.yaml
# Etapa 2a-ii (docs/plans/plan-multizona-labels-taints-nubo-postnegociacion-prod.md §6.4):
# nodeSelector/tolerations hacia el nodegroup infra para el control-plane
# (chart gateway-helm@1.7.1, values confirmadas contra values.tmpl.yaml oficial:
# deployment.replicas, deployment.pod.nodeSelector/tolerations). replicas
# queda en 1 (subir a 2 es mejora de HA aparte, no de segmentacion).

        path: /spec/values

            pod:
              nodeSelector:
                workload: infra
              tolerations:
                - key: workload
                  operator: Equal
                  value: infra
                  effect: NoSchedule
          certgen:
            job:
              nodeSelector:
                workload: infra
              tolerations:
                - key: workload
                  operator: Equal
                  value: infra
                  effect: NoSchedule
      - op: add
        path: /spec/install

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/infrastructure/external-secrets/kustomization.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
- ../../../../bases/infrastructure/external-secrets
# Fase 4 (docs/plans/plan-multizona-labels-taints-nubo-postnegociacion-prod.md):
# nodeSelector/tolerations hacia infra. Estructura de values confirmada
# contra overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-qa/infrastructure/external-secrets
# (mismo chart, mismos bloques nodeSelector/tolerations en la raiz, en
# webhook y en certController).
#
# Bump de version del chart (0.3.9 -> 0.9.18, igual que QA): el CRD en el
# cluster ya tiene v1beta1 como storedVersion, pero el chart 0.3.9 no lo
# declara en spec.versions, por lo que el HelmRelease queda en Failed al
# intentar reconciliar los CRDs. QA resolvio el mismo problema con este bump.
patches:
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/chart/spec/version
        value: "0.9.18"
      - op: add
        path: /spec/values/nodeSelector
        value:
          workload: infra
      - op: add
        path: /spec/values/tolerations
        value:
          - key: workload
            operator: Equal
            value: infra
            effect: NoSchedule
      - op: add
        path: /spec/values/webhook
        value:
          nodeSelector:
            workload: infra
          tolerations:
            - key: workload
              operator: Equal
              value: infra
              effect: NoSchedule
      - op: add
        path: /spec/values/certController
        value:
          nodeSelector:
            workload: infra
          tolerations:
            - key: workload
              operator: Equal
              value: infra
              effect: NoSchedule
    target:
      kind: HelmRelease
      name: external-secrets
```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/infrastructure/kafka-interno-nubo/kustomization.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - ../../../../bases/infrastructure/kafka-interno-nubo
  - strimzi-operator-helmrelease.yaml
# Etapa 2a-ii + 2b (docs/plans/plan-multizona-labels-taints-nubo-postnegociacion-prod.md §6.2):
# KafkaNodePool.spec.template.pod no tiene campo nodeSelector (verificado contra
# el CRD instalado y el oficial 0.48.0: solo expone affinity/tolerations) — se
# logra el mismo efecto vía affinity.nodeAffinity.requiredDuringScheduling...
# Etapa 2b (podAntiAffinity + spec.kafka.rack) ya se puede aplicar: los discos
# EBS de brokers/controllers se migraron a 1 por zona (ver §3.4 y la migracion
# registrada en §6.2), asi que required no deja pods Pending.
patches:
  - target:
      group: kafka.strimzi.io
      version: v1beta2
      kind: KafkaNodePool
      name: brokers
    patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/resources
        value:
          requests:
            cpu: 150m
            memory: 1792Mi
          limits:
            cpu: "2"
            memory: 4Gi
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template
        value:
          pod:
            affinity:
              nodeAffinity:
                requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
                  nodeSelectorTerms:
                    - matchExpressions:
                        - key: workload
                          operator: In
                          values: ["infra"]
              podAntiAffinity:
                requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
                  - labelSelector:
                      matchExpressions:
                        - key: strimzi.io/pool-name
                          operator: In
                          values: ["brokers"]
                    topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
            tolerations:
              - key: workload
                operator: Equal
                value: infra
                effect: NoSchedule
  - target:
      group: kafka.strimzi.io
      version: v1beta2
      kind: KafkaNodePool
      name: controllers
    patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/resources
        value:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 512Mi
          limits:
            cpu: "1"
            memory: 1Gi
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template
        value:
          pod:
            affinity:
              nodeAffinity:
                requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
                  nodeSelectorTerms:
                    - matchExpressions:
                        - key: workload
                          operator: In
                          values: ["infra"]
              podAntiAffinity:
                requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
                  - labelSelector:
                      matchExpressions:
                        - key: strimzi.io/pool-name
                          operator: In
                          values: ["controllers"]
                    topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
            tolerations:
              - key: workload
                operator: Equal
                value: infra
                effect: NoSchedule
  - target:
      group: kafka.strimzi.io
      version: v1beta2
      kind: Kafka
      name: kafka-cluster
    patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/kafka/rack
        value:
          topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
      - op: add
        path: /spec/entityOperator/topicOperator/resources
        value:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 256Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
      - op: add
        path: /spec/entityOperator/userOperator/resources
        value:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 256Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/infrastructure/monitoring/prometheusrule-cnpg-slots.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: monitoring.coreos.com/v1
kind: PrometheusRule
metadata:
  name: cnpg-replication-slots
  namespace: monitoring
  labels:
    # ruleSelector del Prometheus de kube-prometheus-stack.
    release: kube-prometheus-stack
spec:
  groups:
    - name: cnpg-replication-slots
      rules:
        # Un slot logico sin consumidor retiene WAL hasta max_slot_wal_keep_size (20GB en postgresql-nubo,
        # diseno L3 5.3); al superarlo pasa a 'lost'. Sobre 8GiB ya consume disco del volumen WAL (64GiB).
        - alert: CNPGLogicalSlotWalRetentionHigh
          expr: max by (namespace, pod, slot_name) (cnpg_pg_replication_slots_pg_wal_lsn_diff{slot_type="logical"}) > 8 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024
          for: 15m
          labels:
            severity: warning
          annotations:
            summary: "Slot logico {{ $labels.slot_name }} retiene mas de 8GiB de WAL"
            description: "{{ $labels.pod }} retiene {{ $value | humanize1024 }}B de WAL por el slot {{ $labels.slot_name }}. Revisar el suscriptor."
        # 15GiB = 75% del tope de 20GB: queda poco para que el slot se pierda y haya que resincronizar todo.
        - alert: CNPGLogicalSlotWalRetentionCritical
          expr: max by (namespace, pod, slot_name) (cnpg_pg_replication_slots_pg_wal_lsn_diff{slot_type="logical"}) > 15 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024
          for: 5m
          labels:
            severity: critical
          annotations:
            summary: "Slot logico {{ $labels.slot_name }} retiene mas de 15GiB de WAL (tope 20GB)"
            description: "{{ $labels.pod }} retiene {{ $value | humanize1024 }}B de WAL. Al llegar a max_slot_wal_keep_size el slot se invalida y la suscripcion necesita resincronizacion completa (runbook 11.4). Reanudar el suscriptor o decidir con el DBA."

        # Las siguientes usan las consultas propias cnpg_nubo_slots_* (postgresql-nubo/monitoring-queries-replicacion.yaml).
        # Slot sobre el tope pero aun recuperable si el WAL no se ha reciclado.
        - alert: CNPGLogicalSlotUnreserved
          expr: max by (namespace, pod, slot_name) (cnpg_nubo_slots_en_riesgo - cnpg_nubo_slots_perdido) == 1
          for: 5m
          labels:
            severity: warning
          annotations:
            summary: "Slot logico {{ $labels.slot_name }} supero max_slot_wal_keep_size (unreserved)"
            description: "En {{ $labels.pod }} el slot {{ $labels.slot_name }} esta 'unreserved': en el proximo checkpoint puede pasar a 'lost'. Reanudar el suscriptor de inmediato."
        # H18: con el slot perdido la suscripcion sigue 'enabled' y sin errores de apply; solo reintenta en el log.
        - alert: CNPGLogicalSlotLost
          expr: max by (namespace, pod, slot_name) (cnpg_nubo_slots_perdido) == 1
          for: 1m
          labels:
            severity: critical
          annotations:
            summary: "Slot logico {{ $labels.slot_name }} perdido (wal_status=lost)"
            description: "En {{ $labels.pod }} el slot {{ $labels.slot_name }} se invalido por superar max_slot_wal_keep_size. La replicacion hacia reportes esta detenida aunque la suscripcion figure habilitada. Aplicar runbook 11.4 (resincronizacion completa)."
        # Suscriptor desconectado: suscripcion deshabilitada por error (p. ej. DDL faltante, runbook 11.2), corte de red o pausa.
        - alert: CNPGLogicalSlotInactive
          expr: max by (namespace, pod, slot_name) (cnpg_nubo_slots_inactivo_en_primario) == 1
          for: 15m
          labels:
            severity: warning
          annotations:
            summary: "Slot logico {{ $labels.slot_name }} sin consumidor hace 15 minutos"
            description: "En {{ $labels.pod }} nadie consume el slot {{ $labels.slot_name }}: retiene WAL y la replicacion hacia reportes esta detenida. Revisar la suscripcion (runbook 11.2)."
        # H16: tras el primer switchover, el ex primario conserva su copia vieja del slot y no la sincroniza.
        - alert: CNPGLogicalSlotStaleCopyOnStandby
          expr: max by (namespace, pod, slot_name) (cnpg_nubo_slots_copia_obsoleta_en_standby) == 1
          for: 10m
          labels:
            severity: warning
          annotations:
            summary: "Copia obsoleta del slot {{ $labels.slot_name }} en el standby {{ $labels.pod }}"
            description: "El standby {{ $labels.pod }} tiene una copia no sincronizada del slot {{ $labels.slot_name }}: no sirve para failover y retiene WAL. Borrarla en ese standby (runbook 11.3)."

```
