## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/infrastructure/postgresql-nubo/diagnose-rewind.sh

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Read-only evidence collection for repeated CloudNativePG failovers.
# Usage: bash diagnose-rewind.sh [former-primary-pod]
set -euo pipefail

REGION=us-east-1
ACCOUNT=242736647867
EKS_CLUSTER=eks-nbo-postneg-prod-eks
NAMESPACE=postgresql-nubo
PG_CLUSTER=cloudnative-pg-nubo
EXPECTED_CONTEXT="arn:aws:eks:${REGION}:${ACCOUNT}:cluster/${EKS_CLUSTER}"

for command in aws kubectl jq; do
  command -v "$command" >/dev/null || { echo "Falta $command" >&2; exit 2; }
done

context=$(kubectl config current-context)
account=$(aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text)
if [[ "$context" != "$EXPECTED_CONTEXT" || "$account" != "$ACCOUNT" ]]; then
  echo "Contexto o cuenta incorrectos: $context / $account" >&2
  exit 2
fi

cluster_json=$(kubectl -n "$NAMESPACE" get cluster "$PG_CLUSTER" -o json)
primary=$(jq -r '.status.currentPrimary // empty' <<<"$cluster_json")
pods_json=$(kubectl -n "$NAMESPACE" get pods -l "cnpg.io/cluster=${PG_CLUSTER},cnpg.io/podRole=instance" -o json)

echo '=== Estado CNPG ==='
jq '{desired:.spec.instances,ready:.status.readyInstances,primary:.status.currentPrimary,phase:.status.phase,instances:.status.instancesStatus,conditions:[.status.conditions[]? | {type,status,reason,message,lastTransitionTime}]}' <<<"$cluster_json"
jq -r '.items[] | [.metadata.name,.status.phase,([.status.containerStatuses[]? | "\(.name)=\(.ready)"] | join(",")),(.spec.nodeName // "sin-nodo")] | @tsv' <<<"$pods_json"

echo '=== Backup y ObjectStore ==='
objectstore_json=$(kubectl -n "$NAMESPACE" get objectstore cnpg-nubo-s3-backups -o json)
jq '{destination:.spec.configuration.destinationPath,serverName:.spec.configuration.serverName,status:.status}' <<<"$objectstore_json"
kubectl -n "$NAMESPACE" get backups -o json |
  jq -r '[.items[] | select(.spec.cluster.name == "cloudnative-pg-nubo")] | sort_by(.metadata.creationTimestamp) | reverse | .[:10][] | [.metadata.name,.status.phase,(.status.startedAt // ""),(.status.stoppedAt // ""),(.status.error // "")] | @tsv'
kubectl -n "$NAMESPACE" get scheduledbackup "${PG_CLUSTER}-weekly" -o json |
  jq '{schedule:.spec.schedule,immediate:.spec.immediate,suspend:.spec.suspend,lastScheduleTime:.status.lastScheduleTime}'

echo '=== Segmentos WAL que fallaron en los dos switchover ==='
destination=$(jq -r '.spec.configuration.destinationPath // empty' <<<"$objectstore_json")
server_name=$(jq -r --arg cluster "$PG_CLUSTER" '[.spec.plugins[]? | select(.name == "barman-cloud.cloudnative-pg.io") | .parameters.serverName][0] // $cluster' <<<"$cluster_json")
if [[ "$destination" =~ ^s3://([^/]+)(/.*)?$ ]]; then
  bucket=${BASH_REMATCH[1]}
  root=${BASH_REMATCH[2]:-}
  root=${root#/}
  root=${root%/}
  for wal in 0000000B0000001B00000048 0000000D0000001B00000088; do
    prefix="${root:+${root}/}${server_name}/wals/${wal:0:16}/${wal}"
    echo "$wal: s3://$bucket/$prefix"
    if objects=$(aws s3api list-objects-v2 --region "$REGION" --bucket "$bucket" --prefix "$prefix" --max-keys 10 2>&1); then
      jq '{objects:[.Contents[]? | {Key,Size,LastModified}],truncated:.IsTruncated}' <<<"$objects"
    else
      echo "NO VERIFICADO: consulta S3 fallida: $objects" >&2
    fi
  done
else
  echo "NO VERIFICADO: destinationPath no es S3: $destination" >&2
fi

if [[ -n "$primary" ]]; then
  echo "=== PostgreSQL en primario $primary ==="
  kubectl -n "$NAMESPACE" exec "$primary" -c postgres -- psql -X -U postgres -d postgres -P pager=off -c \
    "select name,setting,unit from pg_settings where name in ('archive_mode','archive_command','restore_command','archive_timeout','wal_keep_size','max_wal_size','max_slot_wal_keep_size','max_wal_senders','synchronous_commit') order by name;"
  kubectl -n "$NAMESPACE" exec "$primary" -c postgres -- psql -X -U postgres -d postgres -P pager=off -c \
    'select application_name,state,sync_state,write_lsn,flush_lsn,replay_lsn from pg_stat_replication;'
  kubectl -n "$NAMESPACE" exec "$primary" -c postgres -- psql -X -U postgres -d postgres -P pager=off -c \
    'select archived_count,last_archived_wal,last_archived_time,failed_count,last_failed_wal,last_failed_time from pg_stat_archiver;'
  kubectl -n "$NAMESPACE" exec "$primary" -c postgres -- psql -X -U postgres -d postgres -P pager=off -c \
    'select slot_name,slot_type,active,restart_lsn,wal_status,pg_size_pretty(pg_wal_lsn_diff(pg_current_wal_lsn(),restart_lsn)) as retained_distance from pg_replication_slots;'
fi

suspect=${1:-}
if [[ -z "$suspect" ]]; then
  suspect=$(jq -r --arg primary "$primary" '[.items[] | select(.metadata.name != $primary) | select([.status.conditions[]? | select(.type == "Ready" and .status == "True")] | length == 0) | .metadata.name][0] // empty' <<<"$pods_json")
fi
if [[ -n "$suspect" ]] && kubectl -n "$NAMESPACE" get pod "$suspect" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "=== Instancia no lista o indicada: $suspect ==="
  kubectl -n "$NAMESPACE" get pod "$suspect" -o json |
    jq '{name:.metadata.name,node:.spec.nodeName,containers:[.status.containerStatuses[]? | {name,ready,restartCount,state}]}'
  kubectl -n "$NAMESPACE" logs "$suspect" -c postgres --since=6h --tail=500 2>/dev/null |
    jq -Rr 'fromjson? | select((.msg // "") | test("pg_rewind|restore|archive|WAL|Switchover|failover|shutdown|error";"i")) | [.ts,.level,.msg] | @tsv' | tail -60 || true
  containers=$(kubectl -n "$NAMESPACE" get pod "$suspect" -o jsonpath='{.spec.containers[*].name}')
  if [[ " $containers " == *' plugin-barman-cloud '* ]]; then
    echo '=== Errores del sidecar Barman ==='
    kubectl -n "$NAMESPACE" logs "$suspect" -c plugin-barman-cloud --since=6h --tail=300 2>/dev/null |
      jq -Rr 'fromjson? | select((.msg // "") | test("restore|archive|wal|error|fail";"i")) | [.ts,.level,.msg] | @tsv' | tail -60 || true
  else
    echo 'Sin sidecar plugin-barman-cloud en esta instancia.'
  fi
fi

echo '=== Eventos recientes ==='
kubectl -n "$NAMESPACE" get events --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail -30

```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/infrastructure/postgresql-nubo/monitoring-queries-replicacion.yaml

```yaml
---
# Consultas propias del exporter de CNPG para la replicacion logica hacia reportes (diseno L3, seccion 10).
# Las de CNPG por defecto no exponen wal_status: con el slot 'lost' su pg_wal_lsn_diff queda nulo y las alertas
# de retencion dejan de dispararse, mientras la suscripcion sigue 'enabled' sin errores de apply (hallazgo H18).
# Se ejecutan en todas las instancias: en un standby permiten detectar la copia vieja del slot que queda en el
# ex primario despues de un switchover (synced=false con failover=true, hallazgo H16).
# Metricas: cnpg_nubo_slots_<columna>{slot_name, slot_type, wal_status}
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: cnpg-nubo-monitoring-replicacion
  namespace: postgresql-nubo
  labels:
    cnpg.io/reload: "true"
data:
  # Cambiar la linea de version modifica el contenido y fuerza la recarga en el instance manager
  # (cnpg.io/reload). La primera carga del 2026-10-22 02:49 UTC fallo por permisos antes de que el
  # operador actualizara el Role del cluster.
  queries: |
    # version: 2026-10-22
    nubo_slots:
      query: |
        SELECT slot_name,
               slot_type,
               coalesce(wal_status, 'desconocido') AS wal_status,
               CASE WHEN wal_status IN ('unreserved', 'lost') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS en_riesgo,
               CASE WHEN wal_status = 'lost' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS perdido,
               CASE WHEN NOT pg_catalog.pg_is_in_recovery() AND NOT active THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS inactivo_en_primario,
               CASE WHEN pg_catalog.pg_is_in_recovery() AND failover AND NOT synced THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS copia_obsoleta_en_standby,
               coalesce(pg_catalog.pg_wal_lsn_diff(
                   CASE WHEN pg_catalog.pg_is_in_recovery() THEN pg_catalog.pg_last_wal_receive_lsn()
                        ELSE pg_catalog.pg_current_wal_lsn() END, restart_lsn), 0) AS retenido_bytes
        FROM pg_catalog.pg_replication_slots
        WHERE slot_type = 'logical' AND NOT temporary
      metrics:
        - slot_name:
            usage: "LABEL"
            description: "Nombre del slot"
        - slot_type:
            usage: "LABEL"
            description: "Tipo de slot"
        - wal_status:
            usage: "LABEL"
            description: "reserved, extended, unreserved o lost"
        - en_riesgo:
            usage: "GAUGE"
            description: "1 si el slot supero max_slot_wal_keep_size (unreserved) o se perdio (lost)"
        - perdido:
            usage: "GAUGE"
            description: "1 si el slot se invalido (lost): la suscripcion no puede continuar, runbook 11.4"
        - inactivo_en_primario:
            usage: "GAUGE"
            description: "1 si el slot no tiene consumidor en el primario"
        - copia_obsoleta_en_standby:
            usage: "GAUGE"
            description: "1 si en un standby hay una copia no sincronizada de un slot con failover (runbook 11.3)"
        - retenido_bytes:
            usage: "GAUGE"
            description: "WAL retenido por el slot en bytes (0 si se perdio)"

```

```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: pooler-ingress
  namespace: postgresql-nubo
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchExpressions:
      - key: app
        operator: In
        values:
          - cloudnative-pg-nubo-pooler-ro
          - cloudnative-pg-nubo-pooler-rw
  policyTypes:
    - Ingress
  ingress:
    - from:
        - namespaceSelector:
            matchLabels:
              security.nuam.io/environment: prod
      ports:

          port: 5432
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: postgres-ingress
  namespace: postgresql-nubo
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      cnpg.io/cluster: cloudnative-pg-nubo
  policyTypes:
    - Ingress
  ingress:
    - from:
        - podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              cnpg.io/cluster: cloudnative-pg-nubo
        # Replica fisica de reportes: streaming desde cloudnative-pg-nubo-rw.
        - podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              cnpg.io/cluster: cloudnative-pg-nubo-reportes
        # Suscriptor logico de reportes (otro namespace): apply y tablesync como repl_reportes
        # (diseno L3, 5.5). namespaceSelector y podSelector en el MISMO elemento = ambos deben cumplirse.
        - namespaceSelector:
            matchLabels:
              kubernetes.io/metadata.name: postgresql-nubo-reportes
          podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              cnpg.io/cluster: cloudnative-pg-nubo-reportes
        - podSelector:
            matchExpressions:
              - key: app
                operator: In
                values:
                  - cloudnative-pg-nubo-pooler-ro
                  - cloudnative-pg-nubo-pooler-rw
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 5432
    - from:
        - namespaceSelector:
            matchLabels:
              kubernetes.io/metadata.name: cloudnative-pg
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 8000
    - from:
        - namespaceSelector:
            matchLabels:
              kubernetes.io/metadata.name: monitoring
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 9187
```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/infrastructure/postgresql-nubo/patch-pg-cluster.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: postgresql.cnpg.io/v1
kind: Cluster
metadata:
  name: cloudnative-pg-nubo
  namespace: postgresql-nubo
spec:
  # Un primario y dos replicas; los limites de slots y WAL senders ya
  # estan aplicados en las instancias existentes.
  instances: 3

  # Una replica sin receptor WAL no debe atender el servicio -ro ni ser
  # candidata a promocion aunque PostgreSQL acepte conexiones locales.
  probes:
    readiness:
      type: streaming

  # Rol dedicado para la suscripcion logica sub_reportes de postgresql-nubo-reportes (diseno L3).
  # Reemplaza el uso de postgres: con enableSuperuserAccess=false CNPG anula su clave.
  # El Secret basic-auth repl-reportes-credentials se crea fuera de Git (ESO/Vault no
  # disponible en prod al 2026-10-17). Plan: docs/plans/prod/plan-v2-L3-diseno-detallado-reportes-prod.md
  managed:
    roles:
      - name: repl_reportes
        ensure: present
        login: true
        replication: true
        superuser: false
        # 1 apply + hasta 4 tablesync en la copia inicial + slots temporales de tablesync (diseno L3, 5.4)
        connectionLimit: 8
        passwordSecret:
          name: repl-reportes-credentials

  # Slot logico de reportes sincronizado a los standbys (PG17, failover=true en la suscripcion): ante un
  # switchover o failover la suscripcion sigue sin perdida. Exige hot_standby_feedback y
  # sync_replication_slots en "on" (parametros, abajo). Validado en laboratorio (R902/R903). Despues del
  # PRIMER switchover tras crear el slot, borrar la copia vieja en el ex primario (runbook 11.3, H16).
  replicationSlots:
    highAvailability:
      enabled: true
      synchronizeLogicalDecoding: true

  # Consultas propias del exporter: estado de los slots (wal_status, copia obsoleta en standby) para las
  # alertas de monitoring/prometheusrule-cnpg-slots.yaml (hallazgos H16 y H18 del laboratorio).
  monitoring:
    customQueriesConfigMap:
      - name: cnpg-nubo-monitoring-replicacion
        key: queries

  # El ObjectStore por si solo no activa el archivado ni los backups.
  plugins:
    - name: barman-cloud.cloudnative-pg.io
      isWALArchiver: true
      parameters:
        barmanObjectName: cnpg-nubo-s3-backups

  # Backup mensual por snapshots EBS (retención 12 meses, requisito de Continuidad).
  # online: se toma sin detener la instancia; waitForArchive asegura que el WAL
  # necesario quede archivado antes de cerrar el snapshot.
  # snapshotOwnerReference none: los VolumeSnapshot no se borran si se borra el Backup.
  backup:
    volumeSnapshot:
      className: ebs-csi-snapclass-mensual
      walClassName: ebs-csi-snapclass-mensual
      online: true
      onlineConfiguration:
        immediateCheckpoint: true
        waitForArchive: true
      snapshotOwnerReference: none

  # 1. Configuración de recursos requeridos
  resources:
    requests:
      cpu: "1"
      memory: "8Gi"
    limits:
      memory: "12Gi"

  # 2. Actualización de parámetros de PostgreSQL
  postgresql:
    parameters:
      shared_buffers: "3GB"
      work_mem: "4MB"
      effective_io_concurrency: "100"
      # El 13/10/2026 habia 32/32 slots ocupados por HA y sincronizacion
      # logica de tablas. Reservar margen para pg_basebackup y replicas nuevas.
      max_replication_slots: "512"
      max_logical_replication_workers: "32"
      max_sync_workers_per_subscription: "16"
 
      max_wal_senders: "70"
      # CNPG 1.27 usa 512MB por defecto. En el incidente, pg_rewind
      # necesito un segmento ~800MiB anterior al ultimo checkpoint.
      # Reservar 8GiB en cada volumen WAL de 64GiB da margen local;
      # el archivo remoto sigue siendo necesario para caidas largas.
      wal_keep_size: "8GB"
      # Replicacion logica hacia reportes (diseno L3, 5.3). Los tres son sighup (sin reinicio).
      # Tope de WAL retenido por slot: con la suscripcion detenida el slot pasa a 'lost' al superar
      # 20GB en vez de llenar el volumen WAL de 64GiB (laboratorio T14). ~99MB/h de WAL => ~8 dias.
      max_slot_wal_keep_size: "20GB"
      # Obligatorios con synchronizeLogicalDecoding (el webhook de CNPG 1.30 lo rechaza sin ellos).
      # hot_standby_feedback: vigilar bloat por consultas largas en los standbys de pooler-ro.
      hot_standby_feedback: "on"
      sync_replication_slots: "on"
      maintenance_work_mem: "256MB"                # 512MB (base) -> 256MB
      autovacuum_work_mem: "128MB"                 # nuevo: separa autovacuum de maintenance
      idle_in_transaction_session_timeout: "300s"  # nuevo: corta sesiones "idle in transaction"
      log_temp_files: "10240"                      # nuevo: registra consultas que usan disco temporal           # sin cambio


  # Una instancia por nodo; el spread prefiere 1/1/1 con tres AZ y 2/1 con
  # dos. ScheduleAnyway evita bloquear la replica si la AZ fallida aun cuenta.
  affinity:
    nodeSelector:
      workload: infra
    tolerations:
      - key: workload
        operator: Equal
        value: infra
        effect: NoSchedule
    podAntiAffinityType: required
    topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
  topologySpreadConstraints:
    - maxSkew: 1
      topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
      whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
      nodeAffinityPolicy: Honor
      nodeTaintsPolicy: Honor
      labelSelector:
        matchLabels:
          cnpg.io/cluster: cloudnative-pg-nubo
          cnpg.io/podRole: instance
```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/infrastructure/postgresql-nubo/preflight-az-failure.sh

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Read-only preflight for the production CloudNativePG AZ-failure exercise.
set -euo pipefail

REGION=us-east-1
ACCOUNT=242736647867
CLUSTER=eks-nbo-postneg-prod-eks
NAMESPACE=postgresql-nubo
PG_CLUSTER=cloudnative-pg-nubo
EXPECTED_CONTEXT="arn:aws:eks:${REGION}:${ACCOUNT}:cluster/${CLUSTER}"

for command in aws kubectl jq; do
  command -v "$command" >/dev/null || { echo "Falta $command" >&2; exit 2; }
done

actual_context=$(kubectl config current-context)
actual_account=$(aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text)
if [[ "$actual_context" != "$EXPECTED_CONTEXT" || "$actual_account" != "$ACCOUNT" ]]; then
  echo "Contexto o cuenta incorrectos: $actual_context / $actual_account" >&2
  exit 2
fi

failed=0

echo '=== CloudNativePG ==='
cluster_json=$(kubectl -n "$NAMESPACE" get cluster "$PG_CLUSTER" -o json)
echo "$cluster_json" | jq -r '"Deseadas=\(.spec.instances) listas=\(.status.readyInstances // 0) primario=\(.status.currentPrimary // "ninguno") fase=\(.status.phase // "desconocida")"'
if ! echo "$cluster_json" | jq -e '.spec.instances == 3 and .status.readyInstances == 3 and .status.currentPrimary != null and ([.status.conditions[]? | select(.type == "Ready" and .status == "True")] | length == 1)' >/dev/null; then
  echo 'FALLO: CNPG no esta 3/3 Ready.' >&2
  failed=1
fi
if ! echo "$cluster_json" | jq -e '
  .spec.probes.readiness.type == "streaming" and
  any(.spec.plugins[]?; .name == "barman-cloud.cloudnative-pg.io" and
    .isWALArchiver == true and .parameters.barmanObjectName == "cnpg-nubo-s3-backups")
' >/dev/null; then
  echo 'FALLO: faltan la readiness streaming o el archivador Barman en el Cluster.' >&2
  failed=1
fi
if ! echo "$cluster_json" | jq -e 'any(.status.conditions[]?; .type == "ContinuousArchiving" and .status == "True")' >/dev/null; then
  echo 'FALLO: CNPG no confirma archivado continuo de WAL.' >&2
  failed=1
fi
if ! echo "$cluster_json" | jq -e 'any(.status.conditions[]?; .type == "LastBackupSucceeded" and .status == "True")' >/dev/null; then
  echo 'FALLO: el ultimo backup no figura como exitoso; verificar Barman antes de la prueba.' >&2
  failed=1
fi
if ! echo "$cluster_json" | jq -e '
  .spec.affinity.podAntiAffinityType == "required" and
  .spec.affinity.topologyKey == "kubernetes.io/hostname" and
  any(.spec.topologySpreadConstraints[]?;
    .topologyKey == "topology.kubernetes.io/zone" and
    .whenUnsatisfiable == "ScheduleAnyway" and .maxSkew == 1)
' >/dev/null; then
  echo 'FALLO: la distribucion por AZ de Flux aun no esta aplicada a CNPG.' >&2
  failed=1
fi
for pooler in "${PG_CLUSTER}-pooler-ro" "${PG_CLUSTER}-pooler-rw"; do
  pooler_json=$(kubectl -n "$NAMESPACE" get pooler "$pooler" -o json)
  if ! echo "$pooler_json" | jq -e 'any(.spec.template.spec.topologySpreadConstraints[]?; .topologyKey == "topology.kubernetes.io/zone" and .whenUnsatisfiable == "ScheduleAnyway")' >/dev/null; then
    echo "FALLO: $pooler no tiene distribucion tolerante a perdida de AZ." >&2
    failed=1
  fi
done

echo '=== Instancias y zonas ==='
pods_json=$(kubectl -n "$NAMESPACE" get pods -l "cnpg.io/cluster=${PG_CLUSTER},cnpg.io/podRole=instance" -o json)
nodes_json=$(kubectl get nodes -o json)
if ! echo "$pods_json" | jq -e '[.items[] | select(any(.spec.containers[]?; .name == "plugin-barman-cloud"))] | length == 3' >/dev/null; then
  echo 'FALLO: faltan sidecars Barman en una o mas instancias PostgreSQL.' >&2
  failed=1
fi
echo "$pods_json" | jq -r --argjson nodes "$nodes_json" '.items[] | . as $pod | ($nodes.items[] | select(.metadata.name == $pod.spec.nodeName)) as $node | "\($pod.metadata.name) \($pod.status.phase) nodo=\($pod.spec.nodeName) zona=\($node.metadata.labels["topology.kubernetes.io/zone"] // "sin-zona")"'
if ! echo "$pods_json" | jq -e --argjson nodes "$nodes_json" '
  [.items[] | select(.status.phase == "Running" and .spec.nodeName != null) | . as $pod |
   $nodes.items[] | select(.metadata.name == $pod.spec.nodeName) |
   select(.metadata.labels.workload == "infra") |
   .metadata.labels["topology.kubernetes.io/zone"]] | length == 3 and (unique | length == 3)
' >/dev/null; then
  echo 'FALLO: se requieren tres instancias Running en tres nodos infra y tres AZ.' >&2
  failed=1
fi

echo '=== Replicacion y endpoints de lectura ==='
primary=$(echo "$cluster_json" | jq -r '.status.currentPrimary // empty')
if [[ -n "$primary" ]]; then
  primary_replication=$(kubectl -n "$NAMESPACE" exec "$primary" -c postgres -- \
    psql -U postgres -d postgres -Atc \
    "select count(*) from pg_stat_replication where state = 'streaming' and sync_state in ('quorum','sync');")
  echo "Replicas sincronicas conectadas al primario: $primary_replication"
  if [[ ! "$primary_replication" =~ ^[0-9]+$ || "$primary_replication" -lt 1 ]]; then
    echo 'FALLO: el primario no tiene replica sincronica conectada.' >&2
    failed=1
  fi
  wal_keep_mb=$(kubectl -n "$NAMESPACE" exec "$primary" -c postgres -- \
    psql -U postgres -d postgres -Atc \
    "select setting from pg_settings where name = 'wal_keep_size' and unit = 'MB';")
  echo "wal_keep_size efectivo en primario: ${wal_keep_mb}MB"
  if [[ ! "$wal_keep_mb" =~ ^[0-9]+$ || "$wal_keep_mb" -lt 8192 ]]; then
    echo 'FALLO: wal_keep_size efectivo es menor que 8GiB.' >&2
    failed=1
  fi
fi
while IFS= read -r replica; do
  [[ -n "$replica" ]] || continue
  receiver=$(kubectl -n "$NAMESPACE" exec "$replica" -c postgres -- \
    psql -U postgres -d postgres -Atc \
    "select pg_is_in_recovery(),coalesce((select status from pg_stat_wal_receiver limit 1),'none');")
  echo "$replica: $receiver"
  if [[ "$receiver" != 't|streaming' ]]; then
    echo "FALLO: $replica aparece Ready pero no recibe WAL por streaming." >&2
    failed=1
  fi
done < <(echo "$pods_json" | jq -r --arg primary "$primary" '
  .items[] | select(.metadata.name != $primary) |
  select(any(.status.conditions[]?; .type == "Ready" and .status == "True")) |
  .metadata.name')
ro_endpoints=$(kubectl -n "$NAMESPACE" get endpointslice \
  -l "kubernetes.io/service-name=${PG_CLUSTER}-ro" -o json)
while IFS= read -r replica; do
  [[ -n "$replica" ]] || continue
  if [[ "$replica" == "$primary" ]]; then
    echo 'FALLO: el primario aparece en el servicio de lectura.' >&2
    failed=1
    continue
  fi
  receiver=$(kubectl -n "$NAMESPACE" exec "$replica" -c postgres -- \
    psql -U postgres -d postgres -Atc \
    "select coalesce((select status from pg_stat_wal_receiver limit 1),'none');")
  if [[ "$receiver" != streaming ]]; then
    echo "FALLO: el servicio -ro puede enviar lecturas a $replica sin streaming." >&2
    failed=1
  fi
done < <(echo "$ro_endpoints" | jq -r '.items[].endpoints[] | select(.conditions.ready == true) | .targetRef.name // empty' | sort -u)

echo '=== PVC y EBS ==='
binding=$(kubectl get storageclass ebs-sc-gp3 -o jsonpath='{.volumeBindingMode}')
if [[ "$binding" != WaitForFirstConsumer ]]; then
  echo "FALLO: ebs-sc-gp3 usa $binding en lugar de WaitForFirstConsumer." >&2
  failed=1
fi
pvc_json=$(kubectl -n "$NAMESPACE" get pvc -l "cnpg.io/cluster=${PG_CLUSTER}" -o json)
claim_count=$(echo "$pvc_json" | jq '[.items[] | select(.metadata.labels["cnpg.io/pvcRole"] == "PG_DATA" or .metadata.labels["cnpg.io/pvcRole"] == "PG_WAL")] | length')
if [[ "$claim_count" -ne 6 ]]; then
  echo "FALLO: se esperaban seis PVC de datos/WAL; encontrados $claim_count." >&2
  failed=1
fi
while IFS=$'\t' read -r claim phase pv storage_class instance; do
  [[ -n "$claim" ]] || continue
  if [[ "$phase" != Bound || -z "$pv" || "$storage_class" != ebs-sc-gp3 ]]; then
    echo "FALLO: PVC $claim: $phase / $pv / $storage_class" >&2
    failed=1
    continue
  fi
  pv_json=$(kubectl get pv "$pv" -o json)
  volume=$(echo "$pv_json" | jq -r '.spec.csi.volumeHandle // empty')
  if [[ ! "$volume" =~ ^vol-[0-9a-f]+$ ]]; then
    echo "FALLO: PV $pv no usa un EBS CSI valido." >&2
    failed=1
    continue
  fi
  zone=$(aws ec2 describe-volumes --region "$REGION" --volume-ids "$volume" --query 'Volumes[0].AvailabilityZone' --output text)
  pod_node=$(echo "$pods_json" | jq -r --arg instance "$instance" '.items[] | select(.metadata.name == $instance) | .spec.nodeName // empty')
  pod_zone=$(echo "$nodes_json" | jq -r --arg node "$pod_node" '.items[] | select(.metadata.name == $node) | .metadata.labels["topology.kubernetes.io/zone"] // empty')
  echo "$claim -> $volume ($zone), pod=$instance ($pod_zone)"
  if [[ -z "$pod_zone" || "$zone" != "$pod_zone" ]]; then
    echo "FALLO: el EBS de $claim no esta en la zona de su pod." >&2
    failed=1
  fi
done < <(echo "$pvc_json" | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.labels["cnpg.io/pvcRole"] == "PG_DATA" or .metadata.labels["cnpg.io/pvcRole"] == "PG_WAL") | [.metadata.name, .status.phase, .spec.volumeName, .spec.storageClassName, .metadata.labels["cnpg.io/instanceName"]] | @tsv')

echo '=== Capacidad AWS ==='
nodegroups=$(aws eks list-nodegroups --region "$REGION" --cluster-name "$CLUSTER" --query 'nodegroups' --output json)
echo "$nodegroups" | jq -r '.[]'
while IFS= read -r group; do
  [[ -n "$group" ]] || continue
  aws eks describe-nodegroup --region "$REGION" --cluster-name "$CLUSTER" --nodegroup-name "$group" \
    --query 'nodegroup.{Name:nodegroupName,Status:status,Min:scalingConfig.minSize,Desired:scalingConfig.desiredSize,Max:scalingConfig.maxSize,ASGs:resources.autoScalingGroups[].name,Subnets:subnets}' --output json
done < <(echo "$nodegroups" | jq -r '.[]')
echo 'ASG descubiertos por Cluster Autoscaler:'
asgs=$(aws autoscaling describe-auto-scaling-groups --region "$REGION" --output json)
echo "$asgs" | jq -r --arg cluster "$CLUSTER" '
  .AutoScalingGroups[] |
  select(any(.Tags[]?; .Key == "k8s.io/cluster-autoscaler/enabled" and .Value == "true")) |
  select(any(.Tags[]?; .Key == ("k8s.io/cluster-autoscaler/" + $cluster) and .Value == "owned")) |
  "\(.AutoScalingGroupName) min=\(.MinSize) desired=\(.DesiredCapacity) max=\(.MaxSize) AZ=\(.AvailabilityZones | join(","))"
'
asg_count=$(echo "$asgs" | jq --arg cluster "$CLUSTER" '[.AutoScalingGroups[] | select(any(.Tags[]?; .Key == "k8s.io/cluster-autoscaler/enabled" and .Value == "true")) | select(any(.Tags[]?; .Key == ("k8s.io/cluster-autoscaler/" + $cluster) and .Value == "owned"))] | length')
if [[ "$asg_count" -eq 0 ]]; then
  echo 'FALLO: no hay ASG descubiertos por Cluster Autoscaler.' >&2
  failed=1
fi
echo 'Nodos infra por zona:'
echo "$nodes_json" | jq -r '[.items[] | select(.metadata.labels.workload == "infra") | .metadata.labels["topology.kubernetes.io/zone"]] | group_by(.)[] | "\(.[0]): \(length)"'

echo '=== Autoscaler y respaldos ==='
autoscaler_json=$(kubectl -n kube-system get deployment cluster-autoscaler -o json)
echo "$autoscaler_json" | jq -r '"Cluster Autoscaler: deseadas=\(.spec.replicas) disponibles=\(.status.availableReplicas // 0)"'
if ! echo "$autoscaler_json" | jq -e '(.status.availableReplicas // 0) >= 1' >/dev/null; then
  echo 'FALLO: Cluster Autoscaler no tiene replicas disponibles.' >&2
  failed=1
fi
kubectl -n "$NAMESPACE" get backups,scheduledbackups --ignore-not-found
kubectl -n "$NAMESPACE" get volumesnapshots.snapshot.storage.k8s.io --ignore-not-found
schedule_json=$(kubectl -n "$NAMESPACE" get scheduledbackup "${PG_CLUSTER}-weekly" -o json)
if ! echo "$schedule_json" | jq -e '.spec.method == "plugin" and .spec.pluginConfiguration.name == "barman-cloud.cloudnative-pg.io" and .spec.suspend != true' >/dev/null; then
  echo 'FALLO: el backup programado Barman no esta activo.' >&2
  failed=1
fi
backups_json=$(kubectl -n "$NAMESPACE" get backups -o json)
if ! echo "$backups_json" | jq -e --arg cluster "$PG_CLUSTER" '
  any(.items[]?; .spec.cluster.name == $cluster and .spec.method == "plugin" and .status.phase == "completed")
' >/dev/null; then
  echo 'FALLO: no hay un backup base Barman completado; PITR no esta demostrado.' >&2
  failed=1
fi

if [[ "$failed" -ne 0 ]]; then
  echo 'NO LISTO: fallaron requisitos verificables.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo 'Comprobaciones de lectura aprobadas. Antes de provocar una caida: verificar maximos/zonas de ASG, restauracion de backup, fencing y procedimiento de retorno 1/1/1.'

```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/infrastructure/postgresql-nubo/publication-reportes.yaml

```yaml
---
# Publicacion de la replicacion logica hacia reportes (diseno L3, seccion 5.6).
# Todo el esquema NUANBODB (275 tablas al 2026-10-22: 31 raices particionadas + 244 normales). Con
# publish_via_partition_root los cambios viajan como cambios de la raiz: el suscriptor tiene su propio
# particionado mensual y no ve las hojas HOT/WARM. Sin truncate: el cierre no trunca y un TRUNCATE manual
# vaciaria reportes.
# Prerrequisitos (verificados el 2026-10-22): 171 aplicado (0 tablas sin identidad de replica) y 170
# aplicado (el movimiento del cierre va marcado con origin y la suscripcion, con origin=none, no lo recibe).
# Se agrega a kustomization.yaml el dia de la copia inicial (runbook del sabado, paso P04). Antes de
# agregarlo: toda tabla nueva de NUANBODB debe tener PK; si no, el primario rechaza sus UPDATE/DELETE (H15).
# publicationReclaimPolicy delete: si se borra este recurso (o se quita de la kustomization), CNPG elimina la
# publicacion y la suscripcion de reportes falla.
apiVersion: postgresql.cnpg.io/v1
kind: Publication
metadata:
  name: pub-reportes
  namespace: postgresql-nubo
spec:
  cluster:
    name: cloudnative-pg-nubo
  dbname: nubo
  name: pub_reportes
  target:
    objects:
      - tablesInSchema: NUANBODB
  parameters:
    publish_via_partition_root: "true"
    publish: "insert, update, delete"
  publicationReclaimPolicy: delete

```

```yaml
apiVersion: snapshot.storage.k8s.io/v1
kind: VolumeSnapshotClass
metadata:
  name: ebs-csi-snapclass-mensual
driver: ebs.csi.aws.com
# Retain: si se borra el VolumeSnapshot en Kubernetes, el snapshot EBS se conserva.
# Exigido para copias de largo plazo (12 meses, requisito de Continuidad).
deletionPolicy: Retain
parameters:
  # Etiquetas en AWS para identificar y depurar los snapshots al cumplir 12 meses.
  tagSpecification_1: "nuam.io/retencion=12m"
  tagSpecification_2: "nuam.io/origen=cloudnative-pg-nubo"
  tagSpecification_3: "nuam.io/tipo=backup-mensual-postgresql"
```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/infrastructure/postgresql-nubo-reportes-suscriptor/subscription-reportes.yaml

```yaml
---
# Suscripcion de reportes (diseno L3, seccion 7). Cluster suscriptor: cloudnative-pg-nubo-reportes en el
# namespace postgresql-nubo-reportes (no confundir con la replica fisica E, que vive en postgresql-nubo).
# TODAVIA NO GESTIONADO POR FLUX: este directorio no tiene Kustomization en kustoms/. El sabado de la copia
# inicial se aplica con kubectl (runbook, paso P04); la adopcion en Flux del cluster suscriptor es posterior
# (seccion 6.2) e incluira este archivo.
# Requiere en el Cluster suscriptor el externalCluster "nubo-publicador" (host cloudnative-pg-nubo-rw por TCP,
# usuario repl_reportes, sslmode=require, options con wal_sender_timeout=60s) y el Secret
# repl-reportes-credentials copiado desde postgresql-nubo. Validado en el laboratorio con R907.
apiVersion: postgresql.cnpg.io/v1
kind: Subscription
metadata:
  name: sub-reportes
  namespace: postgresql-nubo-reportes
spec:
  cluster:
    name: cloudnative-pg-nubo-reportes
  dbname: nubo
  name: sub_reportes
  externalClusterName: nubo-publicador
  publicationName: pub_reportes
  parameters:
    origin: "none"               # no recibir lo marcado con origin (movimiento del cierre, 170)
    copy_data: "true"            # copia inicial completa
    streaming: "parallel"        # transacciones grandes aplicadas en paralelo mientras se reciben
    binary: "false"              # texto: mas robusto ante diferencias de tipo (SCHEDULE_EXTENSION)
    disable_on_error: "true"     # ante un error de apply se deshabilita en vez de reintentar en bucle
    failover: "true"             # slot sincronizado a los standbys del publicador (synchronizeLogicalDecoding)
    synchronous_commit: "off"    # menor latencia de apply; la durabilidad la da el publicador
  subscriptionReclaimPolicy: delete

```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/infrastructure/restore-test/cluster-restore.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: postgresql.cnpg.io/v1
kind: Cluster
metadata:
  name: pg-restore-test
  namespace: postgresql-restore-test
spec:
  # Una sola instancia: solo para validar la restauración.
  instances: 1
  # Misma imagen que producción (un backup físico requiere la misma versión mayor).
  imageName: ghcr.io/cloudnative-pg/postgresql:17

  # Restaura desde el backup de producción en S3.
  # Restore al último punto disponible. Para PITR se agrega recoveryTarget.
  bootstrap:
    recovery:
      source: origen-prod

  externalClusters:
    - name: origen-prod
      plugin:
        name: barman-cloud.cloudnative-pg.io
        parameters:
          barmanObjectName: cnpg-nubo-s3-restore
          serverName: cloudnative-pg-nubo

  # Sin bloque "plugins": este cluster NO archiva WAL ni escribe en el bucket.

  storage:
    size: 50Gi
    storageClass: ebs-sc-gp3
  walStorage:
    size: 20Gi
    storageClass: ebs-sc-gp3

  resources:
    requests:
      cpu: 500m
      memory: 2Gi
    limits:
      memory: 4Gi

  # Mismos nodos de infraestructura que producción.
  affinity:
    nodeSelector:
      workload: infra
    tolerations:
      - key: workload
        operator: Equal
        value: infra
        effect: NoSchedule
```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/infrastructure/sftp/sftp-go-patch.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: sftpgo
spec:
  replicas: 3
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate               # antes Recreate (lo exigía el PVC RWO)
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1                     # crea el pod nuevo antes de quitar el viejo
      maxUnavailable: 0               # nunca baja de 3 pods listos
  template:
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: sftpgo
      nodeSelector:
        workload: infra
      tolerations:
        - key: workload
          operator: Equal
          value: infra
          effect: NoSchedule
      topologySpreadConstraints:
        - maxSkew: 1
          topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
          whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
          labelSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app.kubernetes.io/name: sftpgo
        # Una réplica por nodo: evita que 2 pods queden en el mismo nodo
        # (pasó el 13/10/2026 durante la prueba de caída de zona).
        - maxSkew: 1
          topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
          whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
          labelSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app.kubernetes.io/name: sftpgo
      containers:
        - name: sftpgo
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 256Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 1Gi                 # antes 512Mi; S3 usa buffers en memoria
          envFrom:
            - secretRef:
                name: sftpgo-secrets
          env:
            - name: SFTPGO_DATA_PROVIDER__DRIVER
              value: postgresql
            - name: SFTPGO_DATA_PROVIDER__HOST
              value: cloudnative-pg-nubo-pooler-rw.postgresql-nubo.svc.cluster.local
            - name: SFTPGO_DATA_PROVIDER__PORT
              value: "5432"
            - name: SFTPGO_DATA_PROVIDER__NAME
              value: sftpgo
            - name: SFTPGO_DATA_PROVIDER__USERNAME
              value: sftpgo
            - name: SFTPGO_DATA_PROVIDER__SSLMODE
              value: "1"
            - name: SFTPGO_DATA_PROVIDER__POOL_SIZE
              value: "10"
            - name: SFTPGO_DATA_PROVIDER__IS_SHARED
              value: "1"
            - name: SFTPGO_SFTPD__HOST_KEYS
              value: /etc/sftpgo/hostkeys/id_rsa,/etc/sftpgo/hostkeys/id_ecdsa,/etc/sftpgo/hostkeys/id_ed25519
          volumeMounts:
            - name: sftp-storage
              mountPath: /var/lib/sftpgo
            - name: sftp-storage
              mountPath: /srv/sftpgo/data
              subPath: data
            - name: hostkeys
              mountPath: /etc/sftpgo/hostkeys
              readOnly: true
      volumes:
        - name: sftp-storage
          persistentVolumeClaim: null     # se desconecta el PVC
          emptyDir: {}                    # disco temporal por pod (ya no guarda datos)
        - name: hostkeys
          secret:
            secretName: "[REDACTED]"
            defaultMode: 0440
```

```yaml
                    If DataMover is "" or "velero", the built-in data mover will be used.
                  type: string
                nodeOS:
                  description: NodeOS is OS of the node where the DataDownload is
                    processed.
                  enum:
                  - auto
                  - linux
                  - windows
                  type: string
                operationTimeout:
                  description: |-
                    OperationTimeout specifies the time used to wait internal operations,
                    before returning error as timeout.
                  type: string
                snapshotID:
                  description: SnapshotID is the ID of the Velero backup snapshot
                    to be restored from.
                  type: string
                snapshotSize:
                  description: SnapshotSize is the logical size in Bytes of the snapshot.
                  format: int64
                  type: integer
                sourceNamespace:
                  description: |-
                    SourceNamespace is the original namespace where the volume is backed up from.
                    It may be different from SourcePVC's namespace if namespace is remapped during restore.
                  type: string
                targetVolume:
                  description: TargetVolume is the information of the target PVC and
                    PV.
                  properties:
                    namespace:
                      description: Namespace is the target namespace
                      type: string
                    pv:
                      description: PV is the name of the target PV that is created
                        by Velero restore
                      type: string
                    pvc:
                      description: PVC is the name of the target PVC that is created
                        by Velero restore
                      type: string
                  required:
                  - namespace
                  - pv
                  - pvc
                  type: object
              required:
              - backupStorageLocation
              - operationTimeout
              - snapshotID
              - sourceNamespace
              - targetVolume
              type: object
            status:
              description: DataDownloadStatus is the current status of a DataDownload.
              properties:
                acceptedByNode:
                  description: Node is name of the node where the DataUpload is prepared.
                  type: string
                acceptedTimestamp:
                  description: |-
                    AcceptedTimestamp records the time the DataUpload is to be prepared.
                    The server's time is used for AcceptedTimestamp
                  format: date-time
                  nullable: true
                  type: string
                completionTimestamp:
                  description: |-
                    CompletionTimestamp records the time a restore was completed.
                    Completion time is recorded even on failed restores.
                    The server's time is used for CompletionTimestamps
                  format: date-time
                  nullable: true
                  type: string
                message:
                  description: Message is a message about the DataDownload's status.
                  type: string
                node:
                  description: Node is name of the node where the DataDownload is
                    processed.
                  type: string
                phase:
                  description: Phase is the current state of the DataDownload.
                  enum:
                  - New
                  - Accepted
                  - Prepared
                  - InProgress
                  - Canceling
                  - Canceled
                  - Completed
                  - Failed
                  type: string
                progress:
                  description: |-
                    Progress holds the total number of bytes of the snapshot and the current
                    number of restored bytes. This can be used to display progress information
                    about the restore operation.
                  properties:
                    bytesDone:
                      format: int64
                      type: integer
                    totalBytes:
                      format: int64
                      type: integer
                  type: object
                startTimestamp:
                  description: |-
                    StartTimestamp records the time a restore was started.
                    The server's time is used for StartTimestamps
                  format: date-time
                  nullable: true
                  type: string
              type: object
          type: object
      served: true
      storage: true
      subresources: {}
- apiVersion: apiextensions.k8s.io/v1
  kind: CustomResourceDefinition
  metadata:
    annotations:
      controller-gen.kubebuilder.io/version: v0.16.5
    creationTimestamp: null
    labels:
      component: velero
    name: datauploads.velero.io
  spec:
    group: velero.io
    names:
      kind: DataUpload
      listKind: DataUploadList
      plural: datauploads
      singular: dataupload
    scope: Namespaced
    versions:
    - additionalPrinterColumns:
      - description: DataUpload status such as New/InProgress
        jsonPath: .status.phase
        name: Status
        type: string
      - description: Time duration since this DataUpload was started
        jsonPath: .status.startTimestamp
        name: Started
        type: date
      - description: Completed bytes
        format: int64
        jsonPath: .status.progress.bytesDone
        name: Bytes Done
        type: integer
      - description: Total bytes
        format: int64
        jsonPath: .status.progress.totalBytes
        name: Total Bytes
        type: integer
      - description: Incremental bytes
        format: int64
        jsonPath: .status.incrementalBytes
        name: Incremental Bytes
        priority: 10
        type: integer
      - description: Name of the Backup Storage Location where this backup should
          be stored
        jsonPath: .spec.backupStorageLocation
        name: Storage Location
        type: string
      - description: Time duration since this DataUpload was created
        jsonPath: .metadata.creationTimestamp
        name: Age
        type: date
      - description: Name of the node where the DataUpload is processed
        jsonPath: .status.node
        name: Node
        type: string
      name: v2alpha1
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          description: DataUpload acts as the protocol between data mover plugins
            and data mover controller for the datamover backup operation
          properties:
            apiVersion:
              description: |-
                APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
                Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
                may reject unrecognized values.
                More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources
              type: string
            kind:
              description: |-
                Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
                Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
                Cannot be updated.
                In CamelCase.
                More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds
              type: string
            metadata:
              type: object
            spec:
              description: DataUploadSpec is the specification for a DataUpload.
              properties:
                backupStorageLocation:
                  description: |-
                    BackupStorageLocation is the name of the backup storage location
                    where the backup repository is stored.
                  type: string
                cancel:
                  description: |-
                    Cancel indicates request to cancel the ongoing DataUpload. It can be set
                    when the DataUpload is in InProgress phase
                  type: boolean
                csiSnapshot:
                  description: If SnapshotType is CSI, CSISnapshot provides the information
                    of the CSI snapshot.
                  nullable: true
                  properties:
                    driver:
                      description: Driver is the driver used by the VolumeSnapshotContent
                      type: string
                    snapshotClass:
                      description: SnapshotClass is the name of the snapshot class
                        that the volume snapshot is created with
                      type: string
                    storageClass:
                      description: StorageClass is the name of the storage class of
                        the PVC that the volume snapshot is created from
                      type: string
                    volumeSnapshot:
                      description: VolumeSnapshot is the name of the volume snapshot
                        to be backed up
                      type: string
                  required:
                  - storageClass
                  - volumeSnapshot
                  type: object
                dataMoverConfig:
                  additionalProperties:
                    type: string
                  description: DataMoverConfig is for data-mover-specific configuration

                  nullable: true
                  type: object
                datamover:
                  description: |-
                    DataMover specifies the data mover to be used by the backup.
                    If DataMover is "" or "velero", the built-in data mover will be used.
                  type: string
                operationTimeout:
                  description: |-
                    OperationTimeout specifies the time used to wait internal operations,
                    before returning error as timeout.
                  type: string
                snapshotType:
                  description: SnapshotType is the type of the snapshot to be backed
                    up.
                  type: string
                sourceNamespace:
                  description: |-
                    SourceNamespace is the original namespace where the volume is backed up from.
                    It is the same namespace for SourcePVC and CSI namespaced objects.
                  type: string
                sourcePVC:
                  description: SourcePVC is the name of the PVC which the snapshot
                    is taken for.
                  type: string
              required:
              - backupStorageLocation
              - operationTimeout
              - snapshotType
              - sourceNamespace
              - sourcePVC
              type: object
            status:
              description: DataUploadStatus is the current status of a DataUpload.
              properties:
                acceptedByNode:
                  description: AcceptedByNode is name of the node where the DataUpload
                    is prepared.
                  type: string
                acceptedTimestamp:
                  description: |-
                    AcceptedTimestamp records the time the DataUpload is to be prepared.
                    The server's time is used for AcceptedTimestamp
                  format: date-time
                  nullable: true
                  type: string
                completionTimestamp:
                  description: |-
                    CompletionTimestamp records the time a backup was completed.
                    Completion time is recorded even on failed backups.
                    Completion time is recorded before uploading the backup object.
                    The server's time is used for CompletionTimestamps
                  format: date-time
                  nullable: true
                  type: string

                  additionalProperties:
                    type: string
                  description: DataMoverResult stores data-mover-specific information

                  nullable: true
                  type: object
                incrementalBytes:

                    since the last backup
                  format: int64
                  type: integer
                message:
                  description: Message is a message about the DataUpload's status.
                  type: string
                node:
                  description: Node is name of the node where the DataUpload is processed.
                  type: string
                nodeOS:
                  description: NodeOS is OS of the node where the DataUpload is processed.
                  enum:
                  - auto
                  - linux
                  - windows
                  type: string
                path:
                  description: Path is the full path of the snapshot volume being
                    backed up.
                  type: string
                phase:
                  description: Phase is the current state of the DataUpload.
                  enum:
                  - New
                  - Accepted
                  - Prepared
                  - InProgress
                  - Canceling
                  - Canceled
                  - Completed
                  - Failed
                  type: string
                progress:
                  description: |-
                    Progress holds the total number of bytes of the volume and the current
                    number of backed up bytes. This can be used to display progress information
                    about the backup operation.
                  properties:
                    bytesDone:
                      format: int64
                      type: integer
                    totalBytes:
                      format: int64
                      type: integer
                  type: object
                snapshotID:
                  description: SnapshotID is the identifier for the snapshot in the
                    backup repository.
                  type: string
                startTimestamp:
                  description: |-
                    StartTimestamp records the time a backup was started.
                    Separate from CreationTimestamp, since that value changes
                    on restores.
                    The server's time is used for StartTimestamps
                  format: date-time
                  nullable: true
                  type: string
              type: object
          type: object
      served: true
      storage: true
      subresources: {}
kind: List
```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-prod/infrastructure/velero/kustomization.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - ../../../../bases/infrastructure/velero
  - volumesnapshotclass.yaml
  - crds-velero-v1.18.4.yaml
patches:
  - target:
      kind: CustomResourceDefinition
      group: apiextensions.k8s.io
    patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /metadata/annotations/kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io~1prune
        value: disabled
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /data/values.yaml
        value: |
            # values-prod.yaml — Velero on EKS (Production - nubo-postnegociacion-prod)
            # Cuenta: 242736647867 | Cluster: eks-nbo-postneg-prod-eks | Región: us-east-1

            namespace:
              labels:
                pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: privileged
                pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce-version: latest
                pod-security.kubernetes.io/audit: privileged
                pod-security.kubernetes.io/audit-version: latest
                pod-security.kubernetes.io/warn: privileged
                pod-security.kubernetes.io/warn-version: latest

            image:
              repository: velero/velero
              tag: v1.18.4
              pullPolicy: IfNotPresent

            upgradeCRDs: false

            # Sobreescribe la imagen de kubectl usada por los hooks del chart.
            # El default del chart (docker.io/bitnamilegacy/kubectl:1.36) ya no existe
            # en Docker Hub y hace que el hook pre-upgrade de Velero quede en ImagePullBackOff.
            kubectl:
              image:
                repository: registry.k8s.io/kubectl
                tag: v1.33.4

            labels:
              app.kubernetes.io/part-of: backup

            podAnnotations: {}

            podSecurityContext:
              fsGroup: 1337

            containerSecurityContext:
              allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
              readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
              capabilities:
                drop: ["ALL"]

            resources:
              requests:
                cpu: 200m
                memory: 256Mi
              limits:
                cpu: 1000m
                memory: 1Gi

            initContainers:
              - name: velero-plugin-for-aws
                image: velero/velero-plugin-for-aws:v1.14.4
                imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
                volumeMounts:
                  - mountPath: /target
                    name: plugins

            rbac:
              create: true
              clusterAdministrator: true
              clusterAdministratorName: cluster-admin

            serviceAccount:
              server:
                create: true
                name: velero-server
                annotations:
                  eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: "arn:aws:iam::242736647867:role/eks-velero-backup-prod"
                labels: {}
                automountServiceAccountToken: true

            credentials:
              useSecret: false
              name:
              existingSecret:
              secretContents: "[REDACTED]"
              extraEnvVars: {}
              extraSecretRef: "[REDACTED]"

            configuration:
              features: "EnableCSI"

              backupStorageLocation:
                - name: default
                  provider: aws
                  bucket: "velero-backups-nuam-242736647867"
                  prefix: "velero/prod"
                  default: true
                  accessMode: ReadWrite
                  config:
                    region: "us-east-1"
                    s3ForcePathStyle: "false"
                    kmsKeyId: "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:242736647867:alias/velero-nubo-postnegociacion-prod"

              volumeSnapshotLocation:
                - name: default
                  provider: aws
                  config:
                    region: "us-east-1"

              logLevel: "info"
              logFormat: "json"
              backupSyncPeriod: "1m"
              storeValidationFrequency: "1h"
              garbageCollectionFrequency: "1h"
              defaultBackupTTL: "168h"

              uploaderType: "kopia"
              fsBackupTimeout: "4h"
              defaultItemOperationTimeout: "4h"
              terminatingResourceTimeout: "10m"
              disableInformerCache: false

              extraArgs:
                - "--client-qps=20.0"
                - "--client-burst=30"

            backupsEnabled: true
            snapshotsEnabled: true

            # PostgreSQL tiene backups y archivado WAL propios mediante
            # CloudNativePG y Barman Cloud; Velero cubre los demas namespaces.

            deployNodeAgent: true

            nodeAgent:
              disableHostPath: false
              podVolumePath: /var/lib/kubelet/pods
              pluginVolumePath: /var/lib/kubelet/plugins
              useScratchEmptyDir: true
              podSecurityContext:
                runAsUser: 0
              containerSecurityContext: {}
              resources:
                requests:
                  cpu: 100m
                  memory: 256Mi
                limits:
                  cpu: 1000m
                  memory: 1Gi
              tolerations:
                - operator: "Exists"

            schedules:
              prod-daily-cluster:
                disabled: true
                labels:
                  env: prod
                  tier: daily
                annotations: {}
                schedule: "0 2 * * *"
                template:
                  ttl: "336h"
                  storageLocation: default
                  volumeSnapshotLocations:
                    - default
                  includedNamespaces:
                    - "*"
                  excludedNamespaces:
                    - kube-system
                    - kube-public
                    - kube-node-lease
                    - flux-system
                    - velero
                    - postgresql-nubo

              prod-hourly-critical:
                disabled: false
                labels:
                  env: prod
                  tier: hourly
                annotations: {}
                schedule: "0 * * * *"
                template:
                  ttl: "72h"
                  storageLocation: default
                  volumeSnapshotLocations:
                    - default
                  includedNamespaces:
                    - "77726203-3-lendings-network"
                    - "api-gateway"
                    - "cloudnative-pg"
                    - "kafka-interno-nubo"
                    - "nubo-back"
                    - "nubo-back-integracion"
                    - "nubo-front"
                    - "sftp-prod"
                  excludedResources:
                    - events
                    - events.events.k8s.io

            affinity:
              podAntiAffinity:
                preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
                  - weight: 100
                    podAffinityTerm:
                      topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
                      labelSelector:
                        matchLabels:
                          app.kubernetes.io/name: velero

            tolerations:
              - operator: "Exists"

            metrics:
              enabled: true
              scrapeInterval: 30s
              scrapeTimeout: 10s
              service:
                type: ClusterIP
                annotations: {}
                labels: {}
              podAnnotations:
                prometheus.io/scrape: "true"
                prometheus.io/port: "8085"
                prometheus.io/path: "/metrics"
              serviceMonitor:
                autodetect: true
                enabled: true
                annotations: {}
                additionalLabels:
                  release: "prometheus"

            prometheusRule:
              autodetect: true
              enabled: true
              additionalLabels:
                release: "prometheus"
              spec:
                - alert: VeleroBackupFailing
                  annotations:
                    message: "Velero backups failing for schedule {{ $labels.schedule }}"
                  expr: |-
                    velero_backup_last_status{schedule!=""} != 1
                  for: 15m
                  labels:
                    severity: warning

            extraObjects:
              - apiVersion: velero.io/v1
                kind: Schedule
                metadata:
                  name: nubo-prod-velero-diario
                  namespace: velero
                spec:
                  schedule: "0 4 * * *"
                  template:
                    ttl: "720h"
                    storageLocation: default
                    includedNamespaces: ["*"]
                    excludedNamespaces: [kube-system, kube-public, kube-node-lease, flux-system, velero, postgresql-nubo]
                    excludedResources: [events, events.events.k8s.io]
                    metadata:
                      labels:
                        ambiente: prod
                        herramienta: velero
                        tipo: diario
                        velero-version: v1.18.4
              - apiVersion: velero.io/v1
                kind: Schedule
                metadata:
                  name: nubo-prod-velero-semanal
                  namespace: velero
                spec:
                  schedule: "0 5 * * 0"
                  template:
                    ttl: "2016h"
                    storageLocation: default
                    snapshotMoveData: true
                    includedNamespaces: ["*"]
                    excludedNamespaces: [kube-system, kube-public, kube-node-lease, flux-system, velero, postgresql-nubo]
                    excludedResources: [events, events.events.k8s.io]
                    metadata:
                      labels:
                        ambiente: prod
                        herramienta: velero
                        tipo: semanal
                        velero-version: v1.18.4
              - apiVersion: velero.io/v1
                kind: Schedule
                metadata:
                  name: nubo-prod-velero-mensual
                  namespace: velero
                spec:
                  schedule: "0 6 1 * *"
                  template:
                    ttl: "8760h"
                    storageLocation: default
                    snapshotMoveData: true
                    includedNamespaces: ["*"]
                    excludedNamespaces: [kube-system, kube-public, kube-node-lease, flux-system, velero, postgresql-nubo]
                    excludedResources: [events, events.events.k8s.io]
                    metadata:
                      labels:
                        ambiente: prod
                        herramienta: velero
                        tipo: mensual
                        velero-version: v1.18.4
    target:
      kind: ConfigMap
      name: values-velero
```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-qa/apps/adm-garantias-back/kustomization.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - ../../../../bases/apps/adm-garantias-back
patches:
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/image
        value: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/adm-garantias-back:0.25.0-beta.1
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/nodeSelector
        value:
          node-lifecycle: bottlerocket-aplicacion

      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/tolerations
        value:
          - key: workload
            operator: Equal
            value: aplicacion
            effect: NoSchedule

    target:
      kind: Deployment

```

```yaml
cause-catalog:

    OK:

    # --- fracciones-contado-back (filas 69-78 de §6; alcanzables vía el forward verbatim de
    # BatchAssignmentItemOutDto.errorCode en cmd-back, ver Fase 3). TRADE_NOT_FOUND, SIDE_NOT_FOUND,
    # TYPE_NOT_FOUND, TAXES_NOT_FOUND, INVESTOR_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND y PARTICIPANT_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND
    # (filas 70/71/73/74/75/77) reusan el mismo ErrorCode.name() que cmd-back y ya están catalogados
    # arriba — solo se agregan acá las 4 entradas que cmd-back no tiene (fila 69, 72, 76, 78). Fila 79
    # (CLIENT_OPERATION_RULES_ERROR) también reusa la entrada de cmd-back de arriba. Filas 54-62
    # (reglas-back, HTTP directo) y 80 (calculos-back) quedan fuera deliberadamente: no son
    # alcanzables vía el pipeline real del orquestador (ver §6/§9.3) — catalogarlas sería código
    # muerto en este archivo.
    STATUS_NOT_FOUND:
      code: ARA-057
      message: "Ocurrió un error al procesar la solicitud. (057)"
      detailedMessage: "No se encontró el estado informado."
      type: BUSINESS
```

```yaml
      type: TECHNICAL
    BUNDLE_SEQUENCE_UPDATE_FAILED:
      code: ARA-104
      message: "Ocurrió un error al procesar la solicitud. (104)"
      detailedMessage: "No fue posible actualizar la secuencia de numeración de paquetes."
      type: TECHNICAL
    AUTOMATIC_PACKAGE_CREATION_FAILED:
      code: ARA-105
      message: "Ocurrió un error al procesar la solicitud. (105)"
      detailedMessage: "No fue posible crear el paquete de custodia de forma automática."
      type: TECHNICAL

    # --- claves compuestas de rechazo por regla de negocio de custodia (plan 8.17): causeCode-ruleCode-validationCode,
    # igual que las del orquestador. ruleCode y validationCode los devuelve el servicio de reglas y la API de acciones
    # los propaga en errorsSettlements[] y en los resultados de traslado. Las reglas son las de renta variable (RF no aplica).
    # El texto de cada validacion sale de BUSINESS_RULE_VALIDATION.MESSAGE_ERROR; aqui va el texto para el cliente.
    CUSTODY_ACTION_REJECTED-RULE_CUSTODIAN_TRANSFER_BY_FRACTION-A:
      code: ARA-108
      message: "La fecha de cumplimiento de la operación ya pasó y no permite la acción de custodia."
      type: BUSINESS
    CUSTODY_ACTION_REJECTED-RULE_CUSTODIAN_TRANSFER_BY_FRACTION-B:
      code: ARA-109
      message: "El estado de la operación no permite la acción de custodia."
      type: BUSINESS
    CUSTODY_ACTION_REJECTED-RULE_CUSTODIAN_PREMATCH_BY_FRACTION_CUSTODIAN-A:
      code: ARA-110
      message: "El estado del custodio de la fracción no permite el pre-match."
      type: BUSINESS
    CUSTODY_ACTION_REJECTED-RULE_CUSTODIAN_ACCEPT_BY_FRACTION_CUSTODIAN-A:
      code: ARA-111
      message: "El estado del custodio de la fracción no permite la admisión."
      type: BUSINESS
    CUSTODY_ACTION_REJECTED-RULE_CUSTODIAN_REJECT_BY_FRACTION_CUSTODIAN-A:
      code: ARA-112
      message: "El estado del custodio de la fracción no permite el rechazo."
      type: BUSINESS
    CUSTODY_ACTION_REJECTED-RULE_CUSTODIAN_TRANSFER_BY_FRACTION_CUSTODIAN-A:
      code: ARA-113
      message: "El estado del custodio de la fracción no permite el traslado."
      type: BUSINESS
    CUSTODY_ACTION_REJECTED-CUSTODY_ACTIONS_API-FRACTION_STATUS_NOT_VALID:
      code: ARA-114
      message: "La fracción no tiene un estado de custodio válido para la acción."
      type: BUSINESS
    TRANSFER_PARTIAL_FAILURE-RULE_CUSTODIAN_TRANSFER_BY_FRACTION-A:
      code: ARA-115
      message: "Existen fracciones rechazadas en el traslado: la fecha de cumplimiento ya pasó."
      type: BUSINESS
    TRANSFER_PARTIAL_FAILURE-RULE_CUSTODIAN_TRANSFER_BY_FRACTION-B:
      code: ARA-116
      message: "Existen fracciones rechazadas en el traslado: el estado de la fracción no lo permite."
      type: BUSINESS
    TRANSFER_PARTIAL_FAILURE-RULE_CUSTODIAN_TRANSFER_BY_FRACTION_CUSTODIAN-A:
      code: ARA-117
      message: "Existen fracciones rechazadas en el traslado: el estado del custodio de la fracción no lo permite."
      type: BUSINESS

    UNCLASSIFIED:
      code: ARA-000
      message: "Ocurrió un error no clasificado al procesar la solicitud."
      type: TECHNICAL

```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-qa/apps/api-client/kustomization.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
# Un volumen solo puede montar ConfigMaps de su propio namespace: el mismo catalogo se publica en cada
# namespace que lo consume, generado desde un unico archivo (cause-catalog.yml) para no duplicar el YAML.
generatorOptions:
  disableNameSuffixHash: true
configMapGenerator:
  - name: api-client-cause-catalog
    namespace: nubo-back-integracion
    files:
      - cause-catalog.yml
  - name: api-client-cause-catalog
    namespace: nubo-back
    files:
      - cause-catalog.yml
  - name: api-client-cause-catalog-tibco
    namespace: nubo-back-integracion
    files:
      - cause-catalog-tibco.yml

```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-qa/apps/asignacion-definitiva-auto-back/kustomization.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
# Reparto de lotes entre réplicas: service-peers.yaml + DISTRIBUTED_PEERS_HOST (ver patch al final).
resources:
  - ../../../../bases/apps/asignacion-definitiva-auto-back
  - service-peers.yaml
patches:
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/image
        value: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/asignacion-definitiva-auto-back:0.72.0-beta.1
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/nodeSelector
        value:
          node-lifecycle: bottlerocket-aplicacion

      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/tolerations
        value:
          - key: workload
            operator: Equal
            value: aplicacion
            effect: NoSchedule

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/replicas
        value: 2

    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Reparto de los escenarios 1 y 4 entre réplicas (slices por MOD(trade_id, #pods)). Sin esta
  # variable, o con DISTRIBUTED_ENABLED=false, todo se procesa en el pod que recibe el GET.
  # Grace period: un pod que baja termina el lote en curso (transacción + ack Kafka) antes de salir.
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/-
        value:
          name: DISTRIBUTED_PEERS_HOST
          value: asignacion-definitiva-auto-back-peers.nubo-back.svc.cluster.local
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/terminationGracePeriodSeconds
        value: 120
    target:
      kind: Deployment

```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-qa/apps/asignacion-definitiva-auto-back/service-peers.yaml

```yaml
# Service headless para que las réplicas se descubran entre sí: su DNS devuelve la IP de cada
# pod listo. El pod que recibe el GET /definitive reparte los escenarios 1 y 4 en un slice por
# réplica (POST /definitive/slice). Solo tráfico interno; el Service ClusterIP de la base no cambia.
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: asignacion-definitiva-auto-back-peers
  namespace: nubo-back
spec:
  clusterIP: None
  selector:
    app: asignacion-definitiva-auto-back
  ports:
    - name: http
      protocol: TCP
      port: 8080
      targetPort: 8080

```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-qa/apps/gestion-usuarios-back/config-gestion-usuarios-back.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: gestion-usuarios-back-config
  namespace: nubo-back
data:
  # Vigencias en segundos (no son secretos). PASSWORD_TTL_SECONDS rige el sobre de contrasena y el boleto de
  # contrasena temporal. El backend usa estos mismos valores si la variable no existe
  PRETOKEN_TTL_SECONDS: "[REDACTED]"
  PASSWORD_TTL_SECONDS: "[REDACTED]"

  # Autorizacion por perfil del backend (Plan-autorizacion-por-accion.md). Estos son los valores por defecto del backend;
  # se dejan aqui para cambiarlos por ambiente sin tocar codigo. Las reglas del alta de usuarios solo se aplican a lo que
  # entra por APISIX con forward-auth (se configura a mano en la Admin API): sin ese plugin no se valida nada.
  PERMISSIONS_ENABLED: "true"
  # Como el endpoint /authorization/check confirma quien llama: LOCAL lee el JWT sin verificar la firma (APISIX ya lo
  # valido con openid-connect); INTROSPECT consulta a Keycloak que el token siga vivo
  PERMISSIONS_GATEWAY_IDENTITY: "LOCAL"
  # Reglas de autorizacion por perfil (YAML o JSON). Este ConfigMap manda: las reglas de aqui se fusionan, por nombre, sobre
  # las que trae el backend (permissions-default.yml) y las reemplazan campo a campo. Cada regla lista sus endpoints
  # ("METODO /ruta" como los ve el gateway), quien la aplica (gateway: el endpoint /authorization/check que llama
  # APISIX; local: el interceptor del propio backend), su interruptor (enabled) y los codigos de accion por tipo de
  # usuario que llama (basta con uno). Los codigos se leen como texto: no hace falta entrecomillarlos.
  # Un endpoint que ninguna regla menciona no se valida. Para agregar otra regla se agrega un bloque mas; para apagar una,
  # enabled: false. Cambiar este valor requiere reiniciar el pod.
  PERMISSIONS_ACTIONS: |
    user-create-internal:
      enabled: true
      enforcement: gateway
      endpoints: ["POST /user-management-api/{version}/user/internal"]
      codes:
        INTERNAL: [048]
    user-create-external:
      enabled: true
      enforcement: gateway
      endpoints: ["POST /user-management-api/{version}/user/external"]
      codes:
        INTERNAL: [177]
        EXTERNAL: [172]

  # Alta de usuarios (backend): dominio(s) de correo de nuam, separados por coma. Los usuarios internos deben tenerlo y los
  # externos no. Cambiarlo requiere reiniciar el pod.
  DOMAIN_EMAIL_NUAM: "nuam.com"
  # Alta de usuarios (backend): ids de los participantes de nuam, separados por coma. No se asignan a usuarios externos.
  PARTICIPANT_NUAM_IDS: "1"

```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-qa/apps/gestion-usuarios-back/kustomization.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - ../../../../bases/apps/gestion-usuarios-back
  - config-gestion-usuarios-back.yaml
patches:
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/image
        value: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/gestion-usuarios-back:0.183.3-beta.19
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/nodeSelector
        value:
          node-lifecycle: bottlerocket-aplicacion

      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/tolerations
        value:
          - key: workload
            operator: Equal
            value: aplicacion
            effect: NoSchedule

    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Claves del Secret nubo-back-secret (se cargan en cada ambiente antes de desplegar: PRETOKEN_KEYS y PASSWORD_RSA_PRIVATE_KEYS);
  # las vigencias (TTL) salen del ConfigMap propio del microservicio
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/-
        value:
          name: PRETOKEN_KEYS
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: nubo-back-secret
              key: PRETOKEN_KEYS
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/-
        value:
          name: PRETOKEN_TTL_SECONDS
          valueFrom:
            configMapKeyRef:
              name: gestion-usuarios-back-config
              key: PRETOKEN_TTL_SECONDS
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/-
        value:
          name: PASSWORD_TTL_SECONDS
          valueFrom:
            configMapKeyRef:
              name: gestion-usuarios-back-config
              key: PASSWORD_TTL_SECONDS
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/-
        value:
          name: PERMISSIONS_ENABLED
          valueFrom:
            configMapKeyRef:
              name: gestion-usuarios-back-config
              key: PERMISSIONS_ENABLED
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/-
        value:
          name: PERMISSIONS_GATEWAY_IDENTITY
          valueFrom:
            configMapKeyRef:
              name: gestion-usuarios-back-config
              key: PERMISSIONS_GATEWAY_IDENTITY
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/-
        value:
          name: PERMISSIONS_ACTIONS
          valueFrom:
            configMapKeyRef:
              name: gestion-usuarios-back-config
              key: PERMISSIONS_ACTIONS
      - op: add
```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-qa/apps/integracion-liquidacion-deceval-borde-back/deploy-java-app.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: integration-settlement-deceval-edge-back-app
  namespace: nubo-back
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: integration-settlement-deceval-edge-back
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: integration-settlement-deceval-edge-back
    spec:
      nodeSelector:
        node-lifecycle: bottlerocket-aplicacion
      tolerations:
        - key: workload
          operator: Equal
          value: aplicacion
          effect: NoSchedule
      securityContext:
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        fsGroup: 10001
        automountServiceAccountToken: false
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: integration-settlement-deceval-edge-back-app-container
          image: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/integration-settlement-deceval-edge-back:0.9.1
          imagePullPolicy: Always
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 10001
            seccompProfile:
              type: RuntimeDefault
            #readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "200m"
              memory: "256Mi"
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
          env:
            - name: DB_USERNAME
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: nubo-back-secret
                  key: DB_USERNAME
            - name: DB_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-qa/apps/liberacion-garantias-back/kustomization.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - ../../../../bases/apps/liberacion-garantias-back
patches:
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/image
        value: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/liberacion-garantias-back:0.44.0-alpha.1
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/nodeSelector
        value:
          node-lifecycle: bottlerocket-aplicacion

      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/tolerations
        value:
          - key: workload
            operator: Equal
            value: aplicacion
            effect: NoSchedule

    target:
      kind: Deployment

```
