```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - ../../../../bases/apps/maestroinstrumentos-back
patches:
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/image
        value: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/maestroinstrumentos-back:0.41.0-beta.5
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/nodeSelector
        value:
          node-lifecycle: bottlerocket-aplicacion

      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/tolerations
        value:
          - key: workload
            operator: Equal
            value: aplicacion
            effect: NoSchedule
      - op: remove
        path: /spec/template/spec/securityContext/automountServiceAccountToken
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/automountServiceAccountToken
        value: false

      # Base 512Mi Value 1GI
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/memory
        value: 1Gi

    target:
      kind: Deployment

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-qa/apps/parent-container-front/snippets/config-parent-container.yml

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: config-parent-container
  namespace: nubo-front
data:
  default.conf: |
    server {
        listen       5000;
        listen  [::]:5000;
        server_name  localhost;

        #access_log  /var/log/nginx/host.access.log  main;
        gzip on;
        gzip_vary on;
        gzip_comp_level 6;
        gzip_min_length 1024;
        gzip_types
            text/plain
            text/css
            text/xml
            text/javascript
            application/json
            application/javascript
            application/xml
            image/svg+xml;
        location / {
            if ($request_method = 'OPTIONS') {
                 add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' '*';
                 add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods' 'GET, POST, OPTIONS, DELETE, PUT, PATCH';
                 add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers' 'Authorization, Content-Type';
                 add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Credentials' 'true';
                  return 204;
            }
            add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' '*';
            add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods' 'GET, POST, OPTIONS, DELETE, PUT, PATCH';
            add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers' 'Authorization, Content-Type';
            add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Credentials' 'true';

            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            index  index.html index.htm;
            try_files $uri /index.html;
            add_header Cache-Control "no-cache, must-revalidate" always;
        }

        location = /assets/remoteEntry.js {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            add_header Cache-Control "no-cache, must-revalidate" always;
        }
        
        location /assets/ {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=31536000, immutable";
            try_files $uri =404;
        }
        
        error_page  404              /404.html;

        # redirect server error pages to the static page /50x.html
        #
        error_page   500 502 503 504  /50x.html;
        location = /50x.html {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
        }

        # proxy the PHP scripts to Apache listening on 127.0.0.1:80
        #
        #location ~ \.php$ {
        #    proxy_pass   http://127.0.0.1;
        #}

        # pass the PHP scripts to FastCGI server listening on 127.0.0.1:9000
        #
        #location ~ \.php$ {
        #    root           html;
        #    fastcgi_pass   127.0.0.1:9000;
        #    fastcgi_index  index.php;
        #    fastcgi_param  SCRIPT_FILENAME  /scripts$fastcgi_script_name;
        #    include        fastcgi_params;
        #}

        # deny access to .htaccess files, if Apache's document root
        # concurs with nginx's one
        #
        #location ~ /\.ht {
        #    deny  all;
        #}
    }

```

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

  - patch: |-
      - op: replace

        value: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/persistencia-data-nasdaq-back:0.74.0-beta.1

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/cpu
        value: 999m

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/memory
        value: 999Mi 

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/replicas
        value: 1

      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/nodeSelector
        value:
          node-lifecycle: bottlerocket-aplicacion

      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/tolerations
        value:
          - key: workload
            operator: Equal
            value: aplicacion
            effect: NoSchedule

      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/-
        value:
          name: KAFKA_NUBO_DATA_PREFIX_FOLIO
          value: "true"
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/-
        value:

          value: "CO"

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-qa/infrastructure/apisix/apisix-route-websocket.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: apisix.apache.org/v2
kind: ApisixRoute
metadata:
  name: websocket-server-route
  namespace: nubo-back
spec:
  http:
    - name: websocket-server-rule
      match:
        paths:
          - /web-socket-server-api/*
      backends:
        - serviceName: web-socket-server-client-back-service
          servicePort: 80
      plugins:
        # CORS - Correcto
        cors:
          allow_credential: true
          allow_headers: "Authorization,Content-Type,X-Requested-With,Accept,Origin,Access-Control-Request-Method,Access-Control-Request-Headers,X-Client-User,X-Client-IP,X-Client-DateTime,Grant-Type"
          allow_methods: "GET,HEAD,PUT,PATCH,POST,DELETE,OPTIONS"
          allow_origins: "https://nbo-postnegociacion-qa.nubo-nuam.com"
          expose_headers: "Content-Length,Content-Type,Date,Server,Connection,Keep-Alive,Authorization"
          max_age: 600
        
        # proxy-rewrite - Correcto
        proxy-rewrite:
          headers:
            add:
              X-Forwarded-Host: "$http_host"
              X-Forwarded-Proto: "$http_x_forwarded_proto"
              X-Forwarded-For: "$remote_addr"
        
        # real-ip - Correcto
        real-ip:
          trusted_addresses:
            - "0.0.0.0/0"
          recursive: false
          source: "X-Forwarded-For"
        
        # authz-keycloak - CORREGIDO CON SKIP
        authz-keycloak:
          access_token_expires_leeway: "[REDACTED]"
          discovery: "https://sso-qa-postneg.nuamx.com/realms/nubo/.well-known/uma2-configuration"
          jwks_uri: "https://sso-qa-postneg.nuamx.com/realms/nubo/protocol/openid-connect/certs"
          permissions: {}
          timeout: 5000
          client_id: "apisix-demo"
          keepalive_timeout: 60000
          token_endpoint: "[REDACTED]"
          issuer: "https://sso-qa-postneg.nuamx.com/realms/nubo"
          client_secret: "[REDACTED]"
          grant_type: "urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:uma-ticket"
          introspection_endpoint: "https://sso-qa-postneg.nuamx.com/realms/nubo/protocol/openid-connect/token/introspect"
          resource_registration_endpoint: "https://sso-qa-postneg.nuamx.com/realms/nubo/authz/protection/resource_set"
          permission_endpoint: "https://sso-qa-postneg.nuamx.com/realms/nubo/authz/protection/permission"
          access_token_expires_in: "[REDACTED]"
          http_method_as_scope: false
          keepalive_pool: 5
          lazy_load_paths: true
          keepalive: true
          cache_ttl_seconds: 86400
          ssl_verify: false
          refresh_token_expires_in: "[REDACTED]"
          refresh_token_expires_leeway: "[REDACTED]"
          policy_enforcement_mode: "ENFORCING"
          # LO NUEVO - Skip para el endpoint /info
          skip:
            - vars:
                - ["uri", "~~", "/web-socket-server-api/v1/websocket/info"]
      
      enable_websocket: true
      priority: 10
```

            global:
              # e.g.

              #   - other-registry-secrets
              # -- Global Docker registry secret names as an array
              imagePullSecrets: "[REDACTED]"

            image:
              # -- Apache APISIX image repository
              repository: apache/apisix
              # -- Apache APISIX image pull policy

              tag: 3.14.1-ubuntu

            # -- set false to use `Deployment`, set true to use `DaemonSet`
            useDaemonSet: false
            # -- if useDaemonSet is true or autoscaling.enabled is true, replicaCount not become effective
            replicaCount: 1

            # -- Set [priorityClassName](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/pod-priority-preemption/#pod-priority) for Apache APISIX pods
            priorityClassName: ""
            # -- Annotations to add to each pod
            podAnnotations: {}
            # -- Set the securityContext for Apache APISIX pods
            podSecurityContext: {}
              # fsGroup: 2000
            # -- Set the securityContext for Apache APISIX container
            securityContext: {}
              # capabilities:
              #   drop:
              #   - ALL
              # readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
              # runAsNonRoot: true
              # runAsUser: 1000

            # -- See https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/run-application/configure-pdb/ for more details
            podDisruptionBudget:
              # -- Enable or disable podDisruptionBudget
              enabled: false
              # -- Set the `minAvailable` of podDisruptionBudget. You can specify only one of `maxUnavailable` and `minAvailable` in a single PodDisruptionBudget.
              # See [Specifying a Disruption Budget for your Application](https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/run-application/configure-pdb/#specifying-a-poddisruptionbudget)
              # for more details
              minAvailable: 90%
              # -- Set the maxUnavailable of podDisruptionBudget
              maxUnavailable: 1

            # -- Set pod resource requests & limits
            resources: {}
              # -- Use the host's network namespace

              # We usually recommend not to specify default resources and to leave this as a conscious
              # choice for the user. This also increases chances charts run on environments with little
              # resources, such as Minikube. If you do want to specify resources, uncomment the following
              # lines, adjust them as necessary, and remove the curly braces after 'resources:'.
              # limits:
              #   cpu: 100m
              #   memory: 128Mi
              # requests:
              #   cpu: 100m
              #   memory: 128Mi
            hostNetwork: false

            # -- Node labels for Apache APISIX pod assignment
            nodeSelector:
              node-lifecycle: bottlerocket-infra
            # -- List of node taints to tolerate
            tolerations:
              - key: workload
                operator: Equal
                value: infra
                effect: NoSchedule
            # -- Set affinity for Apache APISIX deploy
            affinity: {}
            # -- Topology Spread Constraints for pod assignment spread across your cluster among failure-domains
            # ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-topology-spread-constraints/#spread-constraints-for-pods
            topologySpreadConstraints: []

            # -- timezone is the timezone where apisix uses.
            # For example: "UTC" or "Asia/Shanghai"
            # This value will be set on apisix container's environment variable TZ.
            # You may need to set the timezone to be consistent with your local time zone,
            # otherwise the apisix's logs may used to retrieve event maybe in wrong timezone.
            timezone: ""

            # -- extraEnvVars An array to add extra env vars
            # e.g:

            #     value: "bar"
            #   - name: FOO2
            #     valueFrom:
            #       secretKeyRef:
            #         name: SECRET_NAME

            extraEnvVars: []

            updateStrategy: {}
              # type: RollingUpdate

            # -- Additional Kubernetes resources to deploy with the release.
            extraDeploy: []

            # -- Additional `volume`, See [Kubernetes Volumes](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/storage/volumes/) for the detail.
            extraVolumes: []
            # - name: extras
            #   emptyDir: {}

            # -- Additional `volume`, See [Kubernetes Volumes](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/storage/volumes/) for the detail.
            extraVolumeMounts: []
            # - name: extras
            #   mountPath: /usr/share/extras
            #   readOnly: true

            # -- Additional `initContainers`, See [Kubernetes initContainers](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/init-containers/) for the detail.
            extraInitContainers: []
            # - name: init-myservice
            #   image: busybox:1.28
            #   command: ['sh', '-c', "until nslookup myservice.$(cat /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/namespace).svc.cluster.local; do echo waiting for myservice; sleep 2; done"]

            # -- Additional `containers`, See [Kubernetes containers](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/) for the detail.
            extraContainers: []

            initContainer:
              # -- Init container image
              image: busybox
              # -- Init container tag
              tag: 1.28

            autoscaling:
              enabled: false
              # -- HPA version, the value is "v2" or "v2beta1", default "v2"
              version: v2
              minReplicas: 1
              maxReplicas: 100
              targetCPUUtilizationPercentage: 80
              targetMemoryUtilizationPercentage: 80

            nameOverride: ""
            fullnameOverride: ""

            serviceAccount:
              create: false
              annotations: {}
              name: ""

            rbac:
              create: false

            service:
              # -- Apache APISIX service type for user access itself
              type: NodePort
              # -- Setting how the Service route external traffic
              # If you want to keep the client source IP, you can set this to Local.

              # ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/access-application-cluster/create-external-load-balancer/#preserving-the-client-source-ip
              externalTrafficPolicy: Cluster
              # type: LoadBalancer
              # annotations:
              #   service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-type: nlb
              externalIPs: []
              # -- Apache APISIX service settings for http
              http:
                enabled: true
                servicePort: 80
                containerPort: 9080
                # -- Support multiple http ports, See [Configuration](https://github.com/apache/apisix/blob/0bc65ea9acd726f79f80ae0abd8f50b7eb172e3d/conf/config-default.yaml#L24)
                additionalContainerPorts: []
                  # - port: 9081
                  #   enable_http2: true          # If not set, the default value is `false`.
                  # - ip: 127.0.0.2               # Specific IP, If not set, the default value is `0.0.0.0`.
                  #   port: 9082
                  #   enable_http2: true
              # -- Apache APISIX service settings for tls
              tls:
                servicePort: 443
                # nodePort: 4443

              # -- Apache APISIX service settings for stream. L4 proxy (TCP/UDP)
              stream:
                enabled: false
                tcp: []
                udp: []
              #  - secretName: apisix-tls
              #    hosts:
              #      - chart-example.local
              # -- Override default labels assigned to Apache APISIX gateway resources
              labelsOverride: {}
              # labelsOverride:
              #   app.kubernetes.io/name: "{{ .Release.Name }}"
              #   app.kubernetes.io/instance: '{{ include "apisix.name" . }}'

            # -- Using ingress access Apache APISIX service
            ingress:
              enabled: false
              # -- (number) Service port to send traffic. Defaults to `service.http.servicePort`.
              servicePort:
              # -- Ingress annotations
              annotations: {}
                # kubernetes.io/ingress.class: nginx
                # kubernetes.io/tls-acme: "true"
              hosts:
                - host: apisix.local
                  paths: []
              tls: []

            control:
              # -- Enable Control API
              enabled: true
              service:
                # -- Control annotations
                annotations: {}
                # -- Control service type
                type: ClusterIP
                # loadBalancerIP: a.b.c.d
                # loadBalancerSourceRanges:
                #   - "143.231.0.0/16"
                # -- IPs for which nodes in the cluster will also accept traffic for the servic
                externalIPs: []

                # -- NodePort (only if control.service.type is NodePort)
                # nodePort: 32000

                # -- which ip to listen on for Apache APISIX Control API
                ip: "127.0.0.1"
                # -- which port to use for Apache APISIX Control API
                port: 9090
                # -- Service port to use for Apache APISIX Control API
                servicePort: 9090
              # -- Using ingress access Apache APISIX Control service
              ingress:
                enabled: false
                # -- Ingress annotations
                annotations:
                  {}
                  # kubernetes.io/ingress.class: nginx
                  # kubernetes.io/tls-acme: "true"
                # -- Ingress Class Name
                # className: "nginx"
                hosts:
                  - host: apisix-control.local
                    paths:
                      - "/*"
                tls: []
              #  - secretName: apisix-tls
              #    hosts:
              #      - chart-example.local

            # -- Observability configuration.
            metrics:
              serviceMonitor:
                # -- Enable or disable Apache APISIX serviceMonitor
                enabled: false
                # -- namespace where the serviceMonitor is deployed, by default, it is the same as the namespace of the apisix
                namespace: ""
                # -- name of the serviceMonitor, by default, it is the same as the apisix fullname
                name: ""
                # -- interval at which metrics should be scraped
                interval: 15s
                # -- @param serviceMonitor.labels ServiceMonitor extra labels
                labels: {}
                # -- @param serviceMonitor.annotations ServiceMonitor annotations
                annotations: {}

            apisix:
              # -- Enable nginx IPv6 resolver
              enableIPv6: true
              enableHTTP2: true

              # -- Whether the APISIX version number should be shown in Server header
              enableServerTokens: true

              # -- Use Pod metadata.uid as the APISIX id.
              setIDFromPodUID: false

              # -- Whether to add a custom lua module
              luaModuleHook:
                enabled: false
                # -- extend lua_package_path to load third party code
                luaPath: ""
                # -- the hook module which will be used to inject third party code into APISIX
                # use the lua require style like: "module.say_hello"
                hookPoint: ""
                # -- configmap that stores the codes
                configMapRef:
                  # -- Name of the ConfigMap where the lua module codes store
                  name: ""
                  # mounts decides how to mount the codes to the container.
                  mounts:
                    # -- Name of the ConfigMap key, for setting the mapping relationship between ConfigMap key and the lua module code path.
                    - key: ""
                    # -- Filepath of the plugin code, for setting the mapping relationship between ConfigMap key and the lua module code path.
                      path: ""

              ssl:
                enabled: false
                containerPort: 9443
                # -- Support multiple https ports, See [Configuration](https://github.com/apache/apisix/blob/0bc65ea9acd726f79f80ae0abd8f50b7eb172e3d/conf/config-default.yaml#L99)
                additionalContainerPorts: []
                  # - ip: 127.0.0.3           # Specific IP, If not set, the default value is `0.0.0.0`.
                  #   port: 9445
                  #   enable_http3: true
                # -- Specifies the name of Secret contains trusted CA certificates in the PEM format used to verify the certificate when APISIX needs to do SSL/TLS handshaking with external services (e.g. etcd)
                existingCASecret: "[REDACTED]"
                # -- Filename be used in the apisix.ssl.existingCASecret
                certCAFilename: ""
                enableHTTP3: false
                # -- TLS protocols allowed to use.
                sslProtocols: "TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3"
                # -- TLS ciphers allowed to use.
                sslCiphers: "ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-ECDSA-CHACHA20-POLY1305:ECDHE-RSA-CHACHA20-POLY1305:DHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:DHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:DHE-RSA-CHACHA20-POLY1305:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA256:ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA:ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA384:ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA:ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA:DHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256:DHE-RSA-AES256-SHA256:AES128-GCM-SHA256:AES256-GCM-SHA384:AES128-SHA256:AES256-SHA256:AES128-SHA:AES256-SHA:DES-CBC3-SHA"
                # -- Define SNI to fallback if none is presented by client
                fallbackSNI: ""

              router:
                # -- Defines how apisix handles routing:
                # - radixtree_uri: match route by uri(base on radixtree)
                # - radixtree_host_uri: match route by host + uri(base on radixtree)
                # - radixtree_uri_with_parameter: match route by uri with parameters
                http: radixtree_host_uri

              fullCustomConfig:
                # -- Enable full customized config.yaml
                enabled: false
                # -- If apisix.fullCustomConfig.enabled is true, full customized config.yaml.
                # Please note that other settings about APISIX config will be ignored
                config: {}

              deployment:
                # -- Apache APISIX deployment mode
                # Optional: traditional, decoupled, standalone
                #
                # ref: https://apisix.apache.org/docs/apisix/deployment-modes/
                mode: traditional

                # -- Deployment role
                # Optional: traditional, data_plane, control_plane
                #
                # ref: https://apisix.apache.org/docs/apisix/deployment-modes/
                role: "traditional"
                role_traditional:
                  # enum: etcd, yaml
                  config_provider: "etcd"

              admin:
                # -- Enable Admin API
                enabled: true
                # -- Enable Embedded Admin UI
                enable_admin_ui: true
                # -- admin service type
                type: ClusterIP
                # loadBalancerIP: a.b.c.d
                # loadBalancerSourceRanges:
                #   - "143.231.0.0/16"
                # -- IPs for which nodes in the cluster will also accept traffic for the servic
                externalIPs: []
                # -- which ip to listen on for Apache APISIX admin API. Set to `"[::]"` when on IPv6 single stack
                ip: 0.0.0.0
                # -- which port to use for Apache APISIX admin API
                port: 9180
                # -- Service port to use for Apache APISIX admin API
                servicePort: 9180
                # -- Admin API support CORS response headers
                cors: true
                # -- Admin API credentials
                credentials:
                  # -- Apache APISIX admin API admin role credentials
                  admin: edd1c9f034335f136f87ad84b625c8f1
                  # -- Apache APISIX admin API viewer role credentials
                  viewer: 4054f7cf07e344346cd3f287985e76a2

                  # -- The APISIX Helm chart supports storing user credentials in a secret.
                  # The secret needs to contain two keys, admin and viewer, with their respective values set.
                  secretName: "[REDACTED]"
                  # -- Name of the admin role key in the secret, overrides the default key name "admin"
                  secretAdminKey: "[REDACTED]"
                  # -- Name of the viewer role key in the secret, overrides the default key name "viewer"
                  secretViewerKey: "[REDACTED]"

                allow:
                  # -- The client IP CIDR allowed to access Apache APISIX Admin API service.
                  ipList:
                    - 127.0.0.1/24
                # -- Using ingress access Apache APISIX admin service
                ingress:
                  enabled: false
                  # -- Ingress annotations
                  annotations:
                    {}
                    # kubernetes.io/ingress.class: nginx
                    # kubernetes.io/tls-acme: "true"
                  hosts:
                    - host: apisix-admin.local
                      paths:
                        - "/apisix"
                  tls: []
                #  - secretName: apisix-tls
                #    hosts:
                #      - chart-example.local

              nginx:
                workerRlimitNofile: "20480"
                workerConnections: "10620"
                workerProcesses: auto
                enableCPUAffinity: true
                # -- Timeout during which a keep-alive client connection will stay open on the server side.
                keepaliveTimeout: 60s
                envs: []
                # access log and error log configuration
                logs:
                  # -- Enable access log or not, default true
                  enableAccessLog: true
                  # -- Access log path
                  accessLog: "/dev/stdout"
                  # -- Access log format
                  accessLogFormat: '$remote_addr - $remote_user [$time_local] $http_host \"$request\" $status $body_bytes_sent $request_time \"$http_referer\" \"$http_user_agent\" $upstream_addr $upstream_status $upstream_response_time \"$upstream_scheme://$upstream_host$upstream_uri\"'
                  # -- Allows setting json or default characters escaping in variables
                  accessLogFormatEscape: default
                  # -- Error log path
                  errorLog: "/dev/stderr"
                  # -- Error log level
                  errorLogLevel: "warn"
                # -- Custom configuration snippet.
                configurationSnippet:
                  main: |

                  httpStart: |

                  httpEnd: |

                  httpSrv: |

                  httpAdmin: |

                  stream: |

                # -- Add custom [lua_shared_dict](https://github.com/openresty/lua-nginx-module?tab=readme-ov-file#lua_shared_dict) settings,
                # click [here](https://github.com/apache/apisix-helm-chart/blob/master/charts/apisix/values.yaml#L27-L30) to learn the format of a shared dict
                customLuaSharedDicts: []
                  # - name: foo
                  #   size: 10k
                  # - name: bar
                  #   size: 1m

                # -- Override default [lua_shared_dict](https://github.com/apache/apisix/blob/master/conf/config.yaml.example#L250-L276) settings,
                # click [here](https://github.com/apache/apisix-helm-chart/blob/master/charts/apisix/values.yaml#L27-L30) to learn the format of a shared dict
                luaSharedDicts: []
                  # - name: prometheus-metrics
                  #   size: 20m

              discovery:
                # -- Enable or disable Apache APISIX integration service discovery
                enabled: false
                # -- Service discovery registry. Refer to [configuration under discovery](https://github.com/apache/apisix/blob/master/conf/config.yaml.example#L307) for example.
                # Also see [example of using external service discovery](https://apisix.apache.org/docs/ingress-controller/1.8.0/tutorials/external-service-discovery/).
                registry: {}
                  # Integration service discovery registry. E.g eureka\dns\nacos\consul_kv
                  # reference:
                  # https://apisix.apache.org/docs/apisix/discovery/#configuration-for-eureka
                  # https://apisix.apache.org/docs/apisix/discovery/dns/#service-discovery-via-dns
                  # https://apisix.apache.org/docs/apisix/discovery/consul_kv/#configuration-for-consul-kv
                  # https://apisix.apache.org/docs/apisix/discovery/nacos/#configuration-for-nacos
                  # https://apisix.apache.org/docs/apisix/discovery/kubernetes/#configuration
                  #
                  # an eureka example:
                  # ```
                  # eureka:
                  #   host:
                  #     - "http://${username}:[REDACTED]@${eureka_host1}:${eureka_port1}"
                  #     - "http://${username}:[REDACTED]@${eureka_host2}:${eureka_port2}"
                  #   prefix: "/eureka/"
                  #   fetch_interval: 30
                  #   weight: 100
                  #   timeout:
                  #     connect: 2000
                  #     send: 2000
                  #     read: 5000
                  # ```
                  #
                  # the minimal Kubernetes example:
                  # ```
                  # kubernetes: {}
                  # ```
                  #
                  # The prerequisites for the above minimal Kubernetes example:
                  #  1. [Optional] Set `.serviceAccount.create` to `true` to create a dedicated ServiceAccount.
                  #     It is recommended to do so, otherwise the default ServiceAccount "default" will be used.
                  #  2. [Required] Set `.rbac.create` to `true` to create and bind the necessary RBAC resources.
                  #     This grants the ServiceAccount in use to List-Watch Kubernetes Endpoints resources.
                  #  3. [Required] Include the following environment variables in `.nginx.envs` to pass them into
                  #     nginx worker processes (https://nginx.org/en/docs/ngx_core_module.html#env):
                  #      - KUBERNETES_SERVICE_HOST
                  #      - KUBERNETES_SERVICE_PORT
                  #     This is for allowing the default `host` and `port` of `.discovery.registry.kubernetes.service`.

              dns:
                resolvers:
                  - 127.0.0.1
                  - 172.20.0.10
                  - 114.114.114.114
                  - 223.5.5.5
                  - 1.1.1.1
                  - 8.8.8.8
                validity: 30
                timeout: 5

              vault:
                # -- Enable or disable the vault integration
                enabled: false
                # -- The host address where the vault server is running.
                host: ""
                # -- HTTP timeout for each request.
                timeout: 10
                # -- The generated token from vault instance that can grant access to read data from the vault.
                token: "[REDACTED]"
                # -- Prefix allows you to better enforcement of policies.
                prefix: ""

              prometheus:
                # ref: https://apisix.apache.org/docs/apisix/plugins/prometheus/
                enabled: false
                # -- path of the metrics endpoint
                path: /apisix/prometheus/metrics
                # -- prefix of the metrics
                metricPrefix: apisix_
                # -- container port where the metrics are exposed
                containerPort: 9091

              # -- Customize the list of APISIX plugins to enable. By default, APISIX's [default plugins](https://github.com/apache/apisix/blob/master/apisix/cli/config.lua#L196) are automatically used.
              plugins:           # plugin list
                - real-ip
                - proxy-rewrite
                - server-info
                - authz-keycloak
                - cors
                - limit-conn
                - limit-count
                - limit-req
                - csrf
                - openid-connect
        
              # -- Customize the list of APISIX stream_plugins to enable. By default, APISIX's [default stream_plugins](https://github.com/apache/apisix/blob/master/apisix/cli/config.lua#L294) are automatically used.
              stream_plugins: []

              # -- Set APISIX plugin attributes. By default, APISIX's [plugin_attr](https://github.com/apache/apisix/blob/master/apisix/cli/config.lua#L295) are automatically used.
              # See [configuration example](https://github.com/apache/apisix/blob/master/conf/config.yaml.example#L591).
              pluginAttrs: {}

              extPlugin:
                # -- Enable External Plugins. See [external plugin](https://apisix.apache.org/docs/apisix/next/external-plugin/)
                enabled: false
                # -- the command and its arguements to run as a subprocess
                cmd: ["/path/to/apisix-plugin-runner/runner", "run"]

              wasm:
                # -- Enable Wasm Plugins. See [wasm plugin](https://apisix.apache.org/docs/apisix/next/wasm/)
                enabled: false
                plugins: []

              # -- customPlugins allows you to mount your own HTTP plugins.
              customPlugins:
                # -- Whether to configure some custom plugins
                enabled: false
                # -- the lua_path that tells APISIX where it can find plugins,
                # note the last ';' is required.
                luaPath: "/opts/custom_plugins/?.lua"
                plugins:
                  # -- plugin name.
                  - name: "plugin-name"
                    # -- plugin attrs
                    attrs: {}
                    # -- plugin codes can be saved inside configmap object.
                    configMap:
                      # -- name of configmap.
                      name: "configmap-name"
                      # -- since keys in configmap is flat, mountPath allows to define the mount
                      # path, so that plugin codes can be mounted hierarchically.
                      mounts:
                        - key: "the-file-name"
                          path: "mount-path"

              status:
                ip: "0.0.0.0"
                port: 7085

              # -- When configured, APISIX will trust the `X-Forwarded-*` Headers passed in requests from the IP/CIDR in the list.
              trustedAddresses:
                - 127.0.0.1

            # -- external etcd configuration. If etcd.enabled is false, these configuration will be used.
            externalEtcd:
              # -- if etcd.enabled is false, use external etcd, support multiple address, if your etcd cluster enables TLS, please use https scheme, e.g. https://127.0.0.1:2379.
              host:
                # host or ip e.g. http://172.20.128.89:2379
                - http://etcd.host:2379
              # -- if etcd.enabled is false, user for external etcd. Set empty to disable authentication
              user: root
              # -- if etcd.enabled is true, use etcd.auth.rbac.rootPassword instead.
              # -- if etcd.enabled is false and externalEtcd.existingSecret is not empty, the password should store in the corresponding secret
              # -- if etcd.enabled is false and externalEtcd.existingSecret is empty, externalEtcd.password is the passsword for external etcd.
              password: "[REDACTED]"
              # -- if externalEtcd.existingSecret is the name of secret containing the external etcd password
              existingSecret: "[REDACTED]"
              # -- externalEtcd.secretPasswordKey Key inside the secret containing the external etcd password
              secretPasswordKey: "[REDACTED]"

            # -- etcd configuration
            # use the FQDN address or the IP of the etcd
            etcd:
              # -- install built-in etcd by default, set false if do not want to install built-in etcd together,
              # this etcd is based on bitnamilegacy/etcd helm chart and latest bitnami docker image, only for development and testing purposes,
              # if you want to use etcd in production, we recommend you to install etcd by yourself and use `externalEtcd` to connect it.
              enabled: true
              # -- docker image for built-in etcd
              image:
                registry: docker.io
                repository: bitnamilegacy/etcd
                # -- `bitnamilegacy/etcd` only provide `latest` tag now, ref: https://github.com/bitnami/containers/issues/83267,
                # you can switch `etcd.image.repository` to `bitnamilegacy/etcd` to use old versioned tags.
                tag: latest
              persistence:
                enabled: true
                size: 10Gi 
                storageClass: ebs-sc-gp3  

              # -- apisix configurations prefix
              prefix: "/apisix"
              # -- Set the timeout value in seconds for subsequent socket operations from apisix to etcd cluster
              timeout: 30

              # -- if etcd.enabled is true, set more values of bitnamilegacy/etcd helm chart
              auth:
                rbac:
                  # -- No authentication by default. Switch to enable RBAC authentication
                  create: false
                  # -- root password for etcd. Requires etcd.auth.rbac.create to be true.
                  rootPassword: "[REDACTED]"
                tls:
                  # -- enable etcd client certificate
                  enabled: false
                  # -- name of the secret contains etcd client cert
                  existingSecret: "[REDACTED]"
                  # -- etcd client cert filename using in etcd.auth.tls.existingSecret
                  certFilename: ""
                  # -- etcd client cert key filename using in etcd.auth.tls.existingSecret
                  certKeyFilename: ""
                  # -- whether to verify the etcd endpoint certificate when setup a TLS connection to etcd
                  verify: true
                  # -- specify the TLS Server Name Indication extension, the ETCD endpoint hostname will be used when this setting is unset.
                  sni: ""

              # -- ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/security-context/#set-the-security-context-for-a-container
              # -- added for backward compatibility with old kubernetes versions, as seccompProfile is not supported in kubernetes < 1.19
              containerSecurityContext:
                enabled: false

              service:
                port: 2379

              replicaCount: 3
              nodeSelector:
                node-lifecycle: bottlerocket-infra
              tolerations:
                - key: workload
                  operator: Equal
                  value: infra
                  effect: NoSchedule
              autoCompactionRetention: "1h"
              autoCompactionMode: "periodic"

            # -- Ingress controller configuration
            ingress-controller:
              enabled: false


    target:
      kind: ConfigMap
      name: values-apisix

````

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-qa/infrastructure/cert-manager-issuers/kustomization.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
# 💡 NOTA: no incluimos bases/.../certificates.yaml (trae mezclados los 4 Certificate
# de "-qa" y "-preprod"). Ninguno de los 4 sigue gestionado por cert-manager en este
# cluster (eks-nbo-postneg-eks-qa-eks):
#   - Los de "-qa" (tls-nbo-postnegociacion-qa, tls-apisix-nbo-postnegociacion-qa):
#     ACME/letsencrypt no puede validarlos (nbo-nuam.com no tiene registro DNS
#     público) — se gestionan manualmente, ver plan-cert-manager-cainjector-oom-qa.md
#     sección 6.8 para los comandos.
#   - Los de "-preprod" (tls-nbo-postnegociacion-preprod, tls-apisix-nbo-postnegociacion-preprod):
#     confirmado que ningún listener del Gateway de este cluster los referencia y
#     sus Secret nunca llegaron a existir (huérfanos) — ver sección 6.9. Se dejan
#     de intentar emitir; si en el futuro se necesitan, agregar su definición aquí.
# Solo se mantiene el ClusterIssuer (sin patch, valor original de bases: http01/nginx)
# por si algo más lo llega a necesitar.
resources:
  - ../../../../bases/infrastructure/cert-manager/issuers-and-certs/cluster-issuers.yaml

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-qa/infrastructure/envoy-gateway/kustomization.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
- ../../../../bases/infrastructure/envoy-gateway
- httproute-assets-core-extra.yaml
patches:
  - target:
      group: gateway.envoyproxy.io
      version: v1alpha1
      kind: SecurityPolicy
      name: mfe-global-cors-policy
    patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/cors/allowOrigins
        value:
          - "https://nbo-postnegociacion-qa.nubo-nuam.com"
  - target:
      group: gateway.networking.k8s.io
      version: v1
      kind: Gateway
      name: main-gateway
    patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/listeners/-
        value:
          name: kafka-broker-0
          protocol: TCP
          port: 9095
          allowedRoutes:
            kinds:
              - kind: TCPRoute
            namespaces:
              from: All
      - op: add
        path: /spec/listeners/-
        value:
          name: kafka-broker-1
          protocol: TCP
          port: 9096
          allowedRoutes:
            kinds:
              - kind: TCPRoute
            namespaces:
              from: All
      - op: add
        path: /spec/listeners/-
        value:
          name: kafka-broker-2
          protocol: TCP
          port: 9097
          allowedRoutes:
            kinds:
              - kind: TCPRoute
            namespaces:
              from: All
      - op: add
        path: /spec/listeners/-
        value:
          name: kafka-sni
          protocol: TLS
          port: 443
          tls:
            mode: Passthrough
          allowedRoutes:
            kinds:
              - kind: TLSRoute
            namespaces:
              from: All
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/listeners/1/tls/certificateRefs
        value:
          - name: tls-wildcard-nubo-nuam-com-qa
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/listeners/2/tls/certificateRefs
        value:
          - name: tls-wildcard-nubo-nuam-com-qa
      # Kubernetes Dashboard: TLS terminado en Envoy con el comodín de QA. Va al final
      # (/spec/listeners/-) para no correr los índices 1 y 2 de los replace anteriores.
      - op: add
        path: /spec/listeners/-
        value:
          name: https-kubernetes-dashboard
          protocol: HTTPS
          port: 443
          hostname: kubernetes-dashboard.nubo-nuam.com
          tls:
            mode: Terminate
            certificateRefs:
              - name: tls-wildcard-nubo-nuam-com-qa
          allowedRoutes:
            kinds:
              - kind: HTTPRoute
            namespaces:
              from: Selector
              selector:
                matchLabels:
                  kubernetes.io/metadata.name: kubernetes-dashboard
  - target:
      group: gateway.networking.k8s.io
      version: v1
      kind: HTTPRoute
      name: nbo-front-assets-core
      namespace: nubo-front
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/rules
        value:
          - backendRefs:
              - group: ""
                kind: Service
                name: parent-container-front-service
                port: 80
                weight: 1
            matches:
              - path: {type: PathPrefix, value: /assets/}
          - backendRefs:
              - group: ""
                kind: Service
                name: parent-container-front-service
                port: 80
                weight: 1
            matches:
              - path: {type: Exact, value: /favicon.svg}
          - backendRefs:
              - group: ""
                kind: Service
                name: parent-container-front-service
                port: 80
                weight: 1
            matches:
              - path: {type: Exact, value: /favicon.ico}
          - backendRefs:
              - group: ""
                kind: Service
                name: parent-container-front-service
                port: 80
                weight: 1
            filters:
              - type: URLRewrite
                urlRewrite: {path: {replacePrefixMatch: /, type: ReplacePrefixMatch}}
            matches:
              - path: {type: PathPrefix, value: /authentication/}
          - backendRefs:
              - group: ""
                kind: Service

                port: 80
                weight: 1
            filters:
              - type: URLRewrite

            matches:

          - backendRefs:

          - backendRefs:

            filters:
              - type: URLRewrite
                urlRewrite: {path: {replacePrefixMatch: /, type: ReplacePrefixMatch}}
            matches:
              - path: {type: PathPrefix, value: /utils/}
          - backendRefs:
              - group: ""
                kind: Service
                name: opcionesmenu-front-service
                port: 80
                weight: 1
            filters:
              - type: URLRewrite
                urlRewrite: {path: {replacePrefixMatch: /, type: ReplacePrefixMatch}}
            matches:

            filters:

          - backendRefs:

        value:
          crds: Skip
      - op: add
        path: /spec/upgrade
        value:
          crds: Skip
      - op: add
        path: /spec/values
        value:
          crds:
            enabled: false
          deployment:
            pod:
              nodeSelector:

                - key: workload

  - target:
      group: gateway.envoyproxy.io
      version: v1alpha1
      kind: EnvoyProxy
      name: envoyproxy-aws
    patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/provider/kubernetes/envoyDeployment
        value:
          pod:
            nodeSelector:
              node-lifecycle: bottlerocket-infra
            tolerations:
              - key: workload
                operator: Equal
                value: infra
                effect: NoSchedule

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-qa/infrastructure/kafka-interno-nubo/kustomization.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - ../../../../bases/infrastructure/kafka-interno-nubo
  - tcproute-kafka-bootstrap.yaml
  - tcproute-kafka-broker-0.yaml
  - tcproute-kafka-broker-1.yaml
  - tcproute-kafka-broker-2.yaml
  - tlsroute-kafka-bootstrap.yaml
  - tlsroute-kafka-broker-0.yaml
  - tlsroute-kafka-broker-1.yaml
  - tlsroute-kafka-broker-2.yaml
  - strimzi-operator-helmrelease.yaml
patches:
  - target:
      group: kafka.strimzi.io
      version: v1beta2
      kind: Kafka
      name: kafka-cluster
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/kafka/listeners
        value:
          - name: plain
            port: 9092
            type: internal
            tls: false
            authentication:
              type: scram-sha-512
          - name: tls
            port: 9093
            type: internal
            tls: true
            authentication:
              type: scram-sha-512
          - name: external
            port: 9094
            type: cluster-ip
            tls: true
            authentication:
              type: scram-sha-512
            configuration:
              brokerCertChainAndKey:
                secretName: "[REDACTED]"
                certificate: tls.crt
                key: tls.key
              brokers:
                - broker: 0
                  advertisedHost: kafka-broker-0-nbo-postnegociacion-qa.nubo-nuam.com
                  advertisedPort: 443
                - broker: 1
                  advertisedHost: kafka-broker-1-nbo-postnegociacion-qa.nubo-nuam.com
                  advertisedPort: 443
                - broker: 2
                  advertisedHost: kafka-broker-2-nbo-postnegociacion-qa.nubo-nuam.com
                  advertisedPort: 443
```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-qa/infrastructure/kubernetes-dashboard/httproute-kubernetes-dashboard.yaml

```yaml
# 💡 El TLS lo termina Envoy en el listener https-kubernetes-dashboard (main-gateway)
# con el comodín tls-wildcard-nubo-nuam-com-qa. De Envoy al pod el tráfico va por HTTP
# (9090) dentro de la VPC; ver patch del Deployment en kustomization.yaml.
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata:
  name: kubernetes-dashboard
  namespace: kubernetes-dashboard
spec:
  hostnames:
    - kubernetes-dashboard.nubo-nuam.com
  parentRefs:
    - group: gateway.networking.k8s.io
      kind: Gateway
      name: main-gateway
      namespace: envoy-gateway-system
      sectionName: https-kubernetes-dashboard
  rules:
    - backendRefs:
        - name: kubernetes-dashboard
          port: 80
      matches:
        - path:
            type: PathPrefix
            value: /
---
# Redirección HTTP -> HTTPS (mismo patrón que nubo-http-redirect del front).
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata:
  name: kubernetes-dashboard-http-redirect
  namespace: kubernetes-dashboard
spec:
  hostnames:
    - kubernetes-dashboard.nubo-nuam.com
  parentRefs:
    - group: gateway.networking.k8s.io
      kind: Gateway
      name: main-gateway
      namespace: envoy-gateway-system
      sectionName: http
  rules:
    - filters:
        - type: RequestRedirect
          requestRedirect:
            scheme: https
            statusCode: 301
      matches:
        - path:
            type: PathPrefix
            value: /

```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-qa/infrastructure/kubernetes-dashboard/kustomization.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - ../../../../bases/infrastructure/kubernetes-dashboard
  - httproute-kubernetes-dashboard.yaml
patches:
  # 💡 En QA el TLS lo termina Envoy Gateway, así que el dashboard sirve HTTP en 9090.
  # Sin --auto-generate-certificates (ni --tls-cert-file) v2.7.0 sirve solo HTTP en
  # --insecure-bind-address:--insecure-port (default 127.0.0.1:9090, por eso 0.0.0.0).
  # --enable-insecure-login habilita el login por token cuando el pod no ve HTTPS.
  - target:
      group: apps
      version: v1
      kind: Deployment
      name: kubernetes-dashboard
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/args
        value:
          - --namespace=kubernetes-dashboard
          - --insecure-bind-address=0.0.0.0
          - --insecure-port=9090
          - --enable-insecure-login
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/ports
        value:
          - containerPort: 9090
            protocol: TCP
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/livenessProbe/httpGet
        value:
          scheme: HTTP
          path: /
          port: 9090
  - target:
      version: v1
      kind: Service
      name: kubernetes-dashboard
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/ports
        value:
          - port: 80
            targetPort: 9090

```

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-qa/infrastructure/postgresql-nubo/objectstore-nubo-s3-backups-qa.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: barmancloud.cnpg.io/v1
kind: ObjectStore
metadata:
  name: nubo-s3-backups-qa
  namespace: postgresql-nubo
spec:
  configuration:
    destinationPath: s3://cloudnative-pg-nubo-backups/nubo-qa
    endpointURL: https://s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
    s3Credentials:
      inheritFromIAMRole: true
      # Secret "barman-s3-region" (namespace postgresql-nubo, key "region", valor "us-east-1")
      # gestionado a mano, fuera de GitOps (mismo criterio que nubo-back-secret y los
      # certificados TLS de este cluster: el plugin barman-cloud tipa este campo como
      # SecretKeySelector, no acepta ConfigMap, y este repo no comitea Secrets en texto plano).
      region:
        name: barman-s3-region
        key: region
    data:
      compression: gzip
      encryption: AES256
      jobs: 4
    wal:
      compression: gzip
      encryption: AES256
      maxParallel: 4
  retentionPolicy: 30d

```

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: sftpgo
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: sftpgo
          env:
            - name: SFTPGO_DATA_PROVIDER_NAME
              value: /var/lib/sftpgo/sftpgo.db
          volumeMounts:
            - name: sftp-storage
              mountPath: /var/lib/sftpgo
            - name: sftp-storage
              mountPath: /srv/sftpgo/data

## overlays/nubo-postnegociacion-qa/infrastructure/velero/kustomization.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
- ../../../../bases/infrastructure/velero
patches:
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /data/values.yaml
        value: |
            # values-prod.yaml — Velero on EKS (Production)
            # - Auth: IRSA (no static secret)
            # - Backups: S3 + KMS
            # - PV: EBS CSI snapshots (EnableCSI)
            # - Optional FS backup via node-agent (Kopia) enabled
            # - Spread across AZs

            namespace:
              labels:
                # Ajusta según tu postura de Pod Security Admission.
                # Velero a veces requiere permisos elevados si activas node-agent.
                pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: privileged
                pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce-version: latest
                pod-security.kubernetes.io/audit: privileged
                pod-security.kubernetes.io/audit-version: latest
                pod-security.kubernetes.io/warn: privileged
                pod-security.kubernetes.io/warn-version: latest

            image:
              repository: velero/velero
              tag: v1.17.1
              pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
    
            upgradeCRDs: false
     
            # Recomendado: etiquetas/annotations base para observabilidad y ownership
            labels:
              app.kubernetes.io/part-of: backup

            podAnnotations: {}

            # Recomendado para IRSA en EKS: fsGroup
            podSecurityContext:
              fsGroup: 1337

            containerSecurityContext:
              allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
              readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
              capabilities:
                drop: ["ALL"]

            resources:
              requests:
                cpu: 200m
                memory: 256Mi
              limits:
                cpu: 1000m
                memory: 1Gi

            # =========================
            # AWS Plugin (REQUIRED)
            # =========================
            initContainers:
              - name: velero-plugin-for-aws
                image: velero/velero-plugin-for-aws:v1.13.1
                imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
                volumeMounts:
                  - mountPath: /target
                    name: plugins

            # =========================
            # RBAC
            # =========================
            rbac:
              create: true
              clusterAdministrator: true
              clusterAdministratorName: cluster-admin

            # =========================
            # ServiceAccount + IRSA
            # =========================
            serviceAccount:
              server:
                create: true
                name: velero-server
                annotations:
                  # >>> CAMBIA ESTO <<<
                  eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: "arn:aws:iam::009160073106:role/eks-velero-backup"
                labels: {}
                automountServiceAccountToken: true

            # NO uses secret con credenciales estáticas si estás en EKS (IRSA)
            credentials:
              useSecret: false
              name:
              existingSecret:
              secretContents: "[REDACTED]"
              extraEnvVars: {}
              extraSecretRef: "[REDACTED]"

            # =========================
            # Feature flags (CSI snapshots)
            # =========================
            configuration:
              features: "EnableCSI"

              # Backup Storage Location (S3)
              backupStorageLocation:
                - name: default
                  provider: aws
                  bucket: "velero-temporal-nuam-bucket"
                  prefix: "velero/prod"
                  default: true
                  accessMode: ReadWrite
                  config:
                    region: "us-east-1"
                    # normalmente false en AWS S3 estándar
                    s3ForcePathStyle: "false"
                    # opcional si usas endpoint S3 compatible
                    # s3Url: "https://s3.<AWS_REGION>.amazonaws.com"
                    # cifrado en reposo (recomendado)
                    kmsKeyId: "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:009160073106:key/133322cb-f6dd-44f8-ba56-f0ef24176a3e"

              # Volume Snapshot Location (EBS snapshots son regionales)
              volumeSnapshotLocation:
                - name: default
                  provider: aws
                  config:
                    region: "us-east-1"

              # Server flags (prod-friendly)
              logLevel: "info"
              logFormat: "json"
              backupSyncPeriod: "1m"
              storeValidationFrequency: "1h"
              garbageCollectionFrequency: "1h"
              defaultBackupTTL: "168h" # 7 días por defecto

              # Velero 1.17: por defecto usa Kopia como uploader.
              uploaderType: "kopia"
              fsBackupTimeout: "4h"
              defaultItemOperationTimeout: "4h"
              terminatingResourceTimeout: "10m"
              disableInformerCache: false

              extraArgs:
                # Ajusta si quieres tunear performance API server
                - "--client-qps=20.0"
                - "--client-burst=30"

            # =========================
            # Enable backups/snapshots
            # =========================
            backupsEnabled: true
            snapshotsEnabled: true

            # =========================
            # Node-Agent (FS Backup) — recomendable si quieres cubrir:
            # - volúmenes que NO soporten snapshot CSI
            # - datos en emptyDir/pod volumes (con annotations)
            # Si solo te importan PV EBS con CSI snapshots, puedes poner false.
            # =========================
            deployNodeAgent: true

            nodeAgent:
              disableHostPath: false
              podVolumePath: /var/lib/kubelet/pods
              pluginVolumePath: /var/lib/kubelet/plugins
              useScratchEmptyDir: true

              # node-agent requiere privilegios; en EKS suele ir ok con PSP/PSA privileged namespace
              podSecurityContext:
                runAsUser: 0

              containerSecurityContext: {}

              resources:
                requests:
                  cpu: 100m
                  memory: 256Mi
                limits:
                  cpu: 1000m
                  memory: 1Gi

              tolerations:
                # si tienes nodes dedicados/taints, ajusta aquí
                - operator: "Exists"

            # =========================
            # Scheduling: define tus backups
            # =========================
            schedules:
              preprod-daily-cluster:
                disabled: false
                labels:
                  env: qa
                  tier: daily
                annotations: {}
                schedule: "0 2 * * *" # 02:00 todos los días
                template:
                  ttl: "336h" # 14 días
                  storageLocation: default
                  volumeSnapshotLocations:
                    - default
                  includedNamespaces:
                    - "*"   # backup de todo el cluster (ojo con volumen de datos)
                  # Excluye cosas que suelen recrearse o no quieres respaldar
                  excludedNamespaces:
                    - kube-system
                    - kube-public
                    - kube-node-lease
                  # Si quieres excluir PV/PVC del cluster backup y manejarlos con otro schedule:
                  # excludedNamespaceScopedResources:
                  #   - persistentvolumeclaims
                  # excludedClusterScopedResources:
                  #   - persistentvolumes

              preprod-hourly-critical:
                disabled: false
                labels:
                  env: prod
                  tier: hourly
                annotations: {}
                schedule: "0 * * * *" # cada hora
                template:
                  ttl: "72h" # 3 días
                  storageLocation: default
                  volumeSnapshotLocations:
                    - default
                  includedNamespaces:
                    # >>> AJUSTA A TUS NAMESPACES CRÍTICOS <<<
                    - "apps"
                    - "platform"
                    - "databases"
                  excludedResources:
                    # ejemplos típicos
                    - events
                    - events.events.k8s.io

            # =========================
            # Placement / AZ spread (para server)
            # =========================
            affinity:
              podAntiAffinity:
                preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
                  - weight: 100
                    podAffinityTerm:
                      topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
                      labelSelector:
                        matchLabels:
                          app.kubernetes.io/name: velero

            # Si tienes nodegroups por AZ con labels, puedes forzarlo así:
            # nodeSelector:
            #   nodegroup: "platform-prod"
            nodeSelector:
              node-lifecycle: bottlerocket-infra

            tolerations:
              - operator: "Exists"

            # =========================
            # Metrics (Prometheus)
            # =========================
            metrics:
              enabled: true
              scrapeInterval: 30s
              scrapeTimeout: 10s
              service:
                type: ClusterIP
                annotations: {}
                labels: {}
              podAnnotations:
                prometheus.io/scrape: "true"
                prometheus.io/port: "8085"
                prometheus.io/path: "/metrics"
              serviceMonitor:
                autodetect: true
                enabled: true
                annotations: {}
                additionalLabels:
                  release: "prometheus"  # ajusta si tu Prom Operator usa otro label

            prometheusRule:
              autodetect: true
              enabled: true
              additionalLabels:
                release: "prometheus"
              spec:
                - alert: VeleroBackupFailing
                  annotations:
                    message: "Velero backups failing for schedule {{ $labels.schedule }}"
                  expr: |-
                    velero_backup_last_status{schedule!=""} != 1
                  for: 15m
                  labels:
                    severity: warning

            # =========================
            # Extra objects (opcional)
            # - Puedes poner aquí VolumeSnapshotClass si quieres gestionarlo como manifiesto
            # - En EKS normalmente ya tienes ebs-csi-driver + snapshot-controller
            # =========================
            extraObjects: []
     
    target:
      kind: ConfigMap
      name: values-velero

```

## overlays/poc-aws-prod/infrastructure/postgresql/snippets/postgresql-release.yml

```yaml
apiVersion: helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v2
kind: HelmRelease
metadata:
  name: nubo-data
  namespace: nubo-data
spec:
  values:
    nameOverride: nubo-psql
    fullnameOverride: nubo-psql
    postgresql:
      image:
        registry: docker.io
        repository: bitnami/postgresql-repmgr
        tag: 16.4.0-debian-12-r4
       #tag: 14.4.0
       #debug: true
      resources:
        requests:
          cpu: "1000m"          # Solicitar 1/2 de núcleo de CPU
          ephemeral-storage: "800Mi"
          memory: "1Gi"        # Solicitar 2 Gi de memoria
        limits:
          cpu: "2"             # Limitar el uso de CPU a 2 núcleos
          ephemeral-storage: "2Gi"
          memory: "4Gi"        # Limitar el uso de memoria a 4 Gi 
      replicaCount: 2
      database: nubo
      username: postgres
      existingSecret: "[REDACTED]"
      nodeSelector:
        eks.amazonaws.com/nodegroup: ng-ondemand-eks-nodes-20250808200128449000000003
      #nodeSelector:
      #  nuamx-core: enabled
      #initdbScriptsCM: devops-psql-scripts
      maxConnections: "400"
      livenessProbe:
        initialDelaySeconds: 45
        periodSeconds: 20
        timeoutSeconds: 10
        failureThreshold: 12
        successThreshold: 1
      readinessProbe:
        initialDelaySeconds: 45
        periodSeconds: 20
        timeoutSeconds: 10
        failureThreshold: 12
        successThreshold: 1
      startupProbe:
        initialDelaySeconds: 10
        periodSeconds: 20
        timeoutSeconds: 10
        failureThreshold: 20
        successThreshold: 1
      configurationCM: nubo-psql-config
      pgHbaConfiguration: |-
        # Permitir conexiones de replicación desde el nodo específico
        host    replication     repmgr    nubo-psql-postgresql-1.nubo-data.svc.cluster.local/32    md5
        # Permitir conexiones de repmgr desde el nodo específico
        host    repmgr         repmgr    nubo-psql-postgresql-1.nubo-data.svc.cluster.local/32    md5
        # Permitir conexiones locales
        local   all            all                    md5
    volumePermissions:
      # Enable init container that changes volume permissions in the data directory (for cases where the default k8s runAsUser and fsUser values do not work)
      enabled: true
    persistence:
      enabled: true
      accessModes:
        - ReadWriteOnce
      size: 20Gi
      storageClass: sc-database
      
    pgpool:
      replicaCount: 2
      useLoadBalancing: true
      existingSecret: "[REDACTED]"
      reservedConnections: 1
      numInitChildren: "100"
      maxPool: "2"
      childLifeTime: "120"
      childMaxConnections: "50"
      livenessProbe:
        enabled: true
        initialDelaySeconds: 60  # Aumentar el tiempo de inicio
        periodSeconds: 30
        timeoutSeconds: 10
        failureThreshold: 6
        successThreshold: 1
      readinessProbe:
        initialDelaySeconds: 60  # Incrementa el tiempo de inicio
        periodSeconds: 30
        timeoutSeconds: 10
        failureThreshold: 6
        successThreshold: 1
      startupProbe:
        initialDelaySeconds: 60  # Aumenta el tiempo de inicio
        periodSeconds: 30
        timeoutSeconds: 10
        failureThreshold: 20
        successThreshold: 1
      configurationCM: nubo-pgpool-config   

```

## overlays/release/apps/api-client/cause-catalog.yml

```yaml
# Fuente: docs/plans/2026-09-17-mapa-errores-cadena-orquestador-depurado.md, tabla maestra §6 (filas
# 1-53: ErrorCode de orquestador y cmd-back; filas 63-64/69/72/76/78: causeCode propios de
# fracciones-contado-back reenviados sin envolver por cmd-back; más las claves compuestas
# RULE_REASSIGNMENT_BY_SIDE (Fase 4, filas 63-64) y RULE_FINAL_ASSIGNMENT_BY_SIDE/_BY_FRACTION/
# _BY_FRACTION_CUSTODIAN (Fase 5, filas 65-68)). Ver §9.3.1 para el diseño de este archivo y §9.6-b
# para la reconciliación completa de por qué 80 filas de §6 producen 64 entradas acá (exclusiones
# deliberadas + dedup de causeCode compartidos entre repos + claves compuestas sumadas, no 1:1).
cause-catalog:
  entries:
    # --- orquestador (filas 1-5) ---
    DEFINITIVE_ASSIGNMENT_ERROR:
      code: ARA-001
      message: "No fue posible completar la asignación definitiva: existen validaciones de negocio pendientes para la punta."
      type: BUSINESS
    VALIDATION_ERROR:
      code: ARA-002
      message: "El mensaje recibido no cumple con el formato o las validaciones esperadas."
      type: TECHNICAL
    CLIENT_OPERATIONS_CMD_ERROR:
      code: ARA-003
      message: "Ocurrió un error al procesar la solicitud. (003)"
      detailedMessage: "Ocurrió un error inesperado al comunicarse con el servicio de comandos de operaciones."
      type: TECHNICAL
    ERROR_KAFKA_CONSUMER_NUBO:
      code: ARA-004
      message: "Ocurrió un error al procesar la solicitud. (004)"
      detailedMessage: "El consumidor de Kafka del orquestador no pudo procesar el mensaje recibido."
      type: TECHNICAL
    ERROR_DESERIALIZER_JSON:
      code: ARA-005
      message: "Ocurrió un error al procesar la solicitud. (005)"
      detailedMessage: "El mensaje de Kafka no pudo ser deserializado a un objeto JSON válido."
      type: TECHNICAL

    # --- cmd-back (filas 6-53) ---
    UNAUTHORIZED:
      code: ARA-006
      message: "Ocurrió un error al procesar la solicitud. (006)"
      detailedMessage: "La solicitud no está autorizada."
      type: TECHNICAL
    UNEXPECTED:
      code: ARA-007
      message: "Ocurrió un error inesperado al procesar la solicitud. (007)"
      type: TECHNICAL
    METHOD_ARGUMENT_TYPE:
      code: ARA-008
      message: "Ocurrió un error al procesar la solicitud. (008)"
      detailedMessage: "La ruta de la solicitud no es válida."
      type: TECHNICAL
    METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED:
      code: ARA-009
      message: "Ocurrió un error al procesar la solicitud. (009)"
      detailedMessage: "El método HTTP utilizado no está permitido para este recurso."
      type: TECHNICAL
    NOT_FOUND:
      code: ARA-010
      message: "Ocurrió un error al procesar la solicitud. (010)"
      detailedMessage: "El recurso solicitado no existe."
      type: TECHNICAL
    UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE:
      code: ARA-011
      message: "Ocurrió un error al procesar la solicitud. (011)"
      detailedMessage: "El tipo de contenido (Content-Type) de la solicitud no es compatible."
      type: TECHNICAL
    MESSAGE_NOT_READABLE:
      code: ARA-012
      message: "Ocurrió un error al procesar la solicitud. (012)"
      detailedMessage: "No fue posible leer el cuerpo de la solicitud."
      type: TECHNICAL
    BAD_REQUEST:
      code: ARA-013
      message: "El cuerpo de la solicitud no es válido."
      type: TECHNICAL
    HEADER_CLIENT_IP_REQUIRED:
      code: ARA-014
      message: "Ocurrió un error al procesar la solicitud. (014)"
      detailedMessage: "Falta el encabezado obligatorio client_ip."
      type: TECHNICAL
    HEADER_CLIENT_IP_INVALID:
      code: ARA-015
      message: "Ocurrió un error al procesar la solicitud. (015)"
      detailedMessage: "El encabezado client_ip no es válido."
      type: TECHNICAL
    HEADER_CLIENT_USER_REQUIRED:

    # BatchAssignmentItemOutDto.errorCode en cmd-back, ver Fase 3). TRADE_NOT_FOUND, SIDE_NOT_FOUND,
    # TYPE_NOT_FOUND, TAXES_NOT_FOUND, INVESTOR_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND y PARTICIPANT_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND
    # (filas 70/71/73/74/75/77) reusan el mismo ErrorCode.name() que cmd-back y ya están catalogados
    # arriba — solo se agregan acá las 4 entradas que cmd-back no tiene (fila 69, 72, 76, 78). Fila 79
    # (CLIENT_OPERATION_RULES_ERROR) también reusa la entrada de cmd-back de arriba. Filas 54-62
    # (reglas-back, HTTP directo) y 80 (calculos-back) quedan fuera deliberadamente: no son
    # alcanzables vía el pipeline real del orquestador (ver §6/§9.3) — catalogarlas sería código
    # muerto en este archivo.
    STATUS_NOT_FOUND:
      code: ARA-057
      message: "Ocurrió un error al procesar la solicitud. (057)"
      detailedMessage: "No se encontró el estado informado."
      type: BUSINESS

    # reglas-back (validateUpdateStatusTradeV1, sin cambios -- ya era genérico) hasta cmd-back
    # (AssignmentClosureServiceImpl, directo a reglas-back, no pasa por fracciones-contado-back) y
    # orquestador concatena. NO reusa ARA-106 pese a que §8 lo reservaba conceptualmente para 238-A:
    # ese código ya está tomado por la entrada de reasignación 233-C de arriba (ver nota de esa

## overlays/release/apps/api-client/kustomization.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
# Un volumen solo puede montar ConfigMaps de su propio namespace: el mismo catalogo se publica en cada
# namespace que lo consume, generado desde un unico archivo (cause-catalog.yml) para no duplicar el YAML.
generatorOptions:
  disableNameSuffixHash: true
configMapGenerator:
  - name: api-client-cause-catalog
    namespace: nubo-back-integracion
    files:
      - cause-catalog.yml
  - name: api-client-cause-catalog
    namespace: nubo-back
    files:
      - cause-catalog.yml

```

      - op: replace

    target:

## overlays/release/apps/asignacion-definitiva-auto-back/kustomization.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - ../../../../bases/apps/asignacion-definitiva-auto-back
  - service-peers.yaml
patches:
  - patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/image
        value: registry.nuamexchange.com/nubo/asignacion-definitiva-auto-back:0.72.0-rc.1

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/cpu
        value: 999m

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/memory
        value: 999Mi

      - op: replace
        path: /spec/replicas
        value: 2

    target:
      kind: Deployment
  # Reparto de los escenarios 1 y 4 entre réplicas (slices por MOD(trade_id, #pods)). Sin esta
  # variable, o con DISTRIBUTED_ENABLED=false, todo se procesa en el pod que recibe el GET.
  # Grace period: un pod que baja termina el lote en curso (transacción + ack Kafka) antes de salir.
  - patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/-
        value:
          name: DISTRIBUTED_PEERS_HOST
          value: asignacion-definitiva-auto-back-peers.nubo-back.svc.cluster.local
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/terminationGracePeriodSeconds
        value: 120
    target:
      kind: Deployment

    target:
      kind: Deployment

```

## overlays/release/apps/asignacion-definitiva-auto-back/service-peers.yaml

```yaml
# Service headless para que las réplicas se descubran entre sí: su DNS devuelve la IP de cada
# pod listo. El pod que recibe el GET /definitive reparte los escenarios 1 y 4 en un slice por
# réplica (POST /definitive/slice). Solo tráfico interno; el Service ClusterIP de la base no cambia.
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: asignacion-definitiva-auto-back-peers
  namespace: nubo-back
spec:
  clusterIP: None
  selector:
    app: asignacion-definitiva-auto-back
  ports:
    - name: http
      protocol: TCP
      port: 8080
      targetPort: 8080

```

## overlays/release/apps/authentication-front/snippets/config-authentication.yml

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: config-authentication
  namespace: nubo-front
data:
  default.conf: |
    server {
        listen       5003;
        listen  [::]:5003;
        server_name  localhost;

        # --- Compresión en runtime ---
        # Si el build de este microfrontend usa vite-plugin-compression
        # (igual que nubo-front), migrar a gzip_static + brotli_static
        # más adelante: mejor ratio y cero costo de CPU por request.
        gzip on;
        gzip_vary on;
        gzip_proxied any;
        gzip_comp_level 6;
        gzip_min_length 256;
        gzip_types
            text/plain
            text/css
            text/xml
            application/json
            application/javascript
            application/xml+rss
            application/atom+xml
            image/svg+xml
            font/woff2;

        # --- Cache de metadata de archivos ---
        open_file_cache max=1000 inactive=20s;
        open_file_cache_valid 30s;
        open_file_cache_min_uses 2;
        open_file_cache_errors on;

        # --- Tuning de sockets, relevante en 3G por latencia alta ---
        sendfile on;
        tcp_nopush on;
        tcp_nodelay on;
        keepalive_timeout 65;

        # --- CORS a nivel server (una sola vez, aplica a todos los location) ---
        add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' '*' always;
        add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods' 'GET, POST, OPTIONS, DELETE, PUT, PATCH' always;
        add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers' 'Authorization, Content-Type' always;
        add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Credentials' 'true' always;

        location / {
            if ($request_method = 'OPTIONS') {
                return 204;
            }

            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            index  index.html index.htm;

            # FIX CRÍTICO: sin esto, rutas de cliente (ej. /login/callback)
            # devuelven 404 al acceder directo por URL o al refrescar.
            try_files $uri /index.html;

            # index.html nunca se cachea: referencia los chunks con hash
            # de cada build.
            add_header Cache-Control "no-cache, must-revalidate" always;
        }

        # remoteEntry.js NO debe cachearse largo: es el manifest que el
        # host lee para saber qué versión de este remote cargar.
        location = /assets/remoteEntry.js {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            add_header Cache-Control "no-cache, must-revalidate" always;
        }

        location /assets/ {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            types {
                application/javascript js;
                text/css css;
                image/svg+xml svg;
                application/json json;
            }
            # Cache largo e inmutable: válido si estos archivos tienen
            # hash en el nombre (patrón estándar de Vite/Webpack).
            # Antes tenía no-cache/no-store, forzando redescarga
            # completa en cada visita — el mayor costo en 3G.
            add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=31536000, immutable" always;
        }

        error_page  404              /404.html;
        error_page  500 502 503 504  /50x.html;
        location = /50x.html {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
        }
    }

```
