## scripts/analyze-cluster-capacity.ps1

```powershell
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$Context,
    [string]$ExpectedContext = "arn:aws:eks:us-east-1:242736647867:cluster/eks-nbo-postneg-prod-eks",
    [string]$OutputDirectory = (Join-Path $PWD ("cluster-capacity-{0}" -f (Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss"))),
    [ValidateRange(1, 100)]
    [int]$WarningPercent = 80
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

function Write-Section {
    param([string]$Title)

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "=== $Title ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
}

function Invoke-Kubectl {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)]
        [string[]]$Arguments,
        [switch]$AllowFailure
    )

    $commandArguments = @()
    if ($Context) {
        $commandArguments += @("--context", $Context)
    }
    $commandArguments += $Arguments

    $output = & kubectl @commandArguments 2>&1
    $exitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
    if ($exitCode -ne 0 -and -not $AllowFailure) {
        throw "kubectl fallo: kubectl $($commandArguments -join ' ')`n$($output -join "`n")"
    }

    [PSCustomObject]@{
        ExitCode = $exitCode
        Output   = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

function Get-KubectlJson {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)]
        [string[]]$Arguments,
        [switch]$AllowFailure
    )

    $result = Invoke-Kubectl -Arguments ($Arguments + @("-o", "json")) -AllowFailure:$AllowFailure
    if ($result.ExitCode -ne 0 -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($result.Output)) {
        return $null
    }

    $result.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
}

function Get-KubectlRawJson {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)]
        [string]$Path,
        [switch]$AllowFailure
    )

    $result = Invoke-Kubectl -Arguments @("get", "--raw", $Path) -AllowFailure:$AllowFailure
    if ($result.ExitCode -ne 0 -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($result.Output)) {
        return $null
    }

    $result.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
}

function ConvertTo-CpuMilli {
    param($Quantity)

    if ($null -eq $Quantity -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$Quantity)) { return 0.0 }
    $text = [string]$Quantity
    if ($text -match '^([0-9.]+)n$') { return [double]$Matches[1] / 1000000 }
    if ($text -match '^([0-9.]+)u$') { return [double]$Matches[1] / 1000 }
    if ($text -match '^([0-9.]+)m$') { return [double]$Matches[1] }
    return [double]$text * 1000
}

function ConvertTo-MemoryMi {
    param($Quantity)

    if ($null -eq $Quantity -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$Quantity)) { return 0.0 }
    $text = [string]$Quantity
    if ($text -notmatch '^([0-9.]+)([EPTGMK]i?|m)?$') {
        throw "Cantidad de memoria no reconocida: $text"
    }

    $value = [double]$Matches[1]
    switch ($Matches[2]) {
        "Ki" { return $value / 1024 }
        "Mi" { return $value }
        "Gi" { return $value * 1024 }
        "Ti" { return $value * 1024 * 1024 }
        "Pi" { return $value * 1024 * 1024 * 1024 }
        "K"  { return $value * 1000 / 1MB }
        "M"  { return $value * 1000000 / 1MB }
        "G"  { return $value * 1000000000 / 1MB }
        "T"  { return $value * 1000000000000 / 1MB }
        "m"  { return $value / 1000 / 1MB }
        default { return $value / 1MB }
    }
}

function Get-Percent {
    param([double]$Value, [double]$Capacity)

    if ($Capacity -le 0) { return 0.0 }
    [math]::Round(($Value / $Capacity) * 100, 1)
}

function Get-PodRequestedResources {
    param($Pod)

    $appCpu = 0.0
    $appMemory = 0.0
    foreach ($container in @($Pod.spec.containers)) {
        $appCpu += ConvertTo-CpuMilli $container.resources.requests.cpu
        $appMemory += ConvertTo-MemoryMi $container.resources.requests.memory
    }

    $initCpu = 0.0
    $initMemory = 0.0
    foreach ($container in @($Pod.spec.initContainers)) {
        $initCpu = [math]::Max($initCpu, (ConvertTo-CpuMilli $container.resources.requests.cpu))
        $initMemory = [math]::Max($initMemory, (ConvertTo-MemoryMi $container.resources.requests.memory))
    }

    [PSCustomObject]@{
        CpuMilli = [math]::Max($appCpu, $initCpu) + (ConvertTo-CpuMilli $Pod.spec.overhead.cpu)
        MemoryMi = [math]::Max($appMemory, $initMemory) + (ConvertTo-MemoryMi $Pod.spec.overhead.memory)
    }
}

if (-not (Get-Command kubectl -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
    throw "kubectl no esta instalado o no esta disponible en PATH."
}

$currentContext = if ($Context) {
    $Context
} else {
    (Invoke-Kubectl -Arguments @("config", "current-context")).Output.Trim()
}

if ($ExpectedContext -and $currentContext -ne $ExpectedContext) {
    throw "Contexto inesperado: '$currentContext'. Esperado: '$ExpectedContext'. Use -ExpectedContext para autorizar otro contexto."
}

Write-Host "Contexto: $currentContext" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "Revision de solo lectura; no se modificara ningun recurso."

$nodes = Get-KubectlJson -Arguments @("get", "nodes")
$pods = Get-KubectlJson -Arguments @("get", "pods", "--all-namespaces")
$pdbs = Get-KubectlJson -Arguments @("get", "poddisruptionbudgets.policy", "--all-namespaces") -AllowFailure
$nodeMetrics = Get-KubectlRawJson -Path "/apis/metrics.k8s.io/v1beta1/nodes" -AllowFailure
$podMetrics = Get-KubectlRawJson -Path "/apis/metrics.k8s.io/v1beta1/pods" -AllowFailure

$nodeMetricByName = @{}
foreach ($metric in @($nodeMetrics.items)) {
    $nodeMetricByName[$metric.metadata.name] = $metric
}

$podMetricByName = @{}
foreach ($metric in @($podMetrics.items)) {
    $podMetricByName["$($metric.metadata.namespace)/$($metric.metadata.name)"] = $metric
}

$podRows = @(
    foreach ($pod in @($pods.items)) {
        if ($pod.status.phase -in @("Succeeded", "Failed")) { continue }

        $requested = Get-PodRequestedResources -Pod $pod
        $usedCpu = 0.0
        $usedMemory = 0.0
        $containersWithoutCpuRequest = @($pod.spec.containers | Where-Object {
            $null -eq $_.resources.requests.cpu
        }).Count
        $containersWithoutMemoryRequest = @($pod.spec.containers | Where-Object {
            $null -eq $_.resources.requests.memory
        }).Count
        $metric = $podMetricByName["$($pod.metadata.namespace)/$($pod.metadata.name)"]
        foreach ($containerMetric in @($metric.containers)) {
            $usedCpu += ConvertTo-CpuMilli $containerMetric.usage.cpu
            $usedMemory += ConvertTo-MemoryMi $containerMetric.usage.memory
        }

        [PSCustomObject]@{
            Namespace       = $pod.metadata.namespace
            Pod             = $pod.metadata.name
            Node            = $pod.spec.nodeName
            Phase           = $pod.status.phase
            CpuRequest_m    = [math]::Round($requested.CpuMilli, 1)
            CpuUse_m        = [math]::Round($usedCpu, 1)
            MemoryRequestMi = [math]::Round($requested.MemoryMi, 1)
            MemoryUseMi     = [math]::Round($usedMemory, 1)
            NoCpuRequest    = $containersWithoutCpuRequest
            NoMemoryRequest = $containersWithoutMemoryRequest
        }
    }
)

$nodeRows = @(
    foreach ($node in @($nodes.items)) {
        $name = $node.metadata.name
        $nodePods = @($podRows | Where-Object { $_.Node -eq $name })
        $cpuAllocatable = ConvertTo-CpuMilli $node.status.allocatable.cpu
        $memoryAllocatable = ConvertTo-MemoryMi $node.status.allocatable.memory
        $podAllocatable = [int]$node.status.allocatable.pods
        $cpuRequested = ($nodePods | Measure-Object CpuRequest_m -Sum).Sum
        $memoryRequested = ($nodePods | Measure-Object MemoryRequestMi -Sum).Sum
        $metric = $nodeMetricByName[$name]
        $cpuUsed = ConvertTo-CpuMilli $metric.usage.cpu
        $memoryUsed = ConvertTo-MemoryMi $metric.usage.memory
        $readyCondition = @($node.status.conditions | Where-Object { $_.type -eq "Ready" })[0]

        [PSCustomObject]@{
            Node          = $name
            NodeGroup     = $node.metadata.labels.'eks.amazonaws.com/nodegroup'
            Instance      = $node.metadata.labels.'node.kubernetes.io/instance-type'
            Zone          = $node.metadata.labels.'topology.kubernetes.io/zone'
            Workload      = $node.metadata.labels.workload
            Ready         = $readyCondition.status
            Pods          = $nodePods.Count
            PodsMax       = $podAllocatable
            PodsPct       = Get-Percent $nodePods.Count $podAllocatable
            CpuAlloc_m    = [math]::Round($cpuAllocatable, 0)
            CpuRequest_m  = [math]::Round($cpuRequested, 0)
            CpuRequestPct = Get-Percent $cpuRequested $cpuAllocatable
            CpuUse_m      = [math]::Round($cpuUsed, 0)
            CpuUsePct     = Get-Percent $cpuUsed $cpuAllocatable
            MemAllocMi    = [math]::Round($memoryAllocatable, 0)
            MemRequestMi  = [math]::Round($memoryRequested, 0)
            MemRequestPct = Get-Percent $memoryRequested $memoryAllocatable
            MemUseMi      = [math]::Round($memoryUsed, 0)
            MemUsePct     = Get-Percent $memoryUsed $memoryAllocatable
            PodsNoCpuRequest = @($nodePods | Where-Object { $_.NoCpuRequest -gt 0 }).Count
            PodsNoMemRequest = @($nodePods | Where-Object { $_.NoMemoryRequest -gt 0 }).Count
        }
    }
)

$groupRows = @(
    foreach ($group in @($nodeRows | Group-Object NodeGroup)) {
        $items = @($group.Group)
        $cpuAlloc = ($items | Measure-Object CpuAlloc_m -Sum).Sum
        $cpuRequest = ($items | Measure-Object CpuRequest_m -Sum).Sum
        $cpuUse = ($items | Measure-Object CpuUse_m -Sum).Sum
        $memAlloc = ($items | Measure-Object MemAllocMi -Sum).Sum
        $memRequest = ($items | Measure-Object MemRequestMi -Sum).Sum
        $memUse = ($items | Measure-Object MemUseMi -Sum).Sum
        $podsCurrent = ($items | Measure-Object Pods -Sum).Sum
        $podsMax = ($items | Measure-Object PodsMax -Sum).Sum
        $largestCpuNode = ($items | Measure-Object CpuAlloc_m -Maximum).Maximum
        $largestMemNode = ($items | Measure-Object MemAllocMi -Maximum).Maximum
        $largestPodNode = ($items | Measure-Object PodsMax -Maximum).Maximum
        $nPlusOne = $items.Count -gt 1 -and
            $cpuRequest -le ($cpuAlloc - $largestCpuNode) -and
            $memRequest -le ($memAlloc - $largestMemNode) -and
            $podsCurrent -le ($podsMax - $largestPodNode)
        $nPlusOneByUse = $items.Count -gt 1 -and
            $cpuUse -le ($cpuAlloc - $largestCpuNode) -and
            $memUse -le ($memAlloc - $largestMemNode) -and
            $podsCurrent -le ($podsMax - $largestPodNode)

        [PSCustomObject]@{
            NodeGroup     = $group.Name
            InstanceTypes = (($items.Instance | Sort-Object -Unique) -join ",")
            Nodes         = $items.Count
            Pods          = $podsCurrent
            CpuRequestPct = Get-Percent $cpuRequest $cpuAlloc
            CpuUsePct     = Get-Percent $cpuUse $cpuAlloc
            MemRequestPct = Get-Percent $memRequest $memAlloc
            MemUsePct     = Get-Percent $memUse $memAlloc
            NPlusOneByRequests = if ($nPlusOne) { "PASS" } else { "FAIL" }
            NPlusOneByUse = if ($nPlusOneByUse) { "PASS" } else { "FAIL" }
            PodsNoCpuRequest = ($items | Measure-Object PodsNoCpuRequest -Sum).Sum
            PodsNoMemRequest = ($items | Measure-Object PodsNoMemRequest -Sum).Sum
        }
    }
)

$namespaceRows = @(
    foreach ($group in @($podRows | Group-Object Namespace)) {
        [PSCustomObject]@{
            Namespace       = $group.Name
            Pods            = $group.Count
            CpuRequest_m    = [math]::Round(($group.Group | Measure-Object CpuRequest_m -Sum).Sum, 0)
            CpuUse_m        = [math]::Round(($group.Group | Measure-Object CpuUse_m -Sum).Sum, 0)
            MemoryRequestMi = [math]::Round(($group.Group | Measure-Object MemoryRequestMi -Sum).Sum, 0)
            MemoryUseMi     = [math]::Round(($group.Group | Measure-Object MemoryUseMi -Sum).Sum, 0)
        }
    }
)

Write-Section "Resumen por node group"
$groupRows | Sort-Object NodeGroup | Format-Table -AutoSize

Write-Section "Detalle por nodo"
$nodeRows | Sort-Object NodeGroup, Node | Format-Table Node, NodeGroup, Instance, Zone, Pods, PodsPct, CpuRequestPct, CpuUsePct, MemRequestPct, MemUsePct -AutoSize

Write-Section "Top 15 pods por memoria usada"
$podRows | Sort-Object MemoryUseMi -Descending | Select-Object -First 15 Namespace, Pod, Node, MemoryRequestMi, MemoryUseMi, CpuRequest_m, CpuUse_m | Format-Table -AutoSize

Write-Section "Pods en uso con requests incompletos"
$podsWithoutRequests = @($podRows | Where-Object {
    ($_.CpuUse_m -gt 0 -and $_.NoCpuRequest -gt 0) -or
    ($_.MemoryUseMi -gt 0 -and $_.NoMemoryRequest -gt 0)
})
if ($podsWithoutRequests.Count -eq 0) {
    Write-Host "No se encontraron pods en uso con requests incompletos." -ForegroundColor Green
} else {
    $podsWithoutRequests |
        Sort-Object MemoryUseMi -Descending |
        Select-Object Namespace, Pod, Node, NoCpuRequest, NoMemoryRequest, CpuUse_m, MemoryUseMi |
        Format-Table -AutoSize
}

Write-Section "Pods pendientes"
$pendingPods = @($podRows | Where-Object { $_.Phase -eq "Pending" })
if ($pendingPods.Count -eq 0) {
    Write-Host "No hay pods Pending." -ForegroundColor Green
} else {
    $pendingPods | Format-Table Namespace, Pod, CpuRequest_m, MemoryRequestMi -AutoSize
}

Write-Section "PodDisruptionBudgets"
if (@($pdbs.items).Count -eq 0) {
    Write-Host "No se encontraron PDB." -ForegroundColor Yellow
} else {
    @($pdbs.items) | ForEach-Object {
        [PSCustomObject]@{
            Namespace          = $_.metadata.namespace
            Name               = $_.metadata.name
            AllowedDisruptions = $_.status.disruptionsAllowed
            Healthy            = $_.status.currentHealthy
            DesiredHealthy     = $_.status.desiredHealthy
        }
    } | Format-Table -AutoSize
}

Write-Section "Alertas"
$alerts = @($nodeRows | Where-Object {
    $_.PodsPct -ge $WarningPercent -or
    $_.CpuRequestPct -ge $WarningPercent -or
    $_.CpuUsePct -ge $WarningPercent -or
    $_.MemRequestPct -ge $WarningPercent -or
    $_.MemUsePct -ge $WarningPercent
})
if ($alerts.Count -eq 0) {
    Write-Host "Ningun nodo supera $WarningPercent% en pods, CPU o memoria." -ForegroundColor Green
} else {
    $alerts | Format-Table Node, NodeGroup, PodsPct, CpuRequestPct, CpuUsePct, MemRequestPct, MemUsePct -AutoSize
}

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $OutputDirectory -Force | Out-Null
$nodeRows | Export-Csv (Join-Path $OutputDirectory "nodes.csv") -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8
$groupRows | Export-Csv (Join-Path $OutputDirectory "nodegroups.csv") -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8
$podRows | Export-Csv (Join-Path $OutputDirectory "pods.csv") -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8
$namespaceRows | Sort-Object Namespace | Export-Csv (Join-Path $OutputDirectory "namespaces.csv") -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "CSV generados en: $OutputDirectory" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "N+1 usa capacidad agregada; valide tambien PDB, afinidad, zonas, volumenes y drain antes de rotar nodos."
```

## scripts/check-cluster-autoscaling.ps1

```powershell
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$Context,
    [switch]$FailIfNoNodeAutoscaler
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

function Write-Section {
    param([string]$Title)

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "=== $Title ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
}

function Invoke-Kubectl {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)]
        [string[]]$Arguments,
        [switch]$AllowFailure
    )

    $commandArguments = @()
    if ($Context) {
        $commandArguments += @("--context", $Context)
    }
    $commandArguments += $Arguments

    $output = & kubectl @commandArguments 2>&1
    $exitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
    if ($exitCode -ne 0 -and -not $AllowFailure) {
        throw "kubectl fallo: kubectl $($commandArguments -join ' ')`n$($output -join "`n")"
    }

    return [PSCustomObject]@{
        ExitCode = $exitCode
        Output   = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

function Get-KubectlJson {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)]
        [string[]]$Arguments,
        [switch]$AllowFailure
    )

    $result = Invoke-Kubectl -Arguments ($Arguments + @("-o", "json")) -AllowFailure:$AllowFailure
    if ($result.ExitCode -ne 0 -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($result.Output)) {
        return $null
    }

    return $result.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
}

if (-not (Get-Command kubectl -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
    throw "kubectl no esta instalado o no esta disponible en PATH."
}

$version = Invoke-Kubectl -Arguments @("version", "--client=false") -AllowFailure
if ($version.ExitCode -ne 0) {
    throw "No fue posible conectar al cluster. Verifique credenciales y el parametro -Context.`n$($version.Output)"
}

$currentContext = if ($Context) {
    $Context
} else {
    (Invoke-Kubectl -Arguments @("config", "current-context")).Output.Trim()
}

Write-Host "Cluster/contexto: $currentContext" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "Revision de solo lectura. No se modificara ningun recurso."

$workloads = Get-KubectlJson -Arguments @("get", "deployments,daemonsets,statefulsets", "--all-namespaces")
$crdResult = Invoke-Kubectl -Arguments @(
    "get",
    "customresourcedefinitions.apiextensions.k8s.io",
    "-o",
    "jsonpath={range .items[*]}{.metadata.name}{'\n'}{end}"
)
$hpas = Get-KubectlJson -Arguments @("get", "horizontalpodautoscalers.autoscaling", "--all-namespaces") -AllowFailure

$controllerPattern = "cluster-autoscaler|karpenter|keda|vertical-pod-autoscaler|metrics-server"
$controllerMatches = @(
    foreach ($item in @($workloads.items)) {
        $containers = @($item.spec.template.spec.containers)
        $searchText = @(
            $item.metadata.name
            $item.metadata.labels.PSObject.Properties.Value
            $containers.name
            $containers.image
            $containers.args
        ) -join " "

        if ($searchText -match $controllerPattern) {
            [PSCustomObject]@{
                Namespace = $item.metadata.namespace
                Kind      = $item.kind
                Name      = $item.metadata.name
                Images    = ($containers.image -join ", ")
            }
        }
    }
)

Write-Section "Controladores detectados"
if ($controllerMatches.Count -gt 0) {
    $controllerMatches | Sort-Object Namespace, Name | Format-Table -AutoSize
} else {
    Write-Host "No se encontraron controladores conocidos." -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

$crdNames = @($crdResult.Output -split "\r?\n" | Where-Object { -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($_) })
$interestingCrds = @($crdNames | Where-Object {
    $_ -match "karpenter|keda|autoscaling.k8s.io|nodepools.eks.amazonaws.com"
})

Write-Section "CRDs de autoscaling"
if ($interestingCrds.Count -gt 0) {
    $interestingCrds | Sort-Object | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ }
} else {
    Write-Host "No se encontraron CRDs de Karpenter, KEDA, VPA o EKS Auto Mode."
}

$scaledObjects = $null
if ($crdNames -contains "scaledobjects.keda.sh") {
    $scaledObjects = Get-KubectlJson -Arguments @("get", "scaledobjects.keda.sh", "--all-namespaces") -AllowFailure
}

$nodePools = $null
$nodePoolResource = $null
if ($crdNames -contains "nodepools.karpenter.sh") {
    $nodePoolResource = "nodepools.karpenter.sh"
    $nodePools = Get-KubectlJson -Arguments @("get", $nodePoolResource) -AllowFailure
} elseif ($crdNames -contains "nodepools.eks.amazonaws.com") {
    $nodePoolResource = "nodepools.eks.amazonaws.com"
    $nodePools = Get-KubectlJson -Arguments @("get", $nodePoolResource) -AllowFailure
}

Write-Section "Objetos de escalamiento"
$hpaCount = if ($hpas) { @($hpas.items).Count } else { 0 }
$scaledObjectCount = if ($scaledObjects) { @($scaledObjects.items).Count } else { 0 }
$nodePoolCount = if ($nodePools) { @($nodePools.items).Count } else { 0 }
Write-Host "HPA:                 $hpaCount"
Write-Host "KEDA ScaledObjects:  $scaledObjectCount"
Write-Host "NodePools:           $nodePoolCount"
if ($nodePoolResource) {
    Write-Host "API de NodePools:    $nodePoolResource"
}

$fluxObjects = @()
foreach ($resource in @(
    "helmreleases.helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io",
    "kustomizations.kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io"
)) {
    if ($crdNames -contains $resource) {
        $objects = Get-KubectlJson -Arguments @("get", $resource, "--all-namespaces") -AllowFailure
        foreach ($item in @($objects.items)) {
            $text = "$($item.metadata.name) $($item.spec.chart.spec.chart) $($item.spec.path)"
            if ($text -match "autoscaler|karpenter|keda") {
                $fluxObjects += [PSCustomObject]@{
                    Namespace = $item.metadata.namespace
                    Kind      = $item.kind
                    Name      = $item.metadata.name
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

Write-Section "Objetos Flux relacionados"
if ($fluxObjects.Count -gt 0) {
    $fluxObjects | Sort-Object Namespace, Name | Format-Table -AutoSize
} else {
    Write-Host "No se encontraron HelmRelease/Kustomization relacionados con autoscaling."
}

$clusterAutoscalerFound = @($controllerMatches | Where-Object {
    "$($_.Name) $($_.Images)" -match "cluster-autoscaler"
}).Count -gt 0
$karpenterFound = (@($controllerMatches | Where-Object {
    "$($_.Name) $($_.Images)" -match "karpenter"
}).Count -gt 0) -or ($crdNames -contains "nodepools.karpenter.sh")
$eksAutoModeFound = $crdNames -contains "nodepools.eks.amazonaws.com"
$kedaFound = (@($controllerMatches | Where-Object {
    "$($_.Name) $($_.Images)" -match "keda"
}).Count -gt 0) -or ($crdNames -contains "scaledobjects.keda.sh")
$metricsServerFound = @($controllerMatches | Where-Object {
    "$($_.Name) $($_.Images)" -match "metrics-server"
}).Count -gt 0
$nodeAutoscalerFound = $clusterAutoscalerFound -or $karpenterFound -or $eksAutoModeFound

Write-Section "Resumen"
Write-Host ("Cluster Autoscaler: {0}" -f $(if ($clusterAutoscalerFound) { "SI" } else { "NO" }))
Write-Host ("Karpenter:          {0}" -f $(if ($karpenterFound) { "SI" } else { "NO" }))
Write-Host ("EKS Auto Mode:      {0}" -f $(if ($eksAutoModeFound) { "SI" } else { "NO" }))
Write-Host ("KEDA:               {0}" -f $(if ($kedaFound) { "SI" } else { "NO" }))
Write-Host ("HPA configurados:   {0}" -f $hpaCount)
Write-Host ("Metrics Server:      {0}" -f $(if ($metricsServerFound) { "SI" } else { "NO" }))
Write-Host ""

if ($nodeAutoscalerFound) {
    Write-Host "Resultado: existe al menos un mecanismo de escalamiento de nodos." -ForegroundColor Green
} else {
    Write-Host "Resultado: NO se detecto escalamiento automatico de nodos." -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host "KEDA y HPA escalan pods; no agregan nodos al cluster." -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

if ($FailIfNoNodeAutoscaler -and -not $nodeAutoscalerFound) {
    exit 2
}

exit 0
```

## scripts/diagnostico-cnpg-nubo.ps1

```powershell
param(
    [string]$Namespace = 'postgresql-nubo',
    [string]$ClusterName = 'cloudnative-pg-nubo',
    [string]$FluxNamespace = 'flux-system',
    [string]$OperatorNamespace = 'cloudnative-pg',
    [int]$ExpectedInstances = 2,
    [string]$OutputPath = ''
)

# Windows PowerShell 5.1 y PowerShell 7. Solo lectura: no aplica parches,
# no reinicia componentes y no consulta Secrets ni imprime variables de entorno.
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
$lines = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.List[string]'
$findings = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.List[string]'

function Say([string]$message) {
    Write-Host $message
    [void]$script:lines.Add($message)
}
function Section([string]$name) { Say ''; Say "=== $name ===" }
function Finding([string]$message) { [void]$script:findings.Add($message) }
function Kube([string[]]$arguments) {
    $output = & kubectl @arguments 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ }
    [pscustomobject]@{ Code = $LASTEXITCODE; Text = ($output -join "`n").Trim() }
}
function KubeJson([string[]]$arguments) {
    $result = Kube -arguments $arguments
    if ($result.Code -ne 0) {
        Say "ERROR kubectl $($arguments -join ' '): $($result.Text)"
        return $null
    }
    try { return ($result.Text | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop) }
    catch {
        Say "ERROR al leer JSON: $($_.Exception.Message)"
        return $null
    }
}
function KubeText([string]$title, [string[]]$arguments) {
    Section $title
    $result = Kube -arguments $arguments
    if ($result.Text) { Say $result.Text }
    if ($result.Code -ne 0) { Say "ERROR: kubectl termino con codigo $($result.Code)" }
}
function LogExcerpt([string]$namespace, [string]$deployment, [string]$pattern) {
    $result = Kube -arguments @('-n', $namespace, 'logs', "deployment/$deployment", '--since=45m', '--tail=450')
    if ($result.Code -ne 0) {
        Say "No se pudieron leer logs de ${namespace}/${deployment}: $($result.Text)"
        return
    }
    $matches = @($result.Text -split "`n" | Where-Object { $_ -match $pattern } | Select-Object -Last 12)
    if ($matches.Count -eq 0) { Say "${namespace}/${deployment}: sin coincidencias recientes." }
    else { foreach ($entry in $matches) { Say $entry } }
}
function Sql([string]$pod, [string]$query) {
    $result = Kube -arguments @('-n', $Namespace, 'exec', $pod, '-c', 'postgres', '--',
        'psql', '-X', '-q', '-t', '-A', '-F', ' | ', '-U', 'postgres', '-d', 'postgres', '-c', $query)
    if ($result.Code -eq 0) { Say $result.Text }
    else { Say "ERROR SQL en ${pod}: $($result.Text)" }
    return $result
}
function PodReady($pod) {
    if (-not $pod -or $pod.status.phase -ne 'Running') { return $false }
    foreach ($condition in @($pod.status.conditions)) {
        if ($condition.type -eq 'Ready' -and $condition.status -eq 'True') { return $true }
    }
    return $false
}

if (-not (Get-Command kubectl -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { throw 'kubectl no esta en PATH.' }
if (-not $OutputPath) {
    $OutputPath = Join-Path $env:TEMP ("cnpg-nubo-diagnostico-{0}.txt" -f (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'))
}
$context = Kube -arguments @('config', 'current-context')
if ($context.Code -ne 0) { throw "No se pudo leer el contexto: $($context.Text)" }
Say "Fecha: $((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ'))"
Say "Contexto kubectl: $($context.Text)"
Say "Cluster: $Namespace/$ClusterName"
Say "Instancias esperadas durante esta fase: $ExpectedInstances"

Section 'Fuente Git de Flux'
$git = KubeJson -arguments @('-n', $FluxNamespace, 'get', 'gitrepository', 'flux-system', '-o', 'json')
if ($git) {
    $gitRevision = [string]$git.status.artifact.revision
    Say "Artifact revision: $gitRevision"
    Say "Suspendido: $($git.spec.suspend) | URL: $($git.spec.url)"
    Say "Ultima revision observada: $($git.status.observedGeneration)/$($git.metadata.generation)"
    foreach ($condition in @($git.status.conditions)) {
        Say "Condicion $($condition.type)=$($condition.status): $($condition.message)"
    }
    if (-not $gitRevision) { Finding 'GitRepository de Flux no publica un artifact con revision.' }
    if ($git.spec.suspend -eq $true) { Finding 'GitRepository de Flux esta suspendido.' }
}

Section 'Kustomizations de Flux'
foreach ($name in @('kustom-reposources', 'kustom-cloudnative-operator', 'kustom-postgresql-nubo')) {
    $k = KubeJson -arguments @('-n', $FluxNamespace, 'get', 'kustomization', $name, '-o', 'json')
    if (-not $k) { continue }
    Say "$name`: suspendido=$($k.spec.suspend) | intentada=$($k.status.lastAttemptedRevision) | aplicada=$($k.status.lastAppliedRevision)"
    $dependencies = @($k.spec.dependsOn | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { $_.name }) -join ','
    if ($dependencies) { Say "  Depende de: $dependencies" }
    foreach ($condition in @($k.status.conditions)) {
        if ($condition.type -in @('Ready','Reconciling','Stalled')) {
            Say "  $($condition.type)=$($condition.status) $($condition.reason): $($condition.message)"
            if ($condition.type -eq 'Ready' -and $condition.status -eq 'False') {
                Finding "$name no esta Ready: $($condition.message)"
            }
        }
    }
    if ($k.spec.suspend -eq $true) { Finding "$name esta suspendida." }
    if ($gitRevision -and
        [string]$k.status.lastAttemptedRevision -ne $gitRevision) {
        Finding "$name todavia no intento la revision que publica GitRepository."
    }
}
Section 'Logs de controladores Flux'
LogExcerpt $FluxNamespace 'source-controller' 'flux-system|GitRepository|error|fail|authentication|timeout'
LogExcerpt $FluxNamespace 'kustomize-controller' 'kustom-reposources|kustom-postgresql-nubo|kustom-cloudnative-operator|dependency.*revision|error|fail'

Section 'Cluster CloudNativePG'
$cluster = KubeJson -arguments @('-n', $Namespace, 'get', 'cluster', $ClusterName, '-o', 'json')
$primary = ''
if ($cluster) {
    $primary = [string]$cluster.status.currentPrimary
    Say "Deseadas=$($cluster.spec.instances) | Observadas=$($cluster.status.instances) | Listas=$($cluster.status.readyInstances) | Primario=$primary"
    Say "Fase=$($cluster.status.phase) | Motivo=$($cluster.status.phaseReason)"
    Say "Slots declarados=$($cluster.spec.postgresql.parameters.max_replication_slots) | WAL senders declarados=$($cluster.spec.postgresql.parameters.max_wal_senders)"
    Say "Estrategia=$($cluster.spec.primaryUpdateStrategy) | Metodo=$($cluster.spec.primaryUpdateMethod)"
    foreach ($plugin in @($cluster.spec.plugins)) { if ($plugin) { Say "Plugin solicitado=$($plugin.name)" } }
    foreach ($condition in @($cluster.status.conditions)) {
        Say "Condicion $($condition.type)=$($condition.status) $($condition.reason): $($condition.message)"
    }
    Say "Instancias fallidas=$(@($cluster.status.instancesStatus.failed) -join ',')"
    if ($cluster.metadata.annotations.'cnpg.io/reconciliationLoop' -eq 'disabled') {
        Finding 'La reconciliacion del Cluster esta desactivada mediante cnpg.io/reconciliationLoop.'
    }
    if ([int]$cluster.spec.instances -ne $ExpectedInstances) {
        Finding "El Cluster declara $($cluster.spec.instances) instancias; se esperaban $ExpectedInstances para esta fase."
    }
    if ([string]$cluster.status.phase -match 'unknown plugin') {
        Finding 'El operador informa que no reconoce el plugin Barman; revisar su registro y Service.'
    }
}

Section 'Pods, Jobs y PVC'
$podsJson = KubeJson -arguments @('-n', $Namespace, 'get', 'pods', '-o', 'json')
$instancePods = @()
if ($podsJson) {
    foreach ($pod in @($podsJson.items)) {
        if (-not $pod) { continue }
        if ($pod.metadata.name -notlike "$ClusterName-*") { continue }
        $ready = PodReady $pod
        Say "$($pod.metadata.name) | fase=$($pod.status.phase) | ready=$ready | nodo=$($pod.spec.nodeName) | creado=$($pod.metadata.creationTimestamp)"
        if ($pod.metadata.name -match "^$([regex]::Escape($ClusterName))-[0-9]+$") { $instancePods += $pod }
    }
}
$jobsJson = KubeJson -arguments @('-n', $Namespace, 'get', 'jobs', '-o', 'json')
$joinJobs = @()
if ($jobsJson) {
    $joinJobs = @($jobsJson.items | Where-Object { $_ -and $_.metadata.name -like "$ClusterName*-join" })
    if ($joinJobs.Count -eq 0) { Say 'No hay Jobs de join.' }
    foreach ($job in $joinJobs) {
        Say "$($job.metadata.name) | succeeded=$($job.status.succeeded) | failed=$($job.status.failed) | active=$($job.status.active)"
        foreach ($condition in @($job.status.conditions)) {
            Say "  $($condition.type)=$($condition.status) $($condition.reason): $($condition.message)"
            if ($condition.type -eq 'Failed' -and $condition.status -eq 'True') {
                Finding "El Job $($job.metadata.name) termino fallido y puede bloquear la reconciliacion."
            }
        }
    }
}
$pvcs = KubeJson -arguments @('-n', $Namespace, 'get', 'pvc', '-o', 'json')
if ($pvcs) {
    foreach ($pvc in @($pvcs.items | Where-Object { $_ -and $_.metadata.name -like "$ClusterName-*" })) {
        Say "$($pvc.metadata.name) | fase=$($pvc.status.phase) | volumen=$($pvc.spec.volumeName) | tamano=$($pvc.spec.resources.requests.storage)"
    }
}

Section 'Eventos recientes del Cluster'
$events = KubeJson -arguments @('-n', $Namespace, 'get', 'events', '-o', 'json')
if ($events) {
    $relevant = @($events.items | Where-Object {
        $_ -and (([string]$_.involvedObject.name -like "$ClusterName*") -or
            ([string]$_.message -match [regex]::Escape($ClusterName)))
    } | Sort-Object { $_.lastTimestamp } | Select-Object -Last 18)
    foreach ($event in $relevant) {
        Say "$($event.lastTimestamp) $($event.type) $($event.reason) $($event.involvedObject.kind)/$($event.involvedObject.name): $($event.message)"
    }
}

Section 'Ultimo intento de join'
if ($podsJson) {
    $joinPods = @($podsJson.items | Where-Object { $_ -and $_.metadata.name -like "$ClusterName*-join-*" } |
        Sort-Object { $_.metadata.creationTimestamp } -Descending)
    if ($joinPods.Count -gt 0) {
        $joinPod = [string]$joinPods[0].metadata.name
        Say "Pod=$joinPod"
        $joinLog = Kube -arguments @('-n', $Namespace, 'logs', $joinPod, '--all-containers=true', '--tail=180')
        if ($joinLog.Code -eq 0) {
            foreach ($entry in @($joinLog.Text -split "`n" | Where-Object {
                $_ -match 'all replication slots are in use|pg_basebackup: error|Error joining node|permission denied|forbidden|No space left|could not connect|FATAL:'
            } | Select-Object -Last 10)) { Say $entry }
            if ($joinLog.Text -match 'all replication slots are in use') {
                Finding 'El ultimo pg_basebackup fallo porque no habia replication slots disponibles en el primario.'
            }
        } else { Say "No se pudieron leer logs: $($joinLog.Text)" }
    } else { Say 'No hay Pods de join visibles.' }
}

Section 'Operador y plugin Barman'
foreach ($deploymentName in @('cloudnative-pg-operator', 'barman-cloud-plugin-barman-cloud')) {
    $deployment = KubeJson -arguments @('-n', $OperatorNamespace, 'get', 'deployment', $deploymentName, '-o', 'json')
    if ($deployment) {
        Say "$deploymentName | disponibles=$($deployment.status.availableReplicas)/$($deployment.spec.replicas) | imagen=$($deployment.spec.template.spec.containers[0].image)"
    }
}
$service = KubeJson -arguments @('-n', $OperatorNamespace, 'get', 'service', 'barman-cloud', '-o', 'json')
if ($service) { Say "Service Barman: plugin=$($service.metadata.labels.'cnpg.io/pluginName') | IP=$($service.spec.clusterIP)" }
$slices = KubeJson -arguments @('-n', $OperatorNamespace, 'get', 'endpointslices', '-l', 'kubernetes.io/service-name=barman-cloud', '-o', 'json')
$endpointCount = 0
if ($slices) {
    foreach ($slice in @($slices.items)) {
        foreach ($endpoint in @($slice.endpoints)) {
            if ($endpoint -and $endpoint.conditions.ready -ne $false) { $endpointCount++ }
        }
    }
}
Say "Endpoints Barman listos=$endpointCount"
if ($cluster -and $cluster.spec.plugins -and $endpointCount -eq 0) {
    Finding 'Barman esta solicitado pero su Service no tiene endpoints listos.'
}
LogExcerpt $OperatorNamespace 'cloudnative-pg-operator' 'cloudnative-pg-nubo|Unknown plugin|Reconciler error|replication slot|failed.*join'

Section 'PostgreSQL en instancias listas'
foreach ($pod in $instancePods) {
    if (-not (PodReady $pod)) { continue }
    $podName = [string]$pod.metadata.name
    Say "--- $podName ---"
    $settings = Sql $podName "SELECT name,setting,pending_restart FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('max_replication_slots','max_wal_senders') ORDER BY name;"
    if ($settings.Code -eq 0 -and $settings.Text -match '\|\s*t(?:\r?\n|$)') {
        Finding "$podName tiene parametros PostgreSQL pendientes de reinicio."
    }
    $slotCount = Sql $podName "SELECT count(*) AS slots_usados,current_setting('max_replication_slots') AS limite FROM pg_replication_slots;"
    if ($slotCount.Code -eq 0 -and $slotCount.Text -match '^\s*(\d+)\s*\|\s*(\d+)\s*$') {
        if ([int]$Matches[1] -ge [int]$Matches[2]) {
            Finding "$podName tiene todos los replication slots ocupados ($($Matches[1])/$($Matches[2]))."
        }
    }
    Sql $podName "SELECT slot_type,active,count(*) FROM pg_replication_slots GROUP BY slot_type,active ORDER BY slot_type,active;" | Out-Null
    if ($podName -eq $primary) {
        Sql $podName 'SELECT application_name,state,sync_state FROM pg_stat_replication;' | Out-Null
        Sql $podName 'SELECT archived_count,last_archived_time,failed_count,last_failed_time FROM pg_stat_archiver;' | Out-Null
    } else {
        Sql $podName 'SELECT status,latest_end_lsn,last_msg_receipt_time FROM pg_stat_wal_receiver;' | Out-Null
    }
}

Section 'Backups recientes'
$backups = KubeJson -arguments @('-n', $Namespace, 'get', 'backups', '-o', 'json')
if ($backups) {
    foreach ($backup in @($backups.items | Where-Object { $_ -and $_.spec.cluster.name -eq $ClusterName } |
        Sort-Object { $_.metadata.creationTimestamp } -Descending | Select-Object -First 5)) {
        Say "$($backup.metadata.name) | fase=$($backup.status.phase) | fin=$($backup.status.stoppedAt) | error=$($backup.status.error)"
    }
}

Section 'Conclusiones'
if ($findings.Count -eq 0) { Say 'No se detecto una causa unica con estas lecturas; revisar eventos y fase del Cluster arriba.' }
else { foreach ($finding in $findings) { Say "- $finding" } }
Say 'Script de solo lectura: no modifico Pods, PVC, slots, Cluster ni Flux.'

try {
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllLines($OutputPath, $lines.ToArray(), (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    Write-Host "Informe guardado en: $OutputPath"
} catch {
    Write-Warning "No se pudo guardar el informe: $($_.Exception.Message)"
}

```

## utils/flux-boostrap.sh

```bash
#!/bin/bash

REPO_OWNER=bvcco
REPO_NAME=bin_ti-k8s-base
REPO_PATH=env
REPO_BRANCH=production
REPO_USER="xxx"
REPO_TOKEN="[REDACTED]"

echo -e "\033[1;33m (1/3). Please enter the github repository NAME (e.g. bin_ti-k8s-base ):\033[0m"
read REPO_NAME

flux bootstrap github --owner=${REPO_OWNER} --repository=${REPO_NAME} --branch=${REPO_BRANCH} --path=${REPO_PATH} --token-auth

echo -e "\033[1;33m (2/3). Please enter the github USERNAME:\033[0m"
read REPO_USER

echo -e "\033[1;33m (2/3). Please enter the github TOKEN:\033[0m"
read REPO_TOKEN

kubectl create secret generic git-base-credentials-devops \
  --namespace=flux-system \
  --from-literal=username=${REPO_USER} \
  --from-literal=password=${REPO_TOKEN}
```
